title: Guest Services Agent – Four Seasons Resort and Residences AMAALA at Triple Bay, Saudi Arabia
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

AMAALA is situated along Saudi Arabia’s northwest coast and is home to some of the most diverse natural environments. Marking a new chapter for comprehensive wellness tourism, Four Seasons Resort and Residences AMAALA at Triple Bay will feature 220 keys comprising of rooms and suites, as well as villas with their own private pools, and 26 branded residential villas, all thoughtfully designed to offer breathtaking bay and sea views. The resort will include a luxury spa nestled within its garden of tranquility and inspiration featuring a sculptured waterfall. The Organic Spa Garden will be a focal point and treatment experience set to stimulate the senses, offering extensive therapeutic remedies including halotherapy, cryotherapy, and advanced skin therapies. For fitness enthusiasts, the property will offer a bespoke collaboration with fitness trainer Harley Pasternak to seamlessly merge high-performance training with the limitless potential of Triple Bay’s 300 hectares (741 acres) of untouched hills, wadis, and beaches. The pristine terrain includes trails perfect for canyoning and exploring the rugged cliffs and valleys. Guests and residents can also take part in an array of guided hikes, mountain biking, and equestrian bridle trails, or work on their game at the spectacular 27-hole oceanfront golf course.

About the Role
Join our pre-opening team as Guest Services Agent at Four Seasons Resort and Residences AMAALA at Triple Bay. Reporting to the Guest Services Supervisor, you will play an essential role in welcoming guests, managing their luggage and transportation needs, and ensuring smooth and personalized arrivals and departures throughout the pre-opening phase and daily operations.

What You Will Do

  • Assist with pre-opening tasks including systems setup, service standard creation, and training related to guest arrivals and departures.

  • Greet guests upon arrival and departure, assist with luggage handling, escorting, and offering helpful resort and destination information.

  • Coordinate closely with the Front Desk, Concierge, and Valet teams to ensure seamless guest movement and satisfaction.

  • Assist VIP guests and respond to special requests with care and attention.

  • Maintain guest areas at the entrance and lobby, ensuring a welcoming and organized environment.

  • Deliver items to guest rooms when required and support room moves as needed.

  • Monitor guest feedback and support service recovery when necessary.

  • Maintain a professional appearance and embody the Four Seasons service culture.

What You Bring

  • Previous experience in guest services, bell desk, or valet roles within luxury hospitality preferred.

  • Pre-opening experience is an advantage.

  • Energetic and service-oriented personality with excellent communication skills.

  • Physically fit and able to handle luggage and assist with guest movement as needed.

  • Saudi Driver License, Ability to drive.

  • Suitable candidates must be eligible to work in Saudi Arabia. Fluency and English is essential.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary in a tax-free environment.

  • Housing and transportation.

  • 30 days of vacation plus public holidays.

  • Paid home leave tickets.

  • Complimentary meals and uniform cleaning.

  • Medical and life insurance.

  • Employee Assistance Program and worldwide complimentary room nights.

  • Opportunities for growth and development.

Schedule & Hours
Full-time role.

title: Manager – Information Security Governance
description:
About Cognizant Corporate

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose\: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business.

About the role

As a Manager – Information Security Governance & Metrics Reporting, you will be a key member of the Extended CISO Tower's Cybersecurity Architecture & Risk (CAR) practice, coordinating closely with Associate Directors, CAR team leads, Enterprise Architecture, IT and business stakeholders. You will own the operational health of Cognizant's ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management System and act as ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor for the AI Management System, while consolidating Key Monthly Operations Metrics across CAR teams into leadership-ready reporting. You will have the autonomy to bring structure, rigor and clarity to how we measure and communicate our security posture. As a team of self-starters, you can work with impact alongside our vibrant people and culture, all while enjoying unmatched learning opportunities.

In this role, you will\:

• Own the day-to-day operation of Cognizant's ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management System (ISMS) – maintaining the Statement of Applicability, Risk Treatment Plans, policies and control documentation.

• Plan and execute the internal audit program, and coordinate external certification and surveillance audits, ensuring non-conformities and corrective actions (NC/CAPA) are tracked to verified closure.

• Serve as ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor for Cognizant's AI Management System (AIMS) – planning and conducting audits against Annex A controls (data governance, human oversight, AI impact assessment, transparency), reporting findings and driving corrective actions.

• Act as the central coordination point across CAR sub-teams, Enterprise Architects, IT, Compliance and business stakeholders, driving open items, validations and remediation actions to closure.

• Maintain strong working knowledge of Cognizant's information security processes, policies and control framework, ensuring day-to-day CAR activities stay aligned to them.

• Own Key Monthly Operations Metrics – defining, tracking and consolidating KPIs, KRIs and SLA/turnaround-time data across CAR teams into a single, consistent reporting cadence.

• Partner with CAR team leads to collect, validate and normalize metrics (validation volumes, findings/remediation aging, audit closure rates) across platform, application and vendor go-live validations.

• Prepare and present monthly and quarterly leadership decks and dashboards, translating operational metrics into clear trends, risk narratives and business impact for the CISO Tower and senior stakeholders.

• Drive continuous improvement in metrics collection and reporting, working towards automated, tool-based tracking (e.g., GRC platform, Power BI/Tableau) over manual spreadsheets.

• Stay current on emerging regulatory requirements relevant to the role, including India's DPDP Act and CERT-In directions, and reflect these in governance reporting.

• Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture.

What you must have to be considered

• 9-12 years of experience in information security governance, risk & compliance, including hands-on ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS management.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field.

• ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification – Required.

• ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System) Lead Auditor certification, or equivalent AIMS audit experience – Required.

• Strong working knowledge of enterprise information security processes, controls and validation practices.

• Proven experience defining and consolidating security metrics, KPIs and KRIs, with hands-on dashboarding/reporting (Power BI, Tableau or similar).

• Excellent stakeholder coordination, communication and project-management skills, with the ability to drive closure across multiple teams.

• A strong sense of ownership, a desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good.

• The embodiment of Cognizant's Values\: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, & Own It.

These will help you succeed

• CISA or CISM – strongly preferred.

• Experience with GRC platforms (ServiceNow GRC, MetricStream) for metrics tracking and reporting.

• Working knowledge of India's DPDP Act (2023 / 2025 Rules) and CERT-In directions.

• ISO/IEC 27701 or ITIL certification.

• Experience preparing leadership-visibility dashboards consolidating metrics across multiple teams.

• Exposure to AI governance concepts (NIST AI RMF) supporting the AIMS audit function.

Work model

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2 days a week in a Cognizant office in Chennai, India. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Dental Mobile Dental Van Driver - Per Diem
description:
Drive Smiles Across Rhode Island!
Do you enjoy being on the road, connecting with communities, and making a meaningful difference in children's lives? Join East Bay Community Action Program (EBCAP) as a Mobile Dental Van Driver and help bring essential dental services directly to children and families throughout the East Bay region of Rhode Island. In this unique role, you'll be more than a driver. You'll be a valued community ambassador helping expand access to oral healthcare where it's needed most.

Job Description
The Mobile Dental Van Driver is responsible for safely transporting and supporting the operation of EBCAP's "Smiles" Mobile Dental Van at schools, community sites, and other designated locations throughout the East Bay region. This role ensures timely service delivery, maintains a welcoming experience for community partners and visitors, and supports the daily setup and readiness of the mobile dental program.
As the first person many partners and visitors meet, the Mobile Dental Van Driver plays an important role in representing EBCAP's mission and commitment to improving children's oral health.
Safe Transportation & Vehicle Operations
  • Safely operate and transport the Mobile Dental Van to scheduled community locations throughout the East Bay region.
  • Follow all traffic laws, safety protocols, and site-specific requirements when navigating school campuses, community events, and public venues.
  • Complete required vehicle inspections, logs, and transportation documentation in compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
Mobile Clinic Setup & Support
  • Prepare the dental van for daily operations at each location.
  • Assist with setup, breakdown, cleaning, stocking, and organization of dental equipment and supplies.
  • Help ensure the mobile clinic remains safe, clean, and ready to serve patients throughout the day.
Customer Service & Community Engagement
  • Serve as a friendly and professional representative of EBCAP.
  • Welcome and assist school representatives, community partners, volunteers, and members of the public.
  • Respond to basic program and logistical questions while providing excellent customer service.
Administrative & Communication Duties
  • Deliver and retrieve registration forms and program materials from participating schools and locations.
  • Maintain regular communication with the Dental Site Manager and program staff regarding schedules, site logistics, and operational needs.
  • Accurately document activities and results as required.
We're looking for someone who brings:
  • Excellent driving and road safety skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities.
  • Customer service and relationship-building experience.
  • Dependability and attention to detail.
  • Effective verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to work independently and manage priorities with minimal supervision.
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing schedules and community-based environments.
Required Qualifications
  • Minimum of two (2) years of professional driving experience operating a work-related vehicle used for deliveries, transportation, or similar business purposes.
  • Successful completion of a national background check.
  • Satisfactory Motor Vehicle Report (MVR).
  • Knowledge of safe vehicle operation and transportation best practices.
Preferred Attributes
  • Comfortable working in schools, community settings, and public-facing environments.
  • Passion for supporting community health initiatives and serving diverse populations.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Senior Technician (Development Approvals) within the Infrastructure Planning Team in the Environment and Transport Department.

We are looking for someone to assist in the technical approval of third-party highways and transportation schemes through the development process and to provide highway engineering advice as part of the authority’s responses to planning authority consultations for offsite highway works.

About the Role

This role will involve working alongside colleagues in the Development Approvals team; providing technical expertise on adoptable highway infrastructure to ensure they meet current standards, whilst facilitating development, and encouraging economic growth.

You will enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and have experience of managing your own workload and working to deadlines.

You will have excellent communication and negotiation skills, and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders.

In return you will receive a varied workload, the support of colleagues, and have an opportunity to shape the direction of growth in Leicestershire.

About You

To apply for this post, you must be able to evidence in your application how you meet the following criteria:

  • A BTEC Higher in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification OR experience that meets the essential requirement with evidence of continued learning and development.
  • Working in an engineering setting, in relation to design, management, maintenance or administrative processes for road construction or new developments.
  • Collaborative working with customers and key stakeholders to deliver and outcomes.
  • Interpreting and writing technical and non-technical reports and providing technical advice based on relevant guidance and standards; DMRB, Leicestershire Highway Design Guide (LHDG), Manual for Streets, LTN 1/20 etc.
  • Current legislation, policies and procedures; Highways Act, NPPF, NRSWA, Traffic Management Act, Traffic Regulation Act, CDM etc.
  • Have excellent communication and presentation skills, including being able to provide relevant, concise written advice and negotiate successful outcomes.
  • Be able to work to tight timescales and to agreed targets.

title: Engine Workshop Technician - Level I
description:
We are looking for a talented Engine Workshop Technician to join our team specializing in Service for our Master Rebuild Centre in Johannesburg, South Afrcia.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Complete engine repairs, rebuilds, and maintenance tasks efficiently, helping to keep customer equipment running reliably and minimizing downtime.

  • Support the inspection, disassembly, cleaning, and assessment of engines and components to identify issues and contribute to effective repair solutions.
  • Prepare the correct parts, tools, and equipment before maintenance activities, improving workshop productivity and reducing repair delays.

  • Continuously develop technical knowledge and skills through training programs, enabling increased capability and contribution to the workshop team.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Apply strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills to accurately diagnose, repair, and rebuild components while ensuring high-quality workmanship and efficient service delivery.
  • Utilize electronic service tools effectively to perform diagnostics, interpret results, identify root causes, and determine the appropriate corrective actions.
  • Deliver quality results within established turnaround times by maintaining an organized work area, following 5S principles, completing documentation accurately, and ensuring customer expectations are met.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to teamwork and continuous learning by supporting the training and development of apprentices, escalating complex technical issues appropriately, and continuously building technical expertise.

Education/ Experience

  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Preferred).

  • Minimal level of workshop experience required.
  • Basic level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

title: Product Manager, Contractor Management
description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. The position

  • Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, including across different departments (e.g. business operations, sales, etc.) to ensure that we’re satisfying critical business requirements
  • Proficient in English, both written and spoken.

Key responsibilities

  • Build solutions together with the rest of the team
    • Own not just software implementation, but the end-to-end experience: Remote delivers value through services powered by both humans and software
    • Lead on complex solutions without requiring support or involvement from senior members of the product team
    • Effectively manage internal expectations for complex projects, products, and features while navigating challenging prioritization decisions
  • Drive Remote in the right direction by building an effective roadmap and strategy for your area of the product
    • Break down strategic plans into near and mid-term goals that's easy for others to understand
    • Align your product roadmap with higher level department and company problems we’re working to solve
    • Be the subject matter expert for your product area
    • Contribute to scaling and growth plans for your product area
  • Ship improvements quickly and iteratively, challenging yourself and counterparts to find minimal solutions to problems
    • Support and leads a product team delivering high throughput and high return on investment
    • Understand key business KPIs and align your team's work and metrics to directly improve to these
    • Work together with engineers, designers and stakeholders to build solutions to important complex problems
  • Communicate and collaborate internally and externally
    • Contribute to the Product org by sharing your techniques, processes, and learnings
    • Communicate and promote the work of your team and why it matters to customers and internal teams
    • Work asynchronously and transparently
    • Lead on solutions with minimal support or involvement from senior members of the product team. You should be able to work autonomously on simple features and iterations, only needing support to solve complex problems
    • Contribute to tactical and strategic decision-making for your business area
    • Develop into a subject matter expert for understanding, articulating, and solving complex business problems related to our mobile experiences

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Group Product Manager
  • Location: For this position we welcome everyone to apply
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

  1. AI interview
  2. Interview with recruiter
  3. Interview with hiring manager
  4. Live brainstorming session
  5. Team Interview
  6. Bar raiser interview
  7. Executive interview
  8. Offer + Prior employment verification check

#LI-DNP

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is
$50,000—$126,000 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at . As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • budget towards co-working spaces, learning and wellness (including gym memberships)
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • home office budget & IT equipment

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at .

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

description:
As a Software Engineering Intern, you will work side-by-side with your mentor and teammates to build software for Optiver’s real-time trading environment. You will work on projects that further develop and optimize our systems, testing and shipping code with guidance from experienced engineers and seeing how your work performs in production. In our business, where markets are always evolving, each day brings new engineering problems shaped by live conditions, performance requirements and system reliability.

Optiver is building with cutting edge AI technology in the most competitive, data rich landscapes in the world: financial markets. That means no two days are the same, and every day brings new, exciting technical challenges to solve.

What you’ll do

During the ten-week internship, you will be mentored by Optiver engineers and work on projects that improve the systems, tools and infrastructure behind our trading decisions. You will:

  • Build a strong foundation in trading fundamentals, from theoretical concepts and financial markets to strategies and the technology that supports them
  • Work closely with senior engineers and traders to design, develop, test, and ship your code to production
  • Tackle complex, real-world problems to enhance your critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Learn how engineers collaborate with traders and researchers to understand requirements, respond to feedback and improve systems quickly

Based on your performance during the internship, you could receive an offer to join our firm full-time after your studies, in either our London or Amsterdam office.

What you’ll get

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

  • A highly competitive internship compensation package

  • Optiver-covered flights and accommodation in the city centre for the duration of the internship

  • Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, bi-weekly massages, Friday afternoon drinks, a bicycle to explore Amsterdam and much more

  • The opportunity to participate in sports and leisure activities, along with social events exclusively organised for your intern cohort

Who you are

  • Penultimate-year student in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent, with the ability to work full time upon graduation in 2028

  • Passionate for clean code, simple, well-architected systems and continuous improvement

  • Proficient in industry-standard coding languages such as C++, Python, or Java, with a strong understanding of underlying computer architecture and system operations

  • Have an entrepreneurial attitude and an interest in the financial industry

  • An analytical mindset and strong problem-solving skills

  • Able to work closely with other engineers, traders and business operations

title: RN Pulmonary & Critical Care  | 4 Day Week
description:
Hours

4-day work week; no weekends or major holidays!

Summary

Join the dedicated team at Concord Hospital Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine as a Registered Nurse, where you'll play a key role in helping patients breathe easier, sleep better, and live more comfortably. In this dynamic specialty setting, you’ll provide comprehensive care—including assessment, treatment, planning, and evaluation—while mentoring fellow nurses and supporting patients with respiratory and critical care needs. Reporting to the Practice Manager and working under the direction of practice providers, you’ll apply your knowledge across the lifespan to deliver age-appropriate care, build meaningful relationships with patients and families, and collaborate with a skilled healthcare team to improve outcomes and quality of life for those facing complex pulmonary conditions.

Education

Minimum requirements: Associate Degree or Diploma in Nursing from an accredited School of Nursing; BSN preferred.

Certification, Registration & Licensure

Licensure required: New Hampshire Board of Nursing license

Certification required: Current American Heart Association Basic Life Support for Healthcare Providers certification or Red Cross CPR/AED for Professional Rescuers and Health Care Providers.

Other professional certification as needed specific to the expectations of the position.

Experience

Minimum of two years’ prior clinical nursing experience required; medical practice/office experience preferred. Demonstrated ability to effectively and positively interact with a multi-disciplinary team, patients and others.

    providing feedback to delegate and manager.

  • Applies principles of purposeful, organized thinking based on the nursing process to make sound clinical

    judgment and decisions.

  • Completes practice specific clinical skill competencies on an annual basis.

title: Investor Relations
description:
Emergent builds autonomous coding agents that replace traditional software development by generating, testing, and deploying production applications directly from plain-language intent. Our systems run in production at global scale and are used to build millions of real applications.

Since our public launch, we've crossed $100M in ARR and grown to over 10M users across 190+ countries, who have built 12M+ applications on Emergent. We're backed by Creaegis, Claypond, Sentinel Global, Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Google, Lightspeed, Prosus, Together, and Y Combinator.

We're solving the hard part of AI-driven software creation: correctness, reliability, security, and scale in real production systems. The team is built by repeat founders, Olympiad medalists, IIT & IIM alumni, and leaders from Google, Amazon, and Dropbox.

We're hiring builders who want ownership, speed, and impact at global scale.

The Role:

We’re looking for someone to join our Investor Relations function and work closely with our founders, finance team, and investors. You’ll help manage investor communication and engagement, prepare high-quality investor and board materials, support fundraising processes, and ensure our investors have a clear and consistent view of Emergent’s business and growth. This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong communication, financial understanding, attention to detail, and the ability to work directly with senior leadership. You’ll be involved across the investor lifecycle from preparing investor updates and coordinating meetings to supporting fundraising, diligence, and ongoing investor engagement.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage communication and engagement with existing and prospective investors.
  • Prepare investor updates, board decks, quarterly reports, and other investor-facing materials.
  • Work with founders and leadership to gather business updates and translate them into clear investor communication.
  • Coordinate investor meetings, calls, follow-ups, and ongoing communication.
  • Support fundraising processes, including investor research, pitch materials, data rooms, and diligence.
  • Track and report key business, financial, and operating metrics.
  • Maintain investor CRM, communication records, and relevant investor documentation.
  • Help coordinate cap table and investor-related information.
  • Respond to investor requests and coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate responses.
  • Conduct ad-hoc business analysis and market research to support investor conversations.
  • Help ensure all investor-facing information is accurate, consistent, timely, and high quality.

What We're Looking For:

  • 7-10 years of experience in investor relations or a similar role.
  • Strong financial and business acumen.
  • Ability to understand complex information and communicate it clearly and concisely.
  • Comfortable working directly with founders, investors, and senior leadership.
  • Experience preparing board materials, investor updates, presentations, or financial analyses.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • High ownership and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • High ownership mindset with a bias for action

Nice to Have:

  • Experience at a high-growth, venture-backed startup.
  • Exposure to fundraising processes from Seed to Series C+.
  • Background in investment banking, consulting, VC, or corporate strategy.
  • Familiarity with SaaS, AI, or technology businesses.
  • Understanding of startup metrics such as ARR, growth, retention, CAC, LTV, and unit economics.

Benefits and Perks:

  1. Daily Meals: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner provided
  2. Family Insurance: 3 Lakhs worth of coverage for you and your family
  3. Unlimited Paid Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge and come back refreshed
  4. Flexible Working Hours: Work arrangements that fit your life and commitments

Let's build the future of software together.

title: Research Specialist - Action Research
description:
The International Water Management Institute (IWMI), a CGIAR Research Center, is seeking a research professional specialized in Action Research to join its office in Anand, India, as a Research Specialist – Action Research.

The Research Specialist will primarily contribute to the ongoing initiative, Indo-German Cooperation on Agrivoltaics (IGCA). IGCA aims to accelerate and mainstream the adoption of agrivoltaics in India, generating benefits for the rural population without compromising food security. The role also contributes to relevant IWMI-India projects and partnerships including those with ICAR, Tata Trusts and other collaborators.

The Research Specialist is responsible for planning, designing, overseeing, and monitoring action research activities, including protocol development, scientific process documentation, data collection, analysis, and interpretation to achieve research goals and objectives in agrivoltaics and action research. The role engages with stakeholders, assigns and mentors support staff, organizes capacity development sessions, and produces knowledge products to enhance collaboration, outreach, and stakeholder expertise. The Research Specialist ensures timely recording and analysis of data, maintains optimal data pipelines, and develops comprehensive reports and provides inputs to publications to disseminate findings and support evidence-based decision-making.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Main Purpose of Job:

  • Plan, design, oversee, and monitor research activities, including developing field action sites, protocols, data collection, analysis, and interpretation, based on a defined research plan to achieve project objectives and development outcomes.
  • Gather and synthesize information and literature to design studies, experiments, surveys, related to action research ensuring alignment with the research outline provided.
  • Design and implement monitoring system to assess the performance and impacts of agrivoltaics and action research projects.
  • Collaborate, engage, communicate and coordinate with stakeholders on research activities to ensure project objectives and milestones are met including organizing meetings, dialogues, field visits and workshops.
  • Design, conduct, and supervise the implementation of surveys or experiments related to action research , ensuring adherence to research protocols and objectives.
  • The researcher will also take lead in scientific process documentation, data monitoring, field assessment and all other aspects related to action research sites where IWMI is involved as a partner, co-implementer, consultant or advisor.

Main engagement, collaboration and communication responsibilities:

  • Identify and assign appropriate support for research activities, providing clear task responsibilities, technical information, and logistical guidance to ensure smooth implementation of experiments or studies.
  • Provide input to performance appraisals of team members, providing constructive feedback and identifying opportunities for professional development to enhance team performance.
  • Engage with colleagues, implementation partners, consultants, farmers and other stakeholders exchange conceptual ideas and effectively gather feedback and research-related requirements for the research's advancement or to align the execution of research.
  • Align and synchronize project activities with stakeholders to ensure consistency and mutual reinforcement of efforts.
  • Develop training materials and organize tailored capacity development sessions to build expertise in area of work.
  • Design and produce knowledge products, informational resources, and communication materials for to amplify the impact and outreach of project and organizational work.
  • Identify and communicate key information to policymakers and non-scientific audiences to promote knowledge transfer and evidence-based decision-making.

Main responsibilities in the delivery of timely and quality services:

  • Lead the synthesis and analysis of data to support the development of publications and presentations.
  • Develop reports, and presentations, including summarizing research findings, preparing manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals, and creating posters and papers for dissemination.
  • Prepare and deliver detailed project reports and supporting documentation for developer-led and farmer-led agrivoltaics projects in line with agreed timelines and quality standards.

Requirements

Education, Certifications & Training:

  • Master’s Degree in economics, rural management, agriculture, renewable energy, natural resource management or in a closely related discipline; or bachelor’s degree with extensive relevant experience.

Experience:

  • Experience in planning, implementing and overseeing research tasks.
  • Experience in data gathering and management.
  • Exposure to research quality assurance of research processes.
  • Experience in collaborating with partners on the implementation of research activities.
  • Experience working in or with an international not-for-profit organization is an advantage.
  • Experience in water and energy related action-research or field action.

Language Proficiency:

  • Fluency in English is essential to communicate in writing and speaking.
  • Working knowledge of a second language, preferably Gujarati, Marathi or is desirable.

Functional and Technical competencies:

  • Analytical, Critical and Systems Thinking: Analyzes information from multiple sources to identify trends, draw conclusions, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Scientific Ethics and Integrity: Adheres to ethical guidelines in data collection, analysis, and reporting, discloses potential conflicts of interest, and ensures compliance with open data principles to ensure transparency and accessibility.
  • Data Analysis, Management and Visualization: Verifies data accuracy and consistency, addresses simple errors, summarizes and organizes data, and interprets basic trends using available systems and evolving data methodologies to support decisions or activities.
  • Planning and Organizing: Plans and manages multiple priorities and deadlines independently, using time management tools to stay on track, and effectively balances competing tasks while adjusting as needed.
  • Problem Solving: Analyzes information to identify root causes, collaborates with colleagues to gather information, and prioritizes critical factors to propose effective solutions.
  • Water Systems Knowledge: Demonstrates comprehensive understanding of Central Asian water management systems, including irrigated agriculture, transboundary river basins, basin organizations, hydrometeorological services, and water-energy interactions in river basins.
  • Development Contextual Analysis: Analyzes development challenges in India to understand underlying issues, applies knowledge of the water-energy-climate nexus, groundwater governance, agrarian livelihoods, and security, and prioritizes relevant contextual factors to inform effective research and project solutions.
  • Field-Based Research: Conducts field-based and action research to gather relevant evidence, collaborates with communities, partners, and stakeholders to collect and validate information, and translates field insights into practical research outputs and recommendations.

Benefits

This is a nationally recruited position and only Indian nationals will be considered. IWMI offers a competitive salary and benefits package, inclusive of health insurance, life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, and long-term disability coverage. The duration of the contract will initially be for a period Two (02) years, with the possibility of extension.

HOW TO APPLY: Apply for the position by following the application instructions at . We will be accepting applications through 24:00 (IST) on August 30, 2026 (applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis). Your application must include a CV, cover letter, portfolio links and three (3) references, which may be contacted if you are shortlisted. Receipt of all applications will be acknowledged, but only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

title: Cyber Security Trainee
description:
Cyber Security Placement Programme - No Experience Required Are you looking to benefit from a new career in IT and Cybersecurity? Skills shortages in the IT sector are driving the need for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

We help place graduates from this programme in top UK companies and organisations needing to employ entry-level IT and Cybersecurity staff that can hit the ground running with up-to-date skills gained from this programme.

The best part is you will not need any previous experience as fully accredited training, which includes tutor support and mentoring, provides you with the skills, practical knowledge and qualifications for you to secure a professional job and career in IT. You will also have the reassurance of a job guarantee (30K-£38K) upon completion.

Whether you are working full time, part time or are unemployed, this package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks or a few months (step 1 to 4 below). Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps.

Step 1 - Accredited Online Training

The first step is completing a selection of professional, accredited and industry recognised courses from CompTIA which is the global leader in IT Technician, Networking and Cybersecurity training. The training is delivered via multimedia rich video tutorials, practice labs, presentations and quizzes through a portal that you study from home. You will also be assigned an expert tutor and a support mentor to help you throughout your training.

Step 2 - Practical Training

You will gain practical experience by using practice labs which enable you to practice and master what you have learned. Gaining practical hands-on experience gives you confidence to be proficient in your first IT role. This combination of theoretical and practical skills is what line managers need you to have to be effective and confident in your role.

Step 3 - Official exams

You will then go on to sit the CompTIA A+ and the CompTIA Network+ exams to give you the official certifications which will be recognised not only in the UK, but worldwide. The CompTIA A+ is the most asked for certificate for entry-level IT roles

and the certification most IT Managers start their own careers with. All PCs in a professional environment are networked to servers, cloud based or otherwise and the Network+ gives you a needed foundation level of knowledge in networking.

Step 4 - IT Technician placement (£30-£35K)

We work with you to secure your first role as an IT Technician, with a starting salary of anywhere between £30K-38K. Ideally you will need to gain two years’ experience in this role before you can progress into a cyber security role. While working as an IT Technician, we will release your second batch of training which is specifically designed to qualify you to move into the cybersecurity field. This official, accredited training consists of online training, practical training and an official exam (CompTIA Security+). Further we can tailor the package to include courses like the Certified Ethical Hacker and Certified Network Defender depending on your requirements and future direction.

Cybersecurity Role

Once you have completed all the mandatory training in step four and have gained two plus years experience in the IT industry, you will be ready to move into higher paying Cybersecurity roles. Our recruitment support team specialises in the IT and Cybersecurity space and roles at this level have an average starting salary of £35K.

We have been helping career changers and new career seekers gain new careers since 2009 and we are a CompTIA Gold Partner, accredited by the BCS (Chartered Institute of IT/ British Computer Society) and the EC-Council to ensure we provide the highest levels of training.

In addition, we are also ELCAS approved to help members of the Armed Forces, Service Leavers and Veterans gain rewarding careers in IT and Cybersecurity.

Job Guarantee

Due to the success of this programme and the skills shortage of entry-level IT staff, we can guarantee you will secure a job upon completion of your study programme or we will refund you 100% of your course fees back. This is subject to our terms of learning/ terms of business.

Passionate about starting a career in IT? Apply now and one of our friendly advisors will be in touch.

description:
Vi söker nu en beredare till vårt team inom order och logistik i Karlsborg. Hos oss blir du en viktig länk mellan order och logistik, utveckling, produktion och kontrakt. Du blir en del av ett nära team där vi hjälper varandra, arbetar tvärfunktionellt och tillsammans driver förbättringar. Här får du en varierad roll med möjlighet att påverka och utveckla både arbetssätt och processer.

Din vardag

Som beredare ansvarar du för att ta fram produktionsunderlag, beräkna produktionskostnader och säkerställa att rätt information finns tillgänglig för produktionen. Du arbetar i Microsoft Dynamics 365, där du bland annat lägger upp nya artiklar, reviderar befintliga och skapar operationer, BOM och strukturer på produkter.

Du har många kontaktytor inom verksamheten och samarbetar bland annat med planering, kontrakt, inköp, processtöd, förråd, produktion och utveckling. Du kommer även att:

  • Ansvara för produktionsberedning och förse produktionen med orderunderlag

  • Underhålla artikel-, operations- och strukturregister i D365

  • Beräkna STD cost och tillverkningskostnader

  • Medverka vid förfrågnings- och ordergenomgångar

  • Begära in information från olika avdelningar för att ta fram beredningsunderlag

  • Upprätta och underhålla rutiner och processer inom beredning

  • Delta i projekt och förbättringsarbeten

Rollen är administrativ och analytisk, men samtidigt nära produktionen. Du får möjlighet att vara med och utveckla hur vi arbetar med beredning och bidra till effektiva och kvalitetssäkrade processer.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av beredning inom producerande verksamhet och som trivs i en roll där struktur, noggrannhet och samarbete är viktigt. Du är van att hantera flera uppgifter parallellt, tar eget ansvar och driver ditt arbete framåt.

Du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom teknik, logistik, supply chain eller motsvarande, alternativt relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som bedöms likvärdig. Du har god systemvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i affärssystem. Erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics 365 är meriterande.

För att lyckas i rollen har du förståelse för produktionsresurser, arbetstempon och produktionsprocesser. Du har god analytisk förmåga och är kommunikativ med lätt för att samarbeta med olika funktioner och personer i verksamheten. Som person är du flexibel, engagerad och lösningsorienterad.

Du behärskar svenska och engelska väl i både tal och skrift.

Vill du veta mer?

Känner du att ovanstående låter intressant och passar väl in med dina erfarenheter och ambitioner? Då är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig. I den här rekryteringen samarbetar Nammo med Nexer Recruit. Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Fredrik Karlström via e-post: fredrik.karlstrom@nexergroup.com eller telefon +46703020273. Vi arbetar med löpande urval så skicka gärna in din ansökan så fort som möjligt, dock senast 2026-08-30.

Om Nammo

Nammo-koncernen har ca 3.800 anställda och finns representerade i 11 länder världen över. Verksamheten omfattar utveckling, produktion och försäljning av högteknologiska försvarsprodukter samt miljövänlig demilitarisering. Nammo Sweden AB finns på fyra orter i Sverige och har ca 700 anställda. Nammo är ett värderingsstyrt företag och våra värderingar Engagemang, Precision och Omtanke genomsyrar hela vår verksamhet.

title: Product Lead (Trading Platform)
description:
Product Lead (Trading Domain)

We're building a trading product from the ground up and looking for a Product Lead who is both an active trader and an experienced product manager.

This isn't a role where one side is a nice-to-have. You'll be making product decisions that require real market intuition — understanding how traders think, what they actually need at execution speed, what separates a tool they trust from one they abandon, who the players in the market are, such as prop firms, brokers, data providers, what a CME license is, etc. Product management skills alone won't get you there. Trading experience alone won't either.

At TradeFill in partnership with Railsware Product Studio, we build products that people love. You may know Railsware from building TradeZella, Calendly, ParentSquare, Mailtrap.io, Coupler.io, or TitanApps.io — tools that quietly serve millions of people. We bring the same craft and conviction to everything we build.

This particular role is part of a small, founder-led team building in the trading space. You'd be joining:

  • Yaroslav Lazor — product & engineering (CEO and founder of Railsware, previously helped scale Calendly)
  • Umar Ashraf — product, markets & distribution (founder of Tradezella, with 4M+ subscriber YouTube trading channel)

It's a tight team. Your decisions carry real weight. If that kind of ownership drives you, we'd love to hear from you!

What you’ll get?

  • The ability to build and launch a product from scratch, fully managing the process at a stable company with extensive experience developing successful products
  • Full ownership — from idea to shipped product, you run the loop
  • Product-market proximity — you'll use the product yourself as a trader
  • Collaborating with top market brands in the trading world – prop firms, brokers
  • True AI-first environment with a stellar engineering team — we use AI as a core part of how we plan, research, design, and build, yet in tight collaboration with true engineering talent
  • Outcome-driven culture — we combine synchronous collaboration with focused asynchronous work, choosing the approach that best supports effective outcomes

What You Will Do

Product Strategy
  • Contribute to and own the end-to-end product vision
  • Communicate that vision clearly to stakeholders and cross-functional teams
  • Transform strategy into a prioritized product roadmap
  • Prepare a billing model aligned with revenue and profitability goals
Product Prototyping and Discovery
  • Lead product ideation and prototyping - channeling that into discovery sessions
  • Conduct customer development activities — including direct calls with traders and potential users
  • Run market research and competitive analysis
Product Development
  • Define and scope features for development
  • Lead the development process using Agile methodology
  • Carry out proactive risk management and troubleshooting
UI/UX
  • AI-driven prototypes, mockups, wireframes
  • Collaborate with a product designer to implement current UI/UX best practices
  • Improve product UX to drive conversion and retention
Product Analytics
  • Constantly monitor and improve product success metrics such as MRR, CAC, LTV, Churn, NPS, etc
  • Conduct ad-hoc analysis of the web and product metrics using data from the product database to validate decisions
  • Make data-driven decisions alongside the data analytics team

What we’re looking for

Product Management

  • 5+ years in Product Management
  • Hands-on experience shipping SaaS products — B2C (end-user focus) and B2B (understanding sales workflows and processes)
  • Demonstrated ability to own and communicate end-to-end product vision
  • Experience with PDM frameworks, product analytics, and product design tools
  • Experience running customer development and market research independently
  • Experience delivering software products in the US and/or EU markets

Trading experience

  • Active trading experience in any market — futures, stocks, crypto, forex, or similar
  • Day trading, scalping, and/or swing trading experience

Technical Background & Tools

  • Technical background — you understand high-level architecture, can work directly with engineers, and don't need others to interpret technical constraints
  • AI fluency: you use AI actively across research, prototyping, analysis, and decision-making
  • Comfortable working with data independently: SQL or equivalent ability to run ad-hoc product analysis without always needing a data analyst
  • Proficiency with design and prototyping tools
  • General software literacy: comfortable navigating technical tools, dashboards, and developer workflows

Ways of Working

  • High autonomy — you set direction, make decisions independently, and drive work forward without needing to be managed
  • Strong decision-making: you move fast on imperfect information, commit, and course-correct based on data
  • Structured thinker: able to manage multiple workstreams, set priorities, and maintain clarity across contexts
  • Data-driven: you form hypotheses, find the data, and update your views
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English

Would Be a Plus

  • Experience in product at a broker, trading platform, or fintech
  • Experience defining and executing go-to-market strategy
  • Engineering background
  • Public speaking or content creation

The position

  • Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, including across different departments (e.g. business operations, sales, etc.) to ensure that we’re satisfying critical business requirements
  • Proficient in English, both written and spoken.
  • Bonus: Experience working in a remote environment.

Key responsibilities

  • Build solutions together with the rest of the team
    • Own not just software implementation, but the end-to-end experience: Remote delivers value through services powered by both humans and software
    • Lead on complex solutions without requiring support or involvement from senior members of the product team
    • Effectively manage internal expectations for complex projects, products, and features while navigating challenging prioritization decisions
  • Drive Remote in the right direction by building an effective roadmap and strategy for your area of the product
    • Break down strategic plans into near and mid-term goals that's easy for others to understand
    • Align your product roadmap with higher level department and company problems we’re working to solve
    • Be the subject matter expert for your product area
    • Contribute to scaling and growth plans for your product area
  • Ship improvements quickly and iteratively, challenging yourself and counterparts to find minimal solutions to problems
    • Support and leads a product team delivering high throughput and high return on investment
    • Understand key business KPIs and align your team's work and metrics to directly improve to these
    • Work together with engineers, designers and stakeholders to build solutions to important complex problems
  • Communicate and collaborate internally and externally
    • Contribute to the Product org by sharing your techniques, processes, and learnings
    • Communicate and promote the work of your team and why it matters to customers and internal teams
    • Work asynchronously and transparently
    • Lead on solutions with minimal support or involvement from senior members of the product team. You should be able to work autonomously on simple features and iterations, only needing support to solve complex problems
    • Contribute to tactical and strategic decision-making for your business area
    • Develop into a subject matter expert for understanding, articulating, and solving complex business problems related to our mobile experiences

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Group Product Manager
  • Location: For this position we welcome everyone to apply
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

  1. AI interview
  2. Interview with recruiter
  3. Interview with hiring manager
  4. Live brainstorming session
  5. Team Interview
  6. Bar raiser interview
  7. Executive interview
  8. Offer + Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

$50,000—$126,000 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at . As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:

  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • learning budget
  • home office budget & IT equipment
  • budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at .

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. title: Landscape AI & Computational Design Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced Landscape AI & Computational Design Specialist to lead the integration of artificial intelligence, data analytics and computational design across landscape architecture, master planning and public realm projects.
This role will drive innovation by applying AI, parametric design, GIS and automation tools to improve design quality, delivery efficiency and data-driven decision-making throughout project lifecycles.
The successful candidate will work closely with landscape architects, urban designers, planners, BIM specialists and digital delivery teams to develop scalable workflows, practical tools and innovative design solutions that can be adopted across the studio.

  • Develop and implement AI solutions tailored to landscape architecture, master planning and public realm design.

  • Create computational design workflows using tools such as Grasshopper, Rhino, Dynamo, Python and generative design platforms.

  • Support data-driven design decisions through GIS, spatial analytics, environmental modelling and predictive analysis.

  • Develop AI-assisted tools for planting design, public realm planning, walkability studies, mobility analysis and environmental performance assessments.

  • Automate repetitive design, documentation, QA/QC and reporting tasks to improve consistency and delivery efficiency.

  • Lead the development of landscape-specific AI agents, scripts and digital workflows that support project teams.

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Landscape, Urban Design, Master Planning, BIM and Digital Engineering.

  • Investigate emerging technologies and assess opportunities for practical implementation across the studio.

  • Establish best-practice guidance, standards and training materials for computational design and AI adoption.

  • Support bids, competitions and innovation initiatives through advanced visualization, data analytics and scenario modelling.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Landscape Architecture, Urban Design, Architecture, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.

  • Experience applying AI, computational design or advanced digital workflows within the built environment sector.

  • Strong working knowledge of Rhino, Grasshopper, Python, GIS platforms such as ArcGIS or QGIS, Dynamo and visual programming workflows.

  • Understanding of generative AI, machine learning, automation, digital twins and responsible AI principles.

  • Experience developing design automation tools, computational scripts or repeatable digital workflows.

  • Ability to translate complex landscape and urban design challenges into scalable digital solutions.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to design and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience working within multidisciplinary design consultancies or project delivery environments.

    Preferred Experience

  • Landscape architecture, public realm or master planning project experience.

  • Knowledge of environmental modelling, climate resilience, biodiversity analytics and sustainable design frameworks.

  • Experience with Power BI, AI copilots, large language models and design automation platforms.

title: Renewable and Combustion Turbine Tech  - Elk Mound, EITrainee
description:
Are you ready to join an organization where we focus on People First, have fun at work and make a difference in what we do?


Dairyland is proud of our People First culture centered around appreciation, celebrating wins and collaboration. We’ve worked hard to ensure alignment between our culture and our processes and systems, learning and development and rewards and recognition programs.

As a team, we work together to leverage the team’s diverse perspectives, ideas and experiences to deliver nothing less than the best. We are collaborative, transparent and committed to our People and their work experience, growth and professional development.

PURPOSE:

Provide operating, maintenance, and monitoring services for Dairyland's remotely located hydro and combustion turbine generators (if applicable), including auxiliary equipment.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

This list is developed to demonstrate the level of duties normally performed by this classification and to develop a related wage rate. This classification will need to learn and qualify to be proficient in all these duties so that the person will become a Technician in two years or less. The list is not an all-encompassing list of duties.

- Operate and monitor combustion turbines, and hydro turbines generators (if applicable), including auxiliary equipment.

- Assist in writing and updating department job, operating, maintenance, safety and site emergency procedures.

- Provide feedback to the department manager on department activities, training requirements, and other issues of concern.

- Facilitate and support other DPC department activities. Ensure all involved are kept informed on issues of their concerns.

- Comply with all state and federal reporting and permit requirements.

- Support and enhance where possible the plant preventative/predictive maintenance effort, with ideas and suggestions for improved maintenance practice or operating procedure.

- Recommend and implement modifications that will enhance plant efficiency, reliability, or safety.

- Monitor, compile and complete daily activity and monthly reports including safety, environmental, performance and generation.

- Ensure all department maintenance manuals, operating manuals, equipment files, and drawings are maintained and updated.

- Authorize parts and material withdrawal from stock for daily and long-term work assignments.

- Coordinate site activities with purchasing and stores ensuring proper stocking and ordering of necessary parts and equipment.

- Purchase parts and materials locally with credit card and reconcile charges at the end of the month.

- Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain all generation equipment, including: Controls, electronics, electrical, mechanical, pollution, and safety equipment.

- Lead and assist contractor work for maintenance and capital improvement work.

- Communicates extensively with System Dispatch concerning operating capabilities and requirements.

- Train other workers in operation, maintenance and safety of site equipment.

- Develop, maintain and qualify other employees on qualification cards.

- Operate electrical equipment for substation, generators, and site auxiliaries.

- Safely work on energized equipment when necessary.

- Schedule all daily and weekly department activities, as a backup to the Foreperson.

- Perform lockout, tagout and switching safety duties. Provide facility tours as needed.

Works primarily at assigned cost center locations and will occasionally be temporarily transferred to other locations in conjunction with contractual provisions. Perform all other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Education & Experience:

(Internal) Prefer Associate Degree in directly related field (such as electrical, mechanical, instrumentation or applicable power plant operations). Prefer experience in hydro, and/or combustion turbine stations.

(External) Associate Degree in directly related field (such as electrical, mechanical, instrumentation or applicable power plant operations) required. Prefer experience in hydro, and/or combustion turbine stations.

*Specific requirements (e.g. Instrument, Electrical or Mechanical experience, etc.) will be based upon total composition of team skills required to operate and maintain generation units as identified in posting.

Skills:

Demonstrated ability to use software similar to DPC’s including CMMS, e-mail, word processing and spreadsheet programs. Ability to interpret and use equipment drawings, design specifications, system descriptions, control instrumentation, safety procedures, and emergency response procedures. Ability to troubleshoot and problem solve independently and with others. Ability to work with metric tools, equipment, and drawings.

Physical Demands:

Position requires variable work hours and schedules established by operational needs. Sitting, standing, kneeling, crouching, crawling, twisting upper body, walking, bending, reaching, stretching, writing, hearing, speaking, seeing, fingering, gasping, climbing (including stairs, ladders, and use of mechanical lifting devices). Entry into confined spaces required. Occasionally working in areas of extreme noise with hearing protection. Pushing, pulling, lifting up to 50 pounds) and ability to wear protective equipment such as safety glasses, respirators, SCBA, etc. Requires use of personal/laptop computer, electronic control equipment, and general office equipment.

Other Job Characteristics:

Reside within an approximate 30-minute radius of the designated site (15-minute radius for Flambeau). Cellular telephone, or other telecommunications devices will be made available for response to operating needs. Works independently (often alone) and with others in a team environment. Requires periodic offsite maintenance/operations training. Position currently anticipated to require ability to adapt to schedule changes with starting times established by operational needs. Requires overtime response to unscheduled unit runs and problems.

NOTE: FLAMBEAU – The selected candidate must be able to access turbine entrance through 23 ¼ inch, 4 feet long pipe with rung steps.

Dairyland Benefits:

We are committed to providing our greatest asset, our People, with as many perks and benefits as possible. Some benefits of working with us include:

- Health & disability benefits (medical, dental, vision, short & long-term disability)
- Life insurance
- Generous 401(k) and Pension Plans
- Paid Time Off

- New Flexible Work Program
- Tuition Reimbursement
- So much more!

title: Senior Product Manager -  Platform Integrations
description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

The Role

Make every Payoneer capability accessible programmatically — through self-serve APIs and AI-native MCP interfaces — so customers and their AI agents can work with Payoneer wherever they operate, without opening the app.

This is a new, high-ownership area with no prior product owner — strategy, vision, and roadmap are yours to define. Payoneer already exposes hundreds of APIs, but only a fraction of customers can reach them and onboarding still takes weeks, capping adoption and the retention upside of integrated customers. As Senior Product Manager, Platform Integrations, you’ll own the strategy to close that gap, turn API access into a growth and retention lever, and take our MCP / AI-native layer from proof-of-concept to production. You’ll work across Product, R&D, Risk, Security, Legal, and GTM, and report into the Platform Product leadership team.

What you’ll do

  • Take the MCP to production. Take Payoneer’s MCP work from proof-of-concept to production – exposing capabilities such as balance, transactions, payouts, and FX as tools that AI agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude) can call. Partner with Account Security and Core Foundations on auth, governance, and a secure read-first rollout.
  • Turn API access into a growth lever. Payoneer exposes hundreds of APIs, but only a fraction of customers can reach them and onboarding still takes weeks — capping adoption and the retention upside of integrated customers. Own the strategy to close that gap end-to-end, with self-serve onboarding, developer experience, and API governance as the execution threads.
  • Turn demand into a roadmap. Synthesize signals from CSM, Sales, and regional GTM teams (EMEA, LATAM, APAC) into a prioritized, evidence-backed roadmap, and prove the business case – including the retention impact of API-integrated customers.
  • Lead cross-functionally. Coordinate Risk (eligibility), Security (MCP/API risk model), Legal (data sharing and LLM integrations), Pricing, and Engineering to unblock launches and land outcomes, not just features.

Who you are

  • 6+ years in product management, including significant experience owning API, platform, developer-facing, or integration products.
  • Strong technical fluency: comfortable discussing REST APIs, webhooks/events, authentication (OAuth), SDKs, and integration architecture directly with engineers.
  • Proven ability to take an ambiguous, unowned area and create clarity – strategy, roadmap, and shipped product – with a high degree of independence.
  • Track record of building self-serve or developer experiences, and of driving measurable adoption and time-to-value improvements.
  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you align Risk, Security, Legal, GTM, and Engineering around shared outcomes and keep them moving.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; you frame decisions with data and are comfortable defining metrics where none exist.
  • Fluent English, written and verbal. Based in India with the ability to work in a hybrid model and collaborate across global time zones.

What could set you apart

  • Hands-on exposure to AI-native interfaces – Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent tooling, or LLM integrations – and a point of view on where agent-driven finance is heading.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated environment, and fluency working within compliance, risk, and security constraints.
  • Familiarity with API aggregators and ERP/accounting ecosystems (e.g. Codat, Rutter, Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite).
  • Experience productizing an existing internal API surface – governance, standardization, and developer adoption at scale.
  • A builder’s bias: you’ve turned a first customer or first use case into a repeatable, scalable product.

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
