title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Coursera

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, creating one of the world's most comprehensive skills development platforms for the AI era. This strengthens our ability to accelerate AI-powered innovation and shape how the world discovers and builds skills at a pivotal moment of change. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Coursera was launched in 2012 by Andrew Ng and Daphne Koller with a mission to provide universal access to worldclass learning. Coursera partners with leading university and industry partners to offer a broad catalog of content and credentials, including courses, Specializations, Professional Certificates, and degrees. Coursera’s platform innovations — including AI-powered personalized guide and features, like Role Play and Course Builder, and role-based solutions like Skills Tracks — enable instructors, partners, and companies to deliver scalable, personalized, and verified learning. Institutions worldwide rely on Coursera to upskill and reskill their employees, students, and citizens in high-demand fields such as GenAI, data science, technology, and business, while learners globally turn to Coursera to master the skills they need to advance their careers. Coursera is a Delaware public benefit corporation and a B Corp. Coursera recently combined with Udemy to create one of the world’s most comprehensive skills development platforms.

Why Join Us

At Coursera, we’re looking for inventors, innovators, and lifelong learners ready to shape the future of education. You’ll help build global programs and tools that power online learning for millions turning bold ideas into real impact. People who thrive here are customer-first builders who move fast, simplify ruthlessly, and iterate relentlessly on the metrics that matter.

We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to do their best work together. Our virtual hiring and onboarding experience makes it easy to join us and start making an impact from anywhere. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

As a mission-driven company, we’re passionate about making a positive impact in learners’ lives by unlocking opportunity through learning. We’re looking for self-motivated, curious, and bold problem solvers — people who are driven by purpose, energized by complex challenges, and deeply committed to putting learners at the center of everything they do. If you’re excited to reimagine how education can better serve everyone, everywhere and want to build products that drive real-world impact, you’ll thrive here.

Senior Product Manager, Content Quality & Optimization

Trust is the catalog's real moat. As Coursera and Udemy scale content — more authors, more AI-generated and AI-assisted material, more enterprise buyers with reputational stakes — the credibility of what's in the catalog becomes the thing the business is actually selling. Customers reconsider renewals when content falls short. Partners disengage when they can't tell which of their courses need attention. Learners quietly abandon content that isn't working. This role owns Udemy and Coursera's answer: the systems that let authors and content teams find, fix, and prevent content issues, and the guardrails that keep the combined catalog credible as it grows.

The end-to-end quality loop.

The full path from issue discovery through remediation to measurement. Content teams and partners today struggle to see where quality problems are and which ones actually matter, so quality work gets treated as low-value housekeeping. You'll own turning that into a clear, prioritized view — surfacing the issues that matter most, with enough context to know why they're worth fixing, and then measuring whether the fix worked.

Detection intelligence & tooling.

The AI-driven detection and scoring that finds issues at catalog scale and ranks what's wrong, brought together into a single, trusted measure of content quality rather than a scatter of disconnected signals. You'll shape how quality is defined, measured, and made legible to the people who have to act on it.

Trust & abuse prevention across instructor-facing channels.

Sustainable guardrails, monitoring, and policy enforcement on the surfaces instructors control. The goal is to protect the catalog's credibility — keeping inappropriate, misleading, or plagiarized material out, and safeguarding the integrity of instructor identity and reputation — with enforcement that scales without penalizing the good actors who make up the vast majority.

Content governance.

A durable framework rather than one-off firefighting: clear content standards, a defined review and ownership model, and combined manual and automated enforcement for reputationally risky material across the catalog and promotional channels. The aim is to move quality and trust from reactive cleanup to a system that holds up on its own.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience building products in EdTech, learning technologies or content authoring tools
  • Experience with B2B2C business model
  • Experience building, using, or experimenting with AI-driven products, particularly in the areas of content generation and editing, adaptive learning and personalization, automated quality assurance, and multimodal authoring support such as AI for video, audio, and translation.

If this opportunity interests you, you might like these courses on Coursera:

  • Learning How To Learn
  • Gen AI for Product Managers
  • Data Analysis with Python

Salary is just one component of Coursera’s total rewards package. All regular employees are also eligible for a bonus program and equity in the form of RSU’s.

A number of factors are taken into account when determining pay, which includes: job level, location, training/education, business need, skill set and internal equity.

title: Engineer I - Field Service
description:
Brief Job Description:
The Service Engineer will be responsible for visiting customer sites to perform installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and breakdown maintenance of Precision Air Conditioners (PACs). The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in HVAC systems, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to effectively communicate with customers to resolve issues. The Service Engineer will also be responsible for attending breakdown calls, troubleshooting problems, and ensuring customer satisfaction, with a track record of receiving appreciation mail from customers.

Responsibilities
1.Visit customer sites to install, commission, and maintain Precision Air Conditioners (PACs)
2. Perform preventive maintenance tasks according to scheduled maintenance plans to ensure optimal performance of HVAC systems
3. Respond promptly to breakdown calls and efficiently troubleshoot technical issues to minimize downtime for customers
4. Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and provide effective solutions to meet their HVAC needs
5. Diagnose and resolve problems encountered by customers during PAC and Chiller operation, ensuring smooth functionality
6. Maintain accurate records of service activities, including installation, maintenance, and repairs, using appropriate documentation systems
7. Provide technical support and guidance to customers on HVAC system operation, maintenance procedures, and best practices
8. Collaborate with internal teams, including sales and engineering, to address customer inquiries and resolve issues in a timely manner
9. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement in service delivery and recommend solutions to enhance customer satisfaction.
10. Demonstrate professionalism and commitment to delivering high-quality service in all interactions with customers and colleagues
11. Uphold safety standards and protocols while performing onsite activities to ensure a safe working environment for all parties involved
12. Willingness to travel to customer sites, communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with customers and team members, good technical knowledge of HVAC systems, including components, controls, and troubleshooting techniques
Qualifications - Bachelors of Diploma or BTech in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC Engineering, or a related field.

title: Sr Project Manager- Power & Energy
description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Sr. Project Manager- Power & Energy for our Denver, CO office. We can also offer this position remotely from a mutually acceptable location within the United States and must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face-to-face meetings.

Provides situational administrative and technical project management guidance for the development, execution, management, and monitoring of designated projects within a specific geography or discipline in support of company, regional, and national business line goals. Ensures responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, planning and project startup, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds corporate project excellence and delivery standards. Provides innovation, administration, and pragmatic direction to address current and future project management challenges in a rapidly changing and complex business and operations climate.

Your Impact

  • Provide PM leadership for larger scale/more complex projects ensuring contributors know what they are required to do and by when, preparing and overseeing relevant project budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs, monitoring external events and risk contingencies, tracking hours and expenses, ensuring satisfactory performance, and managing the contractual obligations to deliver the project or assigned portfolio of assigned project(s) as defined in the contract.
  • Develop and foster effective strategies to engage project stakeholders at all levels, maintain effective relationships, and report on project progress.
  • Provide guidance with pursuit/initiation activities for projects meeting defined criteria or risk profile; including “Go / No-Go” decisions, contract reviews, risk mitigation strategies, pricing reviews, etc.
  • Participate in the technical aspects of contract negotiation, presentations, and meetings.
  • Actively drive the appropriate levels of technical review required for the project, selecting appropriately qualified staff to perform the required reviews, and adherence to the QA/QC plan, as applicable.
  • Provide verbal and/or written inputs to multi-disciplinary project teams and contribute to providing high level strategic advice to clients.
  • Mentor staff to support their growth and professional development.
  • Manage and provide performance guidance and leadership to assigned staff.
  • Ensure updates occur with system and process documentation including: Risk (REF/RMP), Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Quality Plan (QP), Project Safety (PSP), and Communications Plan where applicable.
  • Facilitate project kick-off meetings with key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with area/technical managers to address project resource and subcontracting requirements in a timely manner.
  • Maintain regular communications with the client including reporting on monthly status, safety incidents, and major issues together with scope and budget impacts.
  • Participate in and oversee problem project reviews, providing input about root cause issues and potential solutions. Assist with developing project recovery plans.
  • Ensure regular project reporting and updates are provided to clients, technical areas, and business unit managers, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget.
  • Monitor accounts receivable (AR) and unbilled revenue, working to address issues as needed.
  • Complete formal project closeout activities, along with facilitating and documenting a lessons-learned meeting with key project staff.
  • Remain current in the latest Project Management techniques and practices (PMAP).
  • Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related major, or equivalent experience in a technical or engineering firm.
  • Essential project management certification required (e.g., PMP, CAP-M).
  • 12+ years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within our industry.
  • Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process within the A/E/C industry and strong background and experience in project management.
  • Advanced proficiency with analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
  • Advanced proficiency with critical thinking and problem-solving skills to make assessments and calculations involving the application of project management principles, with a sound understanding of intent, impact, and optimal outcomes.
  • Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
  • Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
  • Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
  • Strong experience in managing the review and approval of documents and discipline-specific project deliverables, processes, and plans in a multi-project environment is highly desirable.
  • Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, subcontractors, consultants, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
  • Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet project-specific needs.
  • Up to 25 % travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Engineering

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

title: Excess Buyer
description:
Sourceability® is a global digital distributor of electronic components transforming how modern businesses bring products to market. With innovation, quality and logistics as the backbone of the company, Sourceability’s cutting-edge products and services expedite the procurement process across a wide range of industries, including communications/cellular, consumer electronics, and auto manufacturing.

We are looking for a commercially focused Excess Buyer to become a vital part of our APAC Excess team.

As an Excess Buyer, you will manage small to mid-sized excess accounts, qualify excess inventory lists, develop supplier relationships and convert opportunities into customer-backed purchases. This role is the core account ownership level within the Excess career path and is designed to prepare strong performers for future Senior Excess Buyer responsibilities.

Our goal is to build a sophisticated team equipped with strong technical awareness, commercial judgement and business acumen. Each team member adds value to the business, the customer and the wider supply chain.

Insight on your impact

  • Manage assigned small and mid-sized excess accounts and develop relationships opened by Junior Excess Buyers.
  • Review, qualify and prioritise excess, obsolete and unwanted component lists received from customers and suppliers.
  • Validate key list details such as MPN, manufacturer, quantity, date code, condition, packaging, target price and location.
  • Negotiate standard excess purchase opportunities within approved limits and escalate complex or high-value opportunities when needed.
  • Coordinate with Sales to identify matched customer demand, proactive offer opportunities and potential cost-save opportunities.
  • Support PO follow-up, supplier communication, delivery updates and issue resolution in coordination with relevant internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, supplier profiles, opportunity notes and account development plans.
  • Coach Junior Excess Buyers on account handling, outreach quality, list collection, CRM discipline and basic excess terminology.

Your qualifications, your influence

To be successful in the role, you must possess the following skills:

  • Experience in purchasing, sourcing, sales, electronic component distribution, EMS/OEM supply chain or related commercial role.
  • Ability to qualify excess inventory lists and understand key fields such as MPN, manufacturer, quantity, date code, packaging and lead time.
  • Good negotiation skills and ability to manage standard purchase opportunities within approval limits.
  • Strong communication skills with customers, suppliers, Sales, Logistics, Quality and Finance stakeholders.
  • Strong CRM and data discipline, with the ability to maintain clean account and opportunity records.
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, follow up consistently and prioritise opportunities based on value, quality and demand.
  • Understanding of account ownership rules and the importance of protecting Sales relationships.

Preferred skills and technical familiarity

Adding additional insight, practical experience and a growth mindset will elevate your contribution in this role:

  • Hands-on experience in independent distribution, excess inventory, electronic components or procurement operations.
  • Familiarity with component categories such as semiconductors, passives, connectors, electromechanical parts and sensors.
  • Experience working with OEM, EMS, ODM, OCM, Tier supplier or distributor accounts.
  • Experience preparing proactive offers, opportunity summaries or supplier/customer account plans.
  • Ability to train or guide junior team members and contribute to a structured career progression model.
  • Regional language skills and ability to work across APAC cultures and time zones.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
  • Collaborative and vibrant work culture
  • PTO
  • Referral bonus programme where applicable

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.

title: Order Management Associate
description:
OUR COMPANY:
EOS IT Solutions is a global technology and logistics company, providing Collaboration and
Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward
thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. We move fast, operate at scale, and hold
ourselves to an exceptionally high standard - because our clients demand nothing less. Customer
satisfaction and a relentless commitment to quality are core to everything we do, and we invest
deeply in the people who make that possible.
We are a true international IT provider and proud of it. Global simplicity. Trusted transparency.
WHAT YOU WILL DO:
As an Order Management Associate, you sit at the center of how orders actually get delivered -
from the moment a client’s order is confirmed to the moment it lands complete and correct. You
are the connective tissue between our vendors, our warehouse, and our clients, and you keep
every moving part on track. This is not a passive admin role. You will be expected to spot issues
before they become problems, keep multiple orders moving at once, and bring energy and
precision to everything you touch. You’ll work across a client base that includes some of the
largest technology organizations in the world, and they expect a lot. So do we.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Generate vendor purchase orders accurately and efficiently, turning client orders into POs
that are complete, correct, and ready to action first time.
• Build POs the right way, every time - product specifications, quantities, and delivery
timelines all present and accurate.
• Track inbound shipments from vendors, staying ahead of delivery timelines rather than
chasing them after the fact.
• Work closely with project teams to flag and resolve potential delays before they reach the
client.
• Generate picking tickets for warehouse staff, aligned to live project timelines.
• Create logistics tickets for outbound shipments to clients, keeping the delivery chain
moving.
• Bring meticulous attention to detail to every stage of order processing - a small error
caught early saves a big problem later, and you catch it first.
• Run thorough quality checks to guarantee the correct products ship to the correct client,
every time.
• Prioritize a busy workload by urgency and importance, so the most time-sensitive orders
never slip.
• Manage a high volume of orders simultaneously without letting accuracy or quality drop.
• Adapt quickly when order specifications, shipment schedules, or client requests change -
and keep everything moving anyway.
• Troubleshoot issues as they come up and resolve them promptly to keep order flow
smooth.
• Respond promptly to client inquiries with clear updates on order status.
• Stay on top of vendor pricing, discounts, and promotions, so you always know where the
best deal is.
• Spot opportunities to negotiate better terms with vendors and bring cost savings back to
the business.
• Negotiate favorable terms, discounts, or bulk purchase arrangements that improve
margin.
Essential Criteria:
• A Degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field; or 1–2 years of
experience in an order management, procurement, or supply chain support role; or a
combination of relevant work experience and further education such as a post-secondary
qualification or professional certification.
• An understanding of the commercials involved in buying and reselling hardware - or a
genuine willingness to learn fast.
• Comfortable picking up procurement or ERP software; previous hands-on experience is a
plus, not a requirement.
• Strong numeracy skills and analytical ability.
• Basic to intermediate Microsoft Excel skills.
• Excellent time management - you can juggle a busy workload and know what to
prioritize.
• Exceptional attention to detail - the kind that catches the small stuff before it becomes a
big problem.
• Strong communicator, comfortable keeping clients and colleagues in the loop.
• A proactive problem solver who can think on their feet.
• A genuine team player - personable, easy to work with, and willing to pitch in wherever
the team needs it.
• Willing to work as part of a team in a fast-moving, growing global company.
DESIRABLE CRITERIA:
• Experience of Audio-Visual / Video Conferencing and networking environments.
• Exposure to Cisco CCW, Sage X3, or Jira - a plus, not a requirement.
• Able to drive progress positively and effectively, keeping stakeholders informed.
• Able to maintain a high standard of work under pressure, even when handling multiple
issues at once.
At EOS IT Solutions, we don’t just hire experience - we hire drive, curiosity, and the hunger to
get things right. If you’re early in your career but already understand that the details matter, that
speed and accuracy aren’t opposites, and that the best people in any room come prepared with
answers not just questions - we want to hear from you.
This role is for someone who may not have done every part of the order management process
yet, but who is determined to learn it end to end - from how vendor POs get built, to how
shipments get tracked, to what it takes to get the right product to the right client on time, every
time.
We’ll invest in teaching you the process. You bring the work ethic, the attention to detail, and the
mindset that every order is a chance to get sharper.
If you’re looking for a place to clock in and follow instructions, this isn’t it. If you’re looking for
a place to build real commercial and operational skills inside a fast-moving global technology
company, and you’re willing to earn it - let’s talk.

WHO WE ARE:
EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.

We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.

title: Unik jobbmulighet som BPA! Ledige stillinger der du jobber døgnvakter og kan nyte de gode friperiodene!
description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast
⏰ Arbeidstid: Døgn

Jeg er en glad ung mann som bor i min egen leilighet i Spydeberg. Jeg trives godt med livet og hjemmet mitt, og gleder meg over små hverdagsgleder som musikk, dans og konserter. Hver uke kjøper jeg friske blomster for å skape en hyggelig atmosfære i hjemmet – og jeg kan vel si at jeg har et "svart belte" i shopping!

På grunn av helsesituasjonen min har jeg et stort hjelpebehov og trenger assistanse i alle dagens aktiviteter. Til tross for dette er det viktig for meg å være inkludert, sett og trygg. Jeg liker å delta i det som skjer, og det er avgjørende for meg å ha medbestemmelse i egen hverdag, slik at jeg kan leve det livet jeg ønsker. Jeg har allerede et dyktig team av assistenter som jeg trives veldig godt med, men nå ser jeg etter flere som kan bidra til å styrke og utfylle gjengen. Når dagsformen er god, liker jeg å være ute og dra på tur. Jeg digger kjøreturer og et kafébesøk slår heller aldri feil!

Jeg ser etter deg som er sosial, løsningsorientert og inkluderende. Du bør trives med faste rutiner og være selvstendig i arbeidet ditt, men viktigst av alt: du må kunne se meg som den jeg er og forstå mine behov. Jeg kommuniserer uten ord, men når vi blir kjent, vil du enkelt forstå hva jeg uttrykker og ønsker. Du vil få grundig opplæring og kurs, slik at du blir trygg og komfortabel i rollen din som assistent hos meg. Jeg har dyr i hjemmet.

Høres dette interessant ut? Kunne du tenke deg å bli en del av teamet? Da håper jeg du søker!

Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid

Jeg søker nå 4 nye assistenter i 100 % stillinger med oppstart snarest.

Hos meg jobber man i en 2–1-turnus hele døgnet. Natt er hvilende og tilknyttet arbeidsstedet, og da kommer en tredje person inn som har våken nattevakt. Arbeidstid er hovedsakelig døgnvakter. Andre arbeidstider kan avtales ved behov. Turnus vil bli presentert nærmere i prosessen.

Forutsigbarhet og stabilitet er viktig, så det er avgjørende at du ser for deg å være i stillingen over tid. På grunn av stillingens karakter oppfordres menn til å søke.

Vi intervjuer aktuelle kandidater fortløpende og ansetter så snart vi har funnet riktig person. Oppstart er snarest.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Matlaging

  • Personlig hygiene (som stell, dusj og påkledning)

  • Forflytning

  • Matservering via PEG (opplæring vil bli gitt)

  • Medisinhåndtering (kurs må gjennomføres)

  • Praktisk bistand i hjemmet og hjelpe til med ærender

  • Følge/transport til og fra avtaler og sosiale aktiviteter

Kvalifikasjoner og personlige egenskaper:

  • Førerkort klasse B og er over 24 år på grunn av bilens forsikring

  • God norskforståelse og beherske norsk godt muntlig og skriftlig

  • Tidligere erfaring innenfor helsesektoren er en fordel

  • Ikke allergisk mot dyr (hund og katt)

  • Sosial og åpen

title: Process Technician I
location: West Columbia, South Carolina, United States
description:
At Thorlabs, we design and manufacture components, instruments, and systems that transform the world by identifying, enabling, and accelerating key photonics (i.e., light-based) technologies. Backed by a dedicated workforce of more than 3,000 employees worldwide, Thorlabs contributes to cutting-edge research and real-world innovation.

Whether you're early in your career or bringing years of experience, you’ll find opportunities to grow, take ownership, and make meaningful contributions from day one. We know every employee brings unique talents and perspectives that fuel our success, and we seek driven individuals who are excited to make an impact in a fun, fast-moving culture.

The Process Technician will be responsible for the fabrication of optical components and devices in a clean room environment utilizing equipment and executing production processes. Although the location of the position is in Columbia, SC, it may be required to travel to various locations including other Thorlabs entities and customer/vendor locations.

Essential Job Functions include the following, but are not limited to:

  • Read and follow work instructions. • Execute processes utilizing various production technologies including:
  • Photolithographic patterning of various substrates.
  • Wet chemical etching.
  • High vacuum coating and dry etching processes.
  • Chemical and mechanical cleaning and drying processes.
  • Mechanical machining and dicing processes for metal, glass, and polymers.
  • Laser marking and machining processes for metal, glass, and polymers.
  • Monitor process performance and process outcomes to identify areas for improvement.
  • Maintain a clean, organized work area.
  • Confidently and safely work with hazardous energies and materials.
  • Operate and monitor automated processing tools and equipment.
  • Perform quality inspections and testing (requires good vision and microscope use)
  • Ensure product meets documented quality specifications and recognize when product is out of compliance.
  • Perform periodic calibration and validation on process and metrology equipment.
  • Maintain inventory of raw materials and components.
  • Execute projects assigned by supervisor as required

In addition to the essential functions and duties listed above, the position is also responsible for:

• Meeting company standards pertaining to quantity and quality of work performed on an ongoing basis, performing all work-related tasks in a manner that is in compliance with all Company policies and procedures.

• Adhering to Company policies, procedures, and directives regarding standards of workplace behavior in completing job duties and assignments.

• Employees will work in a cleanroom environment and must wear appropriate cleanroom attire and required PPE (Personal Protective Equipment).

The Company retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

Requirements

Physical Activities:

Work may be active, could stand or sit for long durations and/or perform repetitious work at times. The employee may lift or move objects up to 20 pounds. Employees must grasp, manipulate, or assemble parts and components that are often very small. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate, however, may be noisy at times. Must be able to wear appropriate clothing and personal protective equipment such as but not limited to masks, glasses, gloves, and specialty garments. The required PPE and training allow for the safe handling and processing of chemicals like adhesives, lubricants and solvents, and safe operation of job-related equipment and tools.

Qualifications:

Experience:

• Minimum 1 year of manufacturing experience or related technical education. • Experience with lab safety and hygiene preferred

Education:

• High School Diploma or equivalent. Associate’s degree preferred in optics, physical science, or engineering discipline.

Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Position requires basic reading, writing, and arithmetic skills

• Must possess good written and oral communication skills.

• Must be comfortable working with computers and familiar with Microsoft Office.

• Must successfully complete company’s training program to include completion of various levels of health and safety training.

• Must be able to function in a diverse team environment

• Demonstrate accuracy and thoroughness, completing tasks correctly and on time

Other:

• Travel of less than 10%

The hourly rate for this position is $20.00 - $22.00 D.O.E.

Thorlabs values its diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Job descriptions are not intended as and do not create employment contracts. The organization maintains its status as an at-will employer. Employees can be terminated for any reason not prohibited by law.

Benefits

Thorlabs offers a complete benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance, company paid life insurance, a generous PTO package, a 401(k) plan, and tuition reimbursement just to name a few.

title: Kundservicemedarbetare till konsultuppdrag inom energibranschen – Lund
description:
Beskrivning

Vi söker nu en engagerad och lösningsorienterad kundservicemedarbetare till ett konsultuppdrag i Lund. I denna roll blir du en viktig del av ett team som arbetar med att stötta kunder inom energibranschen – en bransch i ständig förändring och med hög samhällsnytta. Uppdraget innebär att du arbetar nära kunder och bidrar till att skapa en professionell och trygg kundupplevelse genom tydlig service och vägledning.

Du kommer att vara anställd av oss och arbeta som konsult hos vår kund. Tjänsten är på heltid och utförs på plats i Lund. Rollen passar dig som trivs i en serviceinriktad miljö där samarbete, ansvarstagande och engagemang är centrala delar av det dagliga arbetet.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som kundservicemedarbetare arbetar du med att hantera inkommande kundärenden via telefon, mejl och chatt. Du ger kunder professionell service och vägledning kring produkter och tjänster samt hjälper dem att hitta lösningar på sina frågor och behov.

Arbetet innebär även att du utför enklare administrativa uppgifter, exempelvis registrering av listor och hantering av information i olika system. Du kommer att arbeta i flera digitala verktyg, vilket kräver att du snabbt kan sätta dig in i nya system och navigera mellan dem på ett effektivt sätt.

Du förväntas även ha en nyfikenhet för försäljning, då du utöver din månadslön har möjlighet att ta del av provision baserat på den försäljning du bidrar till.

Kvalifikationer

Skall-krav:

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av kundservice eller annat arbete med kundkontakt gentemot konsument

  • Trevlig attityd och hög servicekänsla

  • Ansvarstagande, lösningsorienterad och samarbetsvillig

  • Förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i skrift och tal

Meriterande kvalifikationer:

  • Erfarenhet från energibranschen eller liknande teknisk support där komplexa kundärenden förekommer

  • Vana att hantera utmanande samtal, till exempel med kunder som upplever oro kring ekonomi eller tjänster

  • Erfarenhet eller intresse för försäljning

Villkor

  • Startdatum: 1 maj 2026

  • Slutdatum: 1 augusti 2026, med möjlighet till förlängning eller anställning hos kund.

  • Plats: Lund (arbete sker på plats, ingen möjlighet till distansarbete)

  • Omfattning: Heltid

  • Anställningsform: Konsultuppdrag. Du blir anställd av oss och uthyrd till kund

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så vänta inte med din ansökan

För att vi ska kunna hantera din ansökan behöver vi ditt CV, referenser (specificera) samt säkerställa att skall-kraven tydligt framgår i ditt CV

Om du är redo att ta dig an en roll inom kundservice och bidra med din kompetens och erfarenhet – tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan. Bifoga CV i din ansökan som tydligt visar att du har den kompetens och erfarenhet som efterfrågas för det aktuella arbetet. Vi rekryterar kontinuerligt och ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Notera: Vi hanterar endast ansökningar som skickas in via vår karriärsida.
Vänligen registrera din ansökan där för att säkerställa att den tas emot och behandlas korrekt.

title: Privatrådgiver - Holbæk
description:
Bliv en del af en afdeling med 17 medarbejdere, heraf 3 under uddannelse. Vi har hver vores kundeportefølje, men arbejder tæt sammen for at sikre den bedst mulige rådgivning. Tonen er uformel, og sparring er en naturlig del af arbejdsdagen.

Vi er et bredt sammensat hold i alle aldre med et stærkt sammenhold og en god stemning – og samtidig et klart fokus på at skabe resultater på en ordentlig måde. Holbæk afdeling er en afdeling i positiv udvikling med god vækst, og vi oplever, at kunderne aktivt vælger os til på grund af den nære relation og høje kvalitet i rådgivningen.

Om stillingen

Som privatrådgiver får du ansvaret for din egen portefølje af privatkunder. Du kommer til at arbejde selvstændigt, men altid med et stærkt team og et stort bagland af specialister i ryggen. Du bliver en vigtig ambassadør for AL Sydbank i lokalområdet og en betroet sparringspartner for dine kunder.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være:

  • Rådgivning om bolig, pension, investering, forsikring og daglig økonomi

  • Kreditvurdering og sikring af en sund og bæredygtig udvikling i porteføljen

  • Opbygning og udbygning af egen kundebase gennem proaktiv kontakt

  • Tiltrække nye kunder og forretninger ved at være opsøgende og skabe netværk, ambassadørsalg og markedsføringsaktiviteter i dit lokalområde.

Om dig

Du er kendt for din evne til at opbygge tillidsfulde relationer – både med kunder og kolleger. Desuden er du imødekommende og professionel i din tilgang til opgaver og tager ejerskab for både din portefølje og forretningsudviklingen.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har fokus på kvalitet og samtidig at sikre de værdiskabende kundeoplevelser

  • Er forretningsorienteret og ambitiøs

  • Er klar til at række ud til eksisterende og potentielle nye kunder

  • Har erfaring og er certificeret indenfor kreditpolitk, boligfinansiering, investering, pension og forsikring

Om virksomheden

AL Sydbank er blandt Danmarks største banker med hovedsæde i Aabenraa. Vores mål er at skabe økonomisk tryghed og udvikling – for kunder, lokalsamfund og hinanden.

Hos os bliver du en del af et fællesskab med mere end 4.000 kolleger i Danmark og Nordtyskland. Vi tror på, at stærke relationer skaber de bedste resultater, og derfor bygger vi vores kultur på samarbejde, korte beslutningsveje, høj faglighed og et fælles fokus på at gøre tingene effektivt og ordentligt.

Spørgsmål

Vi afholder løbende samtaler, så hold dig ikke tilbage fra at ansøge stillingen.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Privatdirektør Christian E. Arnesen på tlf. 2338 3578.

title: Business Systems & Data Analyst
description:
Business Systems & Data Analyst | SaaS, Power BI, CRM and Automation, hybrid Bristol

£50,000 to £55,000.

Hybrid working in Bristol, three days a week in the office if local.


This is a broad Business Systems and Data Analyst role for someone who likes ownership, variety, and visible impact.

You will be the person who understands the systems, trusts the data, improves the reporting, and helps colleagues make better decisions. That means being proactive, highly communicative, and comfortable in the room, not hidden away behind dashboards.


Why This Opportunity

Our client is a growing, technology-led professional services business with modern systems already in place. They now need one clear owner for business applications, data quality, reporting, dashboards, and practical process improvement.

This is not a narrow Data Analyst job. It is also not an IT support role. It sits between business systems, operations, data, reporting, and automation, with direct access to senior stakeholders and the freedom to suggest better ways of working.


Could This Be You

You might be a Business Systems Analyst, Data Analyst, Operations Analyst, Applications Analyst, Reporting Analyst, CRM Analyst, Systems Administrator, or Business Analyst with strong data skills.

You do not need every tool listed. You do need to enjoy solving business problems, working closely with people, and turning messy requirements into useful, adopted improvements.

This will suit someone as comfortable in a meeting as they are in Power BI. You will be asking good questions, sharing reports, explaining ideas, and helping people act on what the data shows.


What You’ll Bring


Essential:

  • Experience in a business systems, applications, data, reporting, operations analyst, or business analyst role.
  • Hands-on administration of a business-critical SaaS platform, CRM, or business application.
  • User management, permissions, configuration, and supplier coordination.
  • Reporting or dashboard experience, ideally with Power BI or a similar tool.
  • Confidence working with incomplete, inconsistent, or business-critical data.
  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain systems, data, and processes clearly.
  • Highly communicative and proactive, with confidence in presenting reports and ideas in meetings.
  • Experience gathering requirements from non-technical colleagues.
  • Process documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of GDPR and business data.
  • Existing right to work in the UK.


Useful:

  • CRM administration.
  • Power Automate, Zapier, Make, or n8n.
  • AI tools, APIs, agents, or workflow automation.
  • Managing an outsourced IT provider.
  • Systems implementation, integration, or data migration.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own day-to-day administration of core business systems.
  • Improve data quality across key platforms.
  • Maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and operational KPIs.
  • Support colleagues with access, configuration, and routine systems queries.
  • Coordinate work with an external managed IT provider.
  • Gather requirements and turn them into practical improvements.
  • Present reports, insights, and recommendations to colleagues.
  • Identify manual processes that can be automated.
  • Help assess, configure, and roll out new software.
  • Produce clear documentation and user guidance.


Why You’ll Enjoy It Here

You will have genuine ownership of defined systems and data environments. The business is small enough for your work to be seen, but mature enough to have useful tools, engaged stakeholders, and clear priorities.

This is a visible role in a professional services business. You will be trusted to speak up, share insight, challenge gently, and help colleagues make better decisions.

£50,000 to £55,000.
Bristol.

title: Associate Director, Global Health Economics & Outcomes Research (RWE)
description:
Madrigal is a biopharmaceutical company focused on delivering novel therapeutics for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), a serious liver disease that can progress to cirrhosis, liver failure, need for liver transplantation and premature mortality. Every member of our Madrigal team is connected by our shared purpose: leading the fight against MASH.

Madrigal’s medication, Rezdiffra (resmetirom), is a once-daily, oral, liver-directed THR-β agonist designed to target key underlying causes of MASH. Rezdiffra is the first and only medication approved by both the FDA and European Commission for the treatment of MASH with moderate to advanced fibrosis (F2 to F3). An ongoing Phase 3 outcomes trial is evaluating Rezdiffra for the treatment of compensated MASH cirrhosis (F4c).

Our success is driven by our people. We are building a dynamic, inclusive, and high-performing culture that values scientific excellence, operational rigor, and collaboration. To support our continued growth, we are strengthening our workforce strategy to ensure we have the right talent, at the right time, in the right way.

The Associate Director, Global Health Economics & Outcomes Research (GHEOR), Real-World Evidence (RWE) will support the strategic goals of the GHEOR, Global Medical Affairs (GMA) and the broader business driving patient access with optimal pricing and reimbursement for Madrigal Pharmaceutical’s medicines, with a focus on Rezdiffra.

This position directly impacts the ability to achieve business objectives on a global basis by providing strategic guidance and robust evidence development relevant to achieve optimal patient access by demonstrating the value of our medicines for liver health, with a primary focus on developing and deploying real-world data and evidence to support Rezdiffra and the Madrigal portfolio, in a federated operating model that includes service delivery across the enterprise.

This role will be responsible for developing and executing RWE projects and strategies against the global integrated evidence plans, including dissemination of technical deliverables related to real-word data and evidence. The role will also support the design and execution of pragmatic, prospective real-world and implementation science studies to evaluate treatment effectiveness, care delivery and adoption of evidence-based practices in routine clinical settings. Reporting to the Senior Director, GHEOR (RWE), the incumbent will be working closely with the GMA, Clinical Development & Biostatistics, Access and Commercial, Regional and in-Country teams to foster a culture that promotes innovation, optimal population health and patient centricity.

All incumbents are responsible for adhering to applicable Madrigal policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities and Primary Activities:

Approximately 60% of this role focuses on executing functional objectives, and the remaining 40% is dedicated to providing support for strategic direction and adapting priorities to achieve organizational goals.

  • Evidence Generation and HEOR Studies
    • Analyze complex real-world data (RWD) sources such as administrative claims and electronic health records databases
    • Design, build, and maintain internal data warehouses
    • Develop and maintain reproducible analytical pipelines and real-world evidence (RWE) platforms using R programming, leveraging version control tools and collaborative coding environments (e.g., GitHub), while integrating SQL and Python where beneficial
    • Build and govern internal real-world data (RWD) analytics infrastructure by leveraging modern platforms such as Posit Workbench and Databricks to enable end-to-end RWE study execution
    • Execute both rapid analyses and full protocol-driven research studies, including retrospective observational, prospective real-world, pragmatic and implementation science studies, ensuring methodologies are robust, fit-for-purpose and scientifically sound
    • Support the design and execution of pragmatic and implementation studies that evaluate real-world treatment effectiveness, adoption of evidence-based practices, care pathways, treatment initiation, adherence and persistence, and patient outcomes in routine clinical practice
    • Leverage advanced analytic and statistical modeling techniques (e.g., Cox regression, propensity score matching, IPTW) to drive causal inference and integrate data across diverse real-world sources
    • Navigate complex datasets to leverage data that improves patient outcomes
  • Clinical and Regulatory Support
    • Ensure RWE studies adhere to FDA and EMA regulatory guidance to produce high-quality evidence supporting label expansion and HTA submissions
    • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders—including Medical Affairs, regulatory, access, clinical and data science teams—as well as external investigators and healthcare-system partners, as appropriate, to inform RWE, pragamatic and implementation research across the product lifecycle
  • Industry & Conference
    • Stay current on industry trends and advancements in RWE, HEOR, pragmatic research and implementation science methodologies
    • Present at scientific conferences and publish in key journals
  • Compliance & Quality
    • Ensure all activities comply with company SOPs, industry standards, and applicable regulations
    • Uphold the highest ethical standards in all external engagements
  • Travel Requirement
    • Travel up to 30% for scientific congress attendance, internal and external meetings
    • Ability to work across global time zones as needed

Required Qualifications, Skills & Experience:

  • Graduate degree in biostatistics, public health, epidemiology, or a similar field
  • 10-12+ years of relevant experience.
  • In-depth experience with R programming, version control and collaborative development tools (e.g., GitHub), and analytic environments such as Posit Workbench, Databricks or similar cloud-based data science platforms
  • Expertise in applying advanced statistical analytic methodologies to RWD
  • Familiarity with common commercially available RWD data assets encompassing administrative claims and EHR databases
  • Experience in delivering ad-hoc and full protocol-driven observational studies; experience with prospective real-world research, pragmatic studies, implementation science or health services research is preferred
  • Experience with liver / metabolic diseases in the RWD space would be preferred
  • A strong track record of publications
  • Strong communication skills
  • High proficiency with project management systems, Medical Affairs dashboards, CRM platforms, and enterprise collaboration tools (e.g., Veeva, Microsoft Office Suite, SharePoint, Teams, Zoom)

Preferred Attributes:

  • PhD preferred
  • Experience with SQL and Python
  • In-depth knowledge of liver disease; experience in cardiometabolic health or metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH)

title: Maintenance Generalist Lube Tech C (Day) Shift RVI-Cumming, GA $3,000 New Hire Sign On Bonus
description:
Job Details:

3rd Shift Thursday to Sunday 8:00 am to 8:00 pm

Shifts are subject to periodic rotation every 8 weeks.

SUMMARY

Inspects, oils, and greases moving parts of friction surfaces of mechanical equipment such as shaft and motor bearings, sprockets, drive chains, gears, and pulleys by performing the following duties.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Fills container such as oilcan, grease gun, or tank of lubrication truck with specified lubricant.

Squirts or pours oil on moving parts and friction surfaces, or into holes, oil cups, or reservoirs.

Turns oil cup valves to regulate flow of oil to moving parts.

Forces grease into bearings with grease gun, smears grease on friction surfaces, or packs grease cups by hand.

Fills wells and sumps of lubricating systems with oil.

Reports machinery defects or malfunctions to supervisor.

Cleans machines, sweep floors, and transport stock.

Documents of inspections for predictive maintenance scheduling.

You will also put on research-backed trades based on your own analysis, giving you direct ownership of your best ideas and rapid feedback from the market.

You will begin with structured training through the Optiver Academy for Equity Analysts. As your market knowledge and judgement develop, you will take increasing ownership of company coverage, research ideas and research-backed trading positions.

What you’ll do

In this role, you can expect to:

  • Identify fundamentally driven trading opportunities and work with traders to capture them, focusing on maximising your impact on overall desk PnL.
  • Think probabilistically and perform scenario analysis for relevant upcoming events and catalysts. Analyse time sensitive headlines for companies within your coverage sectors and assess their potential impact on volatility and/or stock prices.
  • Assist in the growth of our fundamental research team by developing processes, identifying new areas of market inefficiencies and building relevant industry networks.
  • Use AI-enabled tools, supported by training, to organise and analyse news, events and company information, applying your own judgement to validate their output and improve the research tooling.

What you’ll get

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

  • A performance-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool.
  • The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 different countries.
  • 25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards.
  • Training opportunities, discounts on health insurance, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses.
  • Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, in-house physio and chair massages, organized sports and leisure activities, and Friday afternoon drinks.
  • Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events.
  • Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats.

Who you are

  • Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in a STEM, Finance, Economics or business related subject
  • Available to start full time work in August 2027 (either graduating by 2027, or holding a maximum of 3 years work experience)
  • Has a genuine interest in financial markets and demonstrates a willingness to learn new techniques/skills and teach others
  • Able to work under the guidance of mentors and develop fundamental research-driven ideas independently
  • Possesses strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbally and in writing
  • Entrepreneurial by nature - you've run something of your own, taken risks that didn't always pay off, or committed to getting genuinely good at something difficult
  • A determined and resilient individual, equipped with strong analytical, quantitative and problem-solving skills
  • Evidenced time management, organizational and multitasking skills with experience in computer programming being preferred, but not required

How to apply

Are you interested in furthering your career on one of the most dynamic and exciting trading floors in Europe?

Apply directly via the form below for the position of Graduate Equity Analyst. Please provide us with a CV in English. Unfortunately we cannot accept applications via email for data protection reasons.

If your application is selected to proceed to the next round, you will be required to complete online assessments. By submitting your application you are confirming that you will be able to take the assessment within 7 days.

Kindly note that we do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our recruitment inquiry form.

Diversity statement

Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion.

We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via the contact form, selecting "Reasonable Adjustments" as the subject of your inquiry.

For answers to some of our most frequently asked questions, refer to our Recruitment FAQs.

title: National Performance Systems Lead
description:
Swim Ireland Performance Swimming

Vacancy: National Performance Systems Lead

Remuneration commensurate with experience and qualifications

As part of our Performance Strategy for the Los Angeles 2028 and Brisbane 2032 Olympic cycles, Swim Ireland Performance is seeking an exceptional, motivated and innovative leader to assume the role of National Performance Systems Lead.

The role will lead and align the technical direction of Irish swimming from pathway to podium and will serve as Swim Ireland’s National Head Coach at the Olympic Games, World Aquatics Championships and European Aquatics Championships across the Los Angeles 2028 and Brisbane 2032 Olympic Cycles.

This is a unique opportunity to work collaboratively with the National Performance Director and an ambitious Performance Team to lead the implementation and ongoing evolution of Swim Ireland’s Performance Plan, connecting National Teams, National Centres, Regional Programmes and Club Performance Environments within a unified framework designed to create best in class environments and deliver sustained international success for Ireland.

Role Overview

Reporting to the National Performance Director, the National Performance Systems Lead will provide leadership across the Performance pathway and work collaboratively with National Centre Head Coaches, Regional Pathway Development Coaches, and club coaches to implement a nationally aligned performance system capable of consistently producing athletes and coaches who can succeed on the European, World and Olympic stage.

Working with the National Performance Director and other relevant members of the Performance Team, the successful candidate will:

1. Support the implementation and ongoing development of Swim Ireland’s Performance Plan

2. Serve as Swim Ireland’s National Head Coach for designated international competitions

3. Support the ongoing evolution and success of National Centre programmes in Dublin, Limerick and Bangor

4. Develop strong, trust-based relationships with key clubs and coaches throughout Ireland

5. Ensure consistent standards, expectations and performance behaviours are embedded across the Performance pathway

6. Contribute to the development and monitoring of performance standards and benchmarks relevant to international progression

7. Support National Centre coaches, Regional Pathway Development Coaches and club coaches working with high-potential athletes

8. Promote the holistic development of athletes across technical, physical, tactical, psychological and lifestyle domains

9. Promote and uphold Swim Ireland’s values, behaviours and commitment to a positive Performance pathway experience

Our Vision for Performance Swimming in Ireland

“Through a unified endeavour across Irish aquatics, power a dynamic system and an ever-evolving culture to develop and support identified aquatic talent, those who wear the Green Jacket with pride, and particularly those who are driven to stand on World and Olympic podiums.”

Our work is guided by the following core principles:

· A commitment to a long-term Performance programme aimed at recurrent, sustainable success

· Dedication to developing a system that enables athletes to reach their full potential consistently

· Aspiration to deliver success at Olympic, World and European level

· A people-centred Performance programme focused on developing world-class athletes, coaches and practitioners

· A commitment to ensuring the Performance pathway is a positive and transformative experience for all involved

Ideal Candidate Profile

Applicants will ideally demonstrate:

· Experience coaching athletes at World Championships, Olympic Games or equivalent international level

· Proven ability to develop athletes along a long-term performance pathway

· Strong understanding of athlete development within swimming

· Experience leading coaches, programmes and multidisciplinary performance projects

· Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction, coaching systems and performance standards within a high-performance sporting environment

· Understanding of performance support disciplines and integrated athlete support services

· Experience designing or implementing high-performance systems, pathways or daily training environment models

· Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

· Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders

· Experience establishing, maintaining and reviewing high-performance standards

· Strong organisational and strategic planning skills

Key Expectations of the Role

Applicants must understand that this role:

· Demands a collaborative approach and a commitment to building trust across the Irish swimming community

· Requires significant travel throughout Ireland and internationally as part of the National Team and National Programme domestic season plan

· Involves regular interaction with clubs, coaches and performance stakeholders

· Requires the confidence to challenge, support and align performance environments in a constructive manner

· Will play a central role in shaping the future direction of Performance Swimming in Ireland

Informal Enquiries

Informal enquiries may be directed in the first instance to the National Performance Director, Andrew Reid, via [email protected]

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion

We particularly welcome applications from female candidates and candidates from Black and minority ethnic backgrounds, who are currently under-represented within our Performance Team. Swim Ireland appoints strictly on merit.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in Ireland at the time of application.

All applications will be treated with the utmost confidentiality. Applicants may indicate their current salary and/or remuneration expectations during the application process.

How to Apply

1. Cover letter, including a personal statement addressing the role requirements and outlining how your skills, experience and values align with the position.

2. Comprehensive CV relevant to the role, including details for three referees, one of whom must be your current employer.

Closing date for applications: 12:00 GMT on Friday 25th September 2026.

This is a full-time position, with a preferred start date no later than 1st January 2027, offered as an initial fixed-term contract to 31st August 2032.

title: Solution Architect for a strategic IAM/IGA
description:
We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect for a strategic IAM/IGA transformation program within our Insurance Business Unit. The focus of the program is the introduction of a group-wide business role model, the migration of existing SailPoint-based roles, and the phased rollout of a target platform based on One Identity (myAccess) and Nexis. We seek a professional who can define and validate solution designs bridging authorization concepts, entitlement models, and system integration across a large, complex international enterprise environment.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Define and validate solution designs for Business Role management, including data structures, integration requirements, entitlement models, governance controls, and operational procedures.

  • Assess existing authorization concepts, entitlements, organizational structures, and Business Roles across the group, including suitability of SailPoint-based roles for migration.

  • Design and validate Business Role management processes and workflows implemented in Nexis and integrated with myAccess (One Identity) and related systems.

  • Contribute to defining the target Business Role framework, including role design standards, lifecycle processes, approval workflows, and segregation-of-duties considerations.

  • Support integration testing, pilots, and rollout activities from an architecture perspective, ensuring designs hold up through dry-runs, pre-pilots, and production rollout.

  • Produce and maintain solution design documentation, implementation concepts, and architecture-related project deliverables.

  • Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Requirements Engineers, Test Managers, and the existing core project team (including internal solution and security architecture capabilities).

  • Provide recommendations on Business Role governance, migration approaches, and operating model design, based on experience from comparable Business Role Management and Identity Governance implementations.

Key Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Solution Architect in complex IAM, IGA, or Access Management transformation programs.

  • Strong understanding of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) architecture, entitlement models, and role-based access design.

  • Experience designing solutions that integrate with One Identity, SailPoint, or comparable IGA platforms.

  • Experience in large-scale migration or rollout programs within international enterprise environments.

  • Ability to define governance controls, data structures, and integration requirements at the solution-design level.

  • Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

  • Professional-level English; German language nice to have

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience with Nexis for Business Role and Application Access Rights management.

  • Experience in the insurance or financial services sector, or other regulated industries.

  • Knowledge of Segregation of Duties (SoD) and compliance-driven access governance.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft AD, SAP, Azure DevOps, and Power BI in an enterprise IGA context.

Other Details:

Contract: B2B

Start Date: 01.10.2026
Duration: until 30.06.2028 (capacity expected at less than 1 FTE, adjusted to project phase needs)
Workload: part-time / less than full FTE, scaled to project phases
Location: remote (predominantly); on-site presence in Germany (Munich, Düsseldorf) may be required for key phases, up to several days per month during crucial project phases

title: L&D Specialist Europe & India
description:
Who we are

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves. Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

Position Overview

This is a newly created, standalone L&D role operating across a geographically distributed SaaS business of approximately 1,100 employees. The role carries end-to-end ownership of learning and development activity—from designing and facilitating manager effectiveness programmes to maintaining the integrity of employee training records across all jurisdictions. The primary focus is building and embedding a performance-oriented management culture.

As an individual contributor working without a direct team beneath you, this position requires both the strategic mindset to set organizational priorities and the hands-on capability to personally deliver them.

Key Responsibilities

1. People Development & Training Management

  • Manager Effectiveness: Design and deliver a comprehensive programme that equips people leaders with the skills, tools, and confidence to manage performance, navigate difficult conversations, adapt leadership styles, and communicate clearly across cultures.

  • Performance Accountability: Develop targeted content enabling managers to address underperformance early, document concerns clearly, and follow through consistently.

  • Situational Leadership: Deliver practical frameworks to help managers adapt their leadership style to different individuals and organizational contexts.

  • Cross-Cultural Alignment: Address and bridge cross-cultural communication gaps relevant to managing teams across Europe, India, and other global markets.

  • Compliance & Records: Maintain accurate, up-to-date training records globally within the LMS. Generate regular completion reports for the HR Director and local regulatory/legal bodies as required.

  • Point of Contact: Act as the primary internal and external expert for training record queries from managers, HR generalists, and auditors.

2. Coaching & Facilitation

  • Follow-up Touchpoints: Design and facilitate structured post-training modules (small group debriefs, peer learning circles) to support managers in applying learned concepts to real-world scenarios.

  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner closely with HR Generalists to align training programs with key employee milestones, particularly performance enablement and annual reviews.

  • Live Delivery & Logistics: Facilitate engaging live training sessions—both virtually and in-person—ensuring frameworks are inclusive and adapted to the audience. Own all end-to-end session logistics (scheduling, calendar coordination, attendance tracking).

3. Toolkits & LMS Curation

  • Manager Toolkit: Build and maintain practical, accessible resources including conversation frameworks, one-page guides, example feedback language, and performance documentation templates.

  • Content Curation: Collaborating with the Global L&D team, curate and update the LMS with high-quality manager content while systematically retiring legacy materials.

Profile & Qualifications

  • Experience: 5 to 7 years of prior experience in a dedicated L&D or People Development role, ideally within an international or scaling tech organization.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

  • Core Expertise: Proven hands-on experience facilitating corporate programmes (e.g., Feedback, Performance Management) with multi-country operational exposure.

  • Coaching: Deep experience or formal certification in professional coaching frameworks.

  • Technical Skills: Strong familiarity with modern Learning Management Systems (LMS) is highly advantageous.

  • Languages: Trilingual fluency is required. Must be fluent in English, Dutch, and French to effectively support local and global stakeholders.

What We Offer

Platform Science offers a comprehensive, market-leading package to regular, full-time employees in Belgium, combined with the unique professional advantages of a global standalone role:

Core Compensation & Benefits

  • Financial Reward: Competitive base salary plus a Corporate Bonus scheme.

  • Time Off & Work-Life Balance: 20 statutory leave days + 12 ADV days (32 days total) to compensate for the 40-hour work week, plus 1 Global Day of Service.

  • Allowances: Meal vouchers (€7.50/day via Edenred) and access to our Employee Support Program.

  • Premium Insurance: Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance (DKV) and Group Insurance (Baloise).

  • Retirement Planning: Company-funded pension contribution of 4% of your annual salary (no employee contribution required).

  • Mobility: Company car included as part of your statutory mobility package to support regular travel between regional offices.

Professional Value & Impact

  • International Exposure: Work daily across multiple countries, time zones, and distinct European and Indian work cultures.

  • Autonomy & Impact: Take absolute end-to-end ownership of the regional L&D roadmap in a highly visible, newly created position where your strategies directly shape corporate culture.

  • Collaborative Growth: Work within a dynamic, expanding organization, partnering directly with hiring managers, business leaders, and global HR infrastructure.
