title: Project Director – Faith and Community Initiative Project (FCI)
description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Employee Contract Type:

Local - Fixed Term Employee (Fixed Term)

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

30% In-Country Leadership and Program Management

Provide overall leadership and management of the FCI country program, responsible for the achievement of country goals, objectives, and results in a timely and cost-effective manner.

Lead country-level planning, adapting guidelines provided by the Global Management Team to the local context, and translating them into country work plans and performance targets.

Implement the global strategy, standards, and performance expectations at country level, ensuring adherence to technical standards, best practices, and donor guidelines.

Uphold the 80/20 efficiency commitment and drive the country transition and sustainability roadmap toward government and faith-based ownership.

30% External Relations: Embassy, Government, Christian Health Association, Faith Based Organizations Networks and other Partners

Serve as the principal in-country point of contact and FCI representative to the U.S. Embassy and GHSD country team, keeping them informed of major program developments.

Manage relationships with host-government counterparts, including the Ministry of Health, the Ministry of Finance, and other relevant ministries and sub-national government authorities.

Build, manage and maintain strong partnerships with Christian Health Associations (CHAs), faith-based organizations networks (FBOs), and other strategic partners to support the delivery of integrated health services and advance country ownership goals.

Represent FCI on the national steering committee (or existing coordinating body) chaired by the host government, ensuring alignment with the country MOU and national health strategies.

Cultivate and manage relationships with local implementing and sub-partners, faith-based and community health networks, and other partners and organizations, including the Global Fund, its principal recipients and sub-recipients, and other GHSD and bilateral partners.

Coordinate with other PEPFAR/GHSD programs and partners so that FCI activities complement ongoing initiatives and adhere to country and global standards, avoiding duplication.

10% Transition to Government Ownership and Sustainability

In close collaboration with the US Embassy, lead high-level negotiations with the Ministry of Health, the Ministry of Finance, and other government authorities to secure the progressive transition and absorption of FCI-supported activities, health workers, facilities, commodities, and data systems into government ownership and domestic financing.

Develop, negotiate, and steward a country-specific sustainability and transition plan with clear benchmarks, milestones, and timelines, jointly owned with the host government and endorsed by the national steering committee.

Secure government commitments and co-investment (including budget lines and payroll absorption) for the continued financing of frontline health workers, hubs, spokes, and community platforms beyond the life of the award.

Advocate with government and faith-based service providers to formalize the integration of faith-based facilities and staff into national health plans, payroll, supply chain, and information systems.

Track and report on transition progress against agreed benchmarks, escalating risks to government absorption in a timely manner and adjusting the roadmap in coordination with the Global Project Director and the national steering committee.

20% Staff, Consortium, and Operations Management

Lead, supervise, and motivate the country team of technical and program-management staff, ensuring strong communication and coordination across the team.

Manage in-country consortium and sub-partners, establishing and maintaining strong lines of communication and collaboration.

Oversee country office operations, logistics, procurement, and administration in line with World Vision and donor policies and country laws.

Directly supervise the Country Technical Director, Finance and Compliance Manager, and MEL Manager, setting performance expectations and supporting staff development.

10% Grant, Fiscal, Compliance, and Risk Management

Hold overall accountability for country-level administration, fiscal management, and grant and contract management, ensuring all program goals are met on time and within budget.

Oversee country programmatic and financial reporting, ensuring compliance with donor regulations, World Vision policies, and country statutory requirements.

In coordination with the Finance and Compliance Manager, ensure expenses are reasonable, allocable, and compliant for clean audits.

Identify country-level risks – programmatic, financial, safeguarding, security, and reputational – in a timely manner and lead mitigation, escalating to the Global Project Director as needed.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILL AND EXPERIENCE

Required Education, training, license, registration, and/or Certification

Academic Qualifications

Master’s degree required in public health, international development, business/public administration, or a related field.

Demonstrated experience representing programs to U.S. Embassies/USG, national governments, the Global Fund, and other partners, and negotiating the transition or absorption of program activities into government systems and financing. Proven experience ensuring compliance and clean audits on donor-funded awards.

Sufficient technical familiarity with integrated health programming (HIV, TB, malaria, MCH, and nutrition) to provide credible leadership. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in the national/local language(s) strongly preferred.

Demonstrated experience working with the Federal Ministry of Health, Regional Health Bureaus, government technical structures, technical working groups, donors, implementing partners, FBOs, and local organizations.

Proven experience providing technical oversight and capacity strengthening to multiple implementing partners, sub-awardees, local organizations, and FBOs across geographically dispersed areas.

Demonstrated experience using MEL data, evidence, research, assessments, and learning to improve technical performance and guide adaptive programming.

Proven experience in health systems strengthening, localization, government ownership, sustainability, institutionalization, and transition.

Experience working in complex, fragile, humanitarian, conflict-affected, or resource-constrained environments is highly desirable.

Preferred Specialized Training / Certifications

Preference will be given to candidates with specialized training or certification in PEPFAR Program Management and Technical Programming

U.S. Government/USAID Award and Program Management

HIV/AIDS and PEPFAR Technical Programming

TB/HIV Collaborative Programming

MNCH and Integrated Primary Health Care

Nutrition Programming and Nutrition-Sensitive Health Systems

Health Systems Strengthening

Quality Improvement / Continuous Quality Improvement (QI/CQI)

Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL)

Data Use, DHIS2, Digital Health, and Health Information Systems

Results-Based Management and Adaptive Management

Project/Program Management: PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent

Leadership and Senior Management

Localization, Partnership Management, and Organizational Capacity Strengthening

Safeguarding, PSEA, Gender, Disability Inclusion, and Protection

Humanitarian Health, Emergency Preparedness, and Outbreak Response, particularly relevant to the Ethiopian context.

Required Professional Experience

Minimum 10 years’ experience managing donor-funded health programs, including senior management and staff supervision, with a strong track record engaging institutional donors, host governments (including Ministries of Health and Finance), and multi-organization consortia; prior Chief of Party, Deputy Chief of Party, or senior country program management experience strongly preferred.

Demonstrated substantial technical expertise in at least one core FCI technical area, such as HIV, TB, MNCH, nutrition, community health, primary health care, or health systems strengthening, combined with proven experience providing strategic technical oversight across integrated health programs.

Proven ability to integrate multiple technical areas into a single coherent program strategy, implementation model, service-delivery approach, performance framework, and health systems strengthening agenda, rather than managing technical components as separate vertical programs.

Strong senior-level experience working with Ministries of Health, Regional Health Bureaus, government technical structures, technical working groups, implementing partners, local organizations, FBOs, and donor technical counterparts. Direct experience with Ethiopia's Federal Ministry of Health and Regional Health Bureaus is highly desirable.

Demonstrated experience in technical quality assurance, quality improvement, integrated service delivery, supportive supervision, mentorship, capacity strengthening, evidence-based programming, data use, performance management, and adaptive management, with a proven ability to identify technical gaps and lead corrective actions.

Demonstrated experience using program data, evidence, assessments, learning, and performance information to guide technical decisions, adapt implementation strategies, improve service quality, and demonstrate measurable program results.

Proven experience contributing to health systems strengthening, government ownership, localization, sustainability, institutionalization, and transition, including strengthening government and local partner technical capacity and integrating project-supported approaches into existing health systems.

Demonstrated experience working effectively in complex, fragile, humanitarian, conflict-affected, or rapidly changing environments, with the ability to adapt technical approaches while maintaining quality and alignment with national and donor requirements.

Proven ability to build consensus among diverse technical stakeholders, manage competing technical priorities, resolve complex implementation challenges, and maintain technical quality and consistency across multiple partners, regions, and technical areas.

Strong track record of providing strategic technical leadership while remaining sufficiently operational to guide implementation teams, partners, health facilities, community platforms, and local organizations toward measurable program results.


Required Language(s)

Fluent English and other local languages

Required travel and/or work environment accommodations

Country office environment with regular in-country travel to implementation regions, districts, and field sites (typically up to 40% of the time). May require travel to insecure or hazardous locations. Occasional international/regional travel for consortium and donor engagements.

Position’s physical requirements

Addis Ababa, WV head office

Preferred Experience, Knowledge and/or key competencies
Advanced knowledge of integrated public health programming, with demonstrated ability to link HIV, TB, MNCH, nutrition, community health, primary health care, and health systems strengthening within a unified program model.

Strong knowledge of Ethiopia’s health system, national health policies, strategies, guidelines, service-delivery platforms, and decentralized health structures, including the Federal Ministry of Health, Regional Health Bureaus, Zonal Health Departments, and Woreda Health Offices/DHMTs.

Strong understanding of U.S. Government and PEPFAR technical requirements, including technical performance frameworks, quality standards, reporting requirements, data use, accountability, and evidence-based programming.

Demonstrated knowledge of health systems strengthening integrated service delivery, quality improvement, supportive supervision, mentorship, capacity strengthening, and institutionalization of technical interventions.

Strong knowledge of HIV and TB programming, including prevention, testing, linkage to care, treatment, retention, viral suppression, TB case finding, TB/HIV integration, and community-facility linkages.

Good understanding of MNCH, nutrition, community health, PHC, and health-system interventions, including their integration with HIV and TB programming.

Strong knowledge of Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL) and the practical use of program data, DHIS2, routine health information, assessments, and evidence to improve technical performance.

Knowledge of quality assurance, continuous quality improvement, adaptive management, and evidence-to-action approaches, with the ability to translate performance findings into practical corrective actions.

Strong understanding of localization, government ownership, partner capacity strengthening, sustainability, institutionalization, and transition of externally supported health programs.


Knowledge of faith-based and community-based health programming, including community engagement, demand creation, referral systems, community accountability, and linkages between community and facility services.

Knowledge of digital health and health information systems, including DHIS2, eCHIS, digital data collection, dashboards, and technology-enabled service monitoring, is desirable.

Knowledge of gender, disability inclusion, safeguarding, PSEA, equity, and rights-based approaches in health programming.

Understanding of humanitarian health, outbreak preparedness and response, conflict-sensitive programming, and service continuity in fragile settings is highly desirable.

Demonstrated ability to interpret complex technical evidence and translate it into strategic decisions, practical implementation guidance, policies, standards, and scalable program models.

Strong strategic leadership, technical judgment, analytical thinking, problem-solving, negotiation, facilitation, and consensus-building skills, with the ability to engage senior government, donor, technical, and implementing-partner stakeholders.

Excellent technical writing, presentation, communication, knowledge-management, and learning dissemination skills.

Strong professional command of English; Amharic fluency is highly desirable, with additional Ethiopian language skills considered an advantage.

title: Lead Mobile SDET
description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

At OneSpan we are looking for a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) — a strong software engineer who specializes in test — to architect and own our QA automation frameworks and strategy across the entire Mobile Security Suite (MSS) SDK portfolio. Our Mobile Security Suite (MSS) spans multiple SDKs across iOS, Android, and server-side platforms (.NET and Java).

This is a hybrid role: part hands-on automation engineer, part technical lead. You will work alongside our Android automation developer, manual QA engineer, and feature developers, contribute directly to test automation across all MSS SDKs, and design the frameworks, tooling, strategy, and roadmap that take our QA practice to the next level.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead Test Strategy: Assess current automation coverage across all MSS SDKs (iOS, Android, server-side), identify gaps, and define the testing strategy, tooling, and project setup needed to close them.

• Contribute Hands-On: Design, write, and maintain automated tests across iOS, Android, and server-side SDKs — using AI coding tools and partnering with feature developers on platforms where you need extra language or domain support.

• Own the Pipelines: Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines (YAML), Bash scripts, and Gradle builds across our multiple SDK pipelines to run automated suites, stand up local/test servers, and integrate with real-device testing cloud solutions.

• Drive Planning & Reporting: Prepare quality and coverage reports, and bring recommendations and next steps to quarterly planning with engineering leadership.

• Mentor the Team: Guide the automation developers, feature developers, and QA engineers who contribute to automation; help formalize processes, code review standards, and best practices.

• Keep Growing: Stay current with mobile and server-side testing tools and frameworks; proactively identify and fill missing skills or tooling gaps on the team.

Required Technical Skills

• Automation Leadership: 6+ years in software test automation, including experience defining test strategy and leading or mentoring other engineers.

• Framework Architecture: Proven track record designing, building, and maintaining test automation frameworks and harnesses from the ground up — abstraction layers, reusable components, test data and fixtures — not just writing tests against an existing suite.

• Mobile Automation Expertise: Deep hands-on mobile test automation in at least one mobile stack — iOS (Swift, XCTest/XCUITest) or Android (Kotlin, Compose Test/Espresso/UI Automator) — with the ability to extend to the other and to server-side, using AI coding tools and feature-developer support to bridge gaps.

• Test Infrastructure: Builds and owns the test infrastructure that runs the suites, including integration with the third-party real-device cloud services we use for tests that need real hardware.

• CI/CD & Scripting: GitLab CI and YAML pipeline authoring, Bash scripting, Gradle.

• Version Control: Git and standard branching / pull request workflows.

• Comfortable working across a multi-language, multi-platform codebase and picking up a new language or framework when a project requires it.

Nice to Have

• Server-Side: Java, Spring or Spring Boot, JUnit 4 and JUnit 5.

• .NET / C# experience, to extend automation coverage to .NET-based server components.

• Experience testing security-sensitive SDKs (e.g., anti-tampering, threat detection, RASP) or working in a regulated / security-conscious product environment.

• Prior experience leading or building a QA automation function from an early stage.

Soft Skills

• Strong leadership and mentoring instincts, with the ability to influence without formal authority.

• Clear communicator, comfortable presenting test strategy, status, and risks to management.

• Analytical and gap-driven — able to look at a large, multi-platform codebase and identify where quality risk actually lives.

• Eager to learn and self-directed in closing skill or tooling gaps.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer-  Monetization Platform
description:
About Monetization Platform

The Monetization Platform team owns the systems behind how Rippling sells, contracts, bills, collects, and recognizes revenue across products and countries.


The team owns the platform behind the complete monetization lifecycle:

Quote → Contract → Entitlement → Subscription → Usage → Bill → Revenue


These systems support a $1B+ sales base, manage entitlements, metering, and usage-based billing rules, and enable localized billing as Rippling launches into new countries.


As Rippling continues to introduce new products, pricing models, packaging structures, and markets, the Monetization Platform provides the common infrastructure that allows teams to move quickly without rebuilding monetization logic each time.


Our vision is simple:

Let any team monetize any product, anywhere, without writing code.


This is a platform for engineers who enjoy solving foundational problems where correctness matters, abstractions need to last, and the impact extends far beyond a single product or team.


The opportunity

  • Rippling's product portfolio is expanding rapidly across HR, IT, Finance, and new product categories.
  • Every new product introduces monetization complexity: what a customer purchased, what they are entitled to use, how their subscription evolves, how usage should be measured, what they should be charged, how payments are collected, and how that activity is ultimately reflected in financial systems.
  • We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the next generation of Rippling's Monetization Platform.
  • You will own broad, ambiguous, multi-team technical charters spanning contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows.
  • You will work on systems where errors are expensive. Incorrect contract state, entitlement state, usage calculations, invoices, payments, taxes, or revenue records can directly affect customers, financial accuracy, and trust.
  • This role combines:
    • Hands-on backend and platform engineering
    • Org-level architectural leadership
    • Technical leadership and mentorship
    • Cross-functional influence across Engineering, Product, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Payments, Security, and Data
  • You will define architecture, make difficult technical tradeoffs, align teams around durable solutions, mentor technical leaders, and help build a platform that allows Rippling to monetize new products and markets faster and with greater confidence.
  • This is not an architecture-only role. You will stay close to execution through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation-level technical decisions.


What you'll own

  • Own major technical charters across CPQ, contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows.
  • Define architecture for systems requiring strong guarantees around data integrity, auditability, reliability, recoverability, and clear ownership across service boundaries.
  • Design durable platform abstractions that allow product teams to introduce new packaging, pricing, entitlement, metered billing, subscription, and contract models without building custom one-off solutions.
  • Lead multi-team initiatives from problem definition and architecture through technical design, execution, migration, launch, and long-term operational ownership.
  • Define clear service boundaries, APIs, data models, ownership models, and failure-handling strategies across interconnected monetization systems.
  • Make high-quality technical tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, performance, cost, compliance, maintainability, and delivery speed.
  • Stay hands-on through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation-level decisions.
  • Partner closely with Product, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, Payments, Platform, Security, Data, and product engineering teams.
  • Identify systemic technical risks early and drive alignment on durable solutions, particularly where customer trust or financial accuracy is at stake.
  • Establish engineering standards for critical monetization systems, including testing, observability, incident learning, migration safety, rollout mechanisms, and operational readiness.
  • Mentor Staff, Senior, and mid-level engineers and help grow technical leadership across the organization.
  • Raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment, thoughtful design reviews, clear technical writing, and operational excellence.

What success looks like

  • Platform leverage: Product teams can launch new products, pricing structures, packaging models, entitlement models, and usage-based offerings without rebuilding core monetization infrastructure.
  • Correctness and trust: Critical contract, entitlement, subscription, billing, payment, tax, and revenue workflows maintain a high standard of data integrity, auditability, and reliability.
  • Clear architectural boundaries: Monetization capabilities have well-defined ownership, APIs, data contracts, and service boundaries, reducing coupling and one-off implementations.
  • Faster product and market expansion: New products and country launches can adopt common monetization capabilities rather than creating bespoke billing and entitlement systems.
  • Operational excellence: Critical monetization systems have strong observability, safe migration patterns, effective incident learning, and clear operational ownership.
  • Technical leadership: Engineers across teams look to you for architectural guidance, difficult technical decisions, and direction on complex cross-system problems.
  • Stronger technical leaders: Staff, Senior, and mid-level engineers around you develop greater technical judgment, ownership, and ability to lead increasingly complex initiatives.


What we're looking for

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, preferably across backend engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure, distributed systems, product engineering, or systems engineering.
  • Proven experience operating at Senior Staff, Principal Engineer, or equivalent Staff+ scope.
  • Deep hands-on engineering foundation with strong coding, debugging, system design, and production ownership experience.
  • Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems with demanding reliability, observability, and data correctness requirements.
  • Strong architecture depth across APIs, databases, data modeling, concurrency, event-driven systems, service boundaries, reliability, performance, failure modes, and long-term maintainability.
  • Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous, cross-functional, multi-team technical initiatives from definition through production ownership.
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make tradeoffs across product needs, business constraints, engineering quality, and long-term platform direction.
  • Ability to influence senior engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong mentorship record and a track record of raising the technical bar for engineers around you.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining complex technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments.
  • Deep backend programming experience in one or more languages. Python and Django experience is a strong plus.

Bonus points

  • Experience building monetization, entitlement, metered or usage-based billing, subscription, pricing, payments, accounting, revenue, tax, or fintech systems.
  • Experience building internal platforms used by multiple product engineering teams.
  • Experience working in SaaS, enterprise software, HR technology, payroll, compliance, workflow-heavy domains, or high-growth product companies.
  • Experience with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with reliability engineering, incident response, performance tuning, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Experience with security, permissions, auditability, compliance, or enterprise-grade controls.
  • A builder-leader mindset: someone who can define direction, align stakeholders, establish durable architecture, and remain close to execution.

title: Staff Engineer 1 – Salesforce AI
description:
InMobi Advertising is a global technology leader helping marketers win the moments that matter. Our advertising platform reaches over 2 billion people across 150+ countries and turns real-time context into business outcomes, delivering results grounded in privacy-first principles. Trusted by 30,000+ brands and leading publishers, InMobi is where intelligence, creativity, and accountability converge. By combining lock screens, apps, TVs, and the open web with AI and machine learning, we deliver receptive attention, precise personalization, and measurable impact.

Through Glance AI, we are shaping AI Commerce, reimagining the future of e-commerce with inspiration-led discovery and shopping. Designed to seamlessly integrate into everyday consumer technology, Glance AI transforms every screen into a gateway for instant, personal, and joyful discovery. Spanning diverse categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and beyond, Glance AI delivers deeply personalized shopping experiences. With rich first-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi’s global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high impact, performance driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work, and by MIT Technology Review, Fast Company’s Top 10 Innovators, and more, InMobi is a workplace where bold ideas create global impact. Backed by investors including SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins, and Sherpalo Ventures, InMobi has offices across San Mateo, New York, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru and beyond.

At InMobi Advertising, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how billions of users connect with content, commerce, and brands worldwide. To learn more, visit

What is the team like?

The GTM (Go-To-Market) Engineering team at InMobi builds and scales the systems that power revenue operations and customer engagement. The team owns a comprehensive Salesforce ecosystem—including Sales Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce—along with Experience Cloud (Customer Community), enabling seamless workflows for Sales, Account Management, and Business teams. A key focus area is building intelligent agents and automations using Agentforce, integrated across Salesforce, Slack, and community platforms. These agents drive productivity, automate workflows, and enable real-time, context-aware actions for internal teams and customer-facing use cases. The team also leverages Slack as a collaboration and execution layer, tightly integrated with Salesforce to trigger workflows, surface insights, and enable faster decision-making. On the backend, the team develops and maintains a scalable middleware platform using Apache Camel and Java, powering event-driven integrations and reliable data exchange across systems. The architecture blends CRM, data platforms, agent-based automation, and distributed systems—focusing on extensibility, real-time processing, and high impact business outcomes. This is a high-impact engineering team operating at the intersection of CRM, AI-driven agents, integrations, and modern enterprise platforms.

Skillset: Agentforce (Agent Development), Salesforce (Advanced), Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, Slack, CI/CD (Copado/GitHub), Event-Driven Architecture, Integration Patterns (Apache Camel), Java, Automation & Workflow Design, Performance Optimization, Python

Role Overview

As an Architect/Staff Engineer I at InMobi, you will be a mentor, technical leader driving the design, development, and delivery of Agentic AI solutions on Salesforce platform. You will serve as the bridge between our CRM infrastructure and AI-driven product experiences - shaping how InMobi's go-to-market and revenue systems evolve and uplift in an era of autonomous workflows and intelligent automation. You'll work closely with product team, RevOps, Data and product engineering to build scalable, distributed, enterprise-grade solutions that power InMobi's growth.

What you'll do

Salesforce platform engineering

  • Design, build, and deploy scalable Salesforce-centric solutions supporting InMobi's revenue and growth operations - including Agentforce / AI-driven orchestration, prompt templating, Data Cloud integration, complex Apex, LWC, and integration layers.
  • Design high-scale integrations with enterprise-grade architectures leveraging Platform Events, Change Data Capture (CDC), and REST/SOAP APIs to enable real-time data flows across the business.
  • Build features enabling seamless integration between Salesforce structured/unstructured data and downstream AI agents for faster insights and decision-making.
  • Deploy and monitor Salesforce-integrated products with an emphasis on agent observability, telemetry, and auditability.
  • Develop best-in-class data health monitoring and context enrichment pipelines to ensure CRM data used by agents is reliable, governed, and audit-ready.

Agentic AI & intelligent automation

  • Lead technical solutioning for full-lifecycle projects focused on how Salesforce will power autonomous workflows, co-pilots, and multi-agent systems - contributing to a "data-first, agent-aware" architecture strategy.
  • Partner with product management and business stakeholders to prioritize CRM data products that drive autonomous decision-making, context-rich recommendations, and discoverable data services for next-gen AI agents and LLM-based systems.

Distributed systems & backend

  • Architect and scale distributed systems that interact with Salesforce for real-time data synchronization, leveraging Kafka, Spark, or similar streaming technologies.
  • Write clean, testable, and high-performance backend middleware in Java that bridges CRM and cloud services at scale.

Engineering excellence

  • Champion DevOps best practices including Salesforce DX, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), and automated testing frameworks.
  • Mentor engineering teams, set technical standards, and enforce code quality and best practices across squads.
  • Contribute to InMobi's platform reliability with a focus on fault tolerance, performance optimization, and scalability.

What you'll bring

Required qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise software development with a focus on scalable, fault-tolerant, CRM-integrated architectures.
  • 2–3 years of hands-on experience with Agentforce, Data Cloud, and cloud platforms (GCP or Azure) and their connectivity to Salesforce.
  • Deep expertise in Salesforce architecture: Apex, LWC, Salesforce Shield, CRM data modelling, and high-volume data processing patterns.
  • Proven experience with advanced Salesforce integrations including Platform Events, CDC, and complex REST/SOAP API integrations.
  • Experience writing optimized SOQL/SOSL and managing large datasets within Salesforce multi-tenant environments.
  • Experience writing clean, testable backend code in Java or Python for middleware services (Apache Camel, MuleSoft) bridging CRM and external cloud services.
  • Mastery of Salesforce DX, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Copado), and AI automated testing and deployment frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce data security including Data Mask, encryption, and governance in the context of agent auditability and compliance.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems and how tools like Kafka or Spark interact with Salesforce for real-time data synchronization.

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at ad-tech or high-scale B2B SaaS companies.
  • Track record of building and delivering Agentic AI solutions for enterprise systems - including sophisticated Salesforce UIs and high-performance backend services.
  • Experience with Salesforce Media Cloud, Order Management System (OMS), Revenue Cloud, or related platforms.
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation, agent observability tooling, or RAG pipeline design.

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.

Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

title: Lead Market Researcher
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London (Hybrid) / UK Remote | 💰 £90,000 - £110,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

⭐About the team

Monzo is expanding beyond the UK to make money work for all Europeans. Our Next Markets team is focused on understanding where and how we can build a successful business in new markets.

We work across Research, Strategy, Product, Data, Design and Marketing to make some of Monzo’s most consequential expansion decisions about our entry strategy: where the strongest opportunities lie and how our proposition should evolve.

We’re looking for a Lead Market Researcher to own the customer and market evidence that sit at the heart of these decisions. This is an opportunity to set research direction for new-market entry, establish how we build confidence in unfamiliar markets, and influence our expansion strategy.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

  • Leading the research that shapes our entry strategy for new markets, starting with discovery across new EU markets
  • Developing and evolving a repeatable market-entry research approach, prioritising the questions that matter most and balancing depth, speed and confidence
  • Building a clear view of local money behaviours, banking expectations, customer needs, trust drivers and barriers to adoption
  • Identifying, understanding and sizing priority customer audiences, partnering closely with Data, Strategy and Product
  • Assessing how well Monzo’s current and near-term proposition fits local customer needs and market expectations
  • Setting a high bar for evidence quality, triangulating across sources and challenging assumptions where the evidence does not support them
  • Synthesising complex and sometimes conflicting evidence into clear recommendations, trade-offs and confidence levels, and use them to shape business, product and marketing decisions
  • Choosing the right research approach for each question, combining hands-on research with AI, specialist expertise and agency support where these add value

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • Significant experience in customer research or consumer insight, with a track record of shaping strategy and business outcomes
  • Experience tackling ambiguous, early-stage problems such as market entry, proposition development, innovation or audience strategy
  • Experience conducting research across multiple markets and navigating meaningful cultural and market differences
  • Strong quantitative research skills, including segmentation and audience sizing
  • Strong methodological judgement - ability to choose the right approach for the question and recognise when specialist qualitative or other expertise is needed
  • Ability to connect customer insight to product, proposition, brand, marketing, commercial and go-to-market decisions
  • Strong synthesis and communication skills, turning complex research and data into clear narratives, recommendations and trade-offs
  • Confidence influencing and constructively challenging senior cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong judgement in fast-moving environments, including knowing when deeper research is needed and when directional evidence is enough

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £90,000 - £110,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.

✅ We can sponsor your visa.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  1. Call with recruiter (30 mins)
  2. Research Methods interview (1 hour)
  3. Teamwork and Impact + Values and Leadership interviews (1.5 hours in total)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

#LI-LG1 #LI-Remote

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

title: Maintenance Engineer
description:
Some engineering jobs are all firefighting.

This isn't one of them.

You'll be joining a well-established manufacturing site producing a long shelf-life product, where things are planned properly and engineering is given the time and support to do things right.

The site is busy, but it's well organised. Production isn't constantly in crisis, and you're not walking into a situation where every breakdown is treated like the end of civilisation.

You'll be part of a stable engineering team, working alongside supportive management and production colleagues who understand the value of good maintenance.

It's the kind of environment where you can get on with the job, solve problems properly and make improvements rather than spending every shift chasing the latest emergency.

What's in it for you?

  • £51,431.90 salary

  • 26 days' holiday + bank holidays

  • Option to buy an additional 5 days' leave

  • Annual site bonus, paid in November

  • Annual salary review every April

  • Matched pension contributions of up to 10%

  • Free on-site parking

  • Established engineering team

  • Well-run manufacturing site

  • Lincoln commutable

The Role

As a Shift Engineer, you'll be responsible for keeping production equipment running reliably and safely.

You'll be working across both electrical and mechanical maintenance, with a good balance of planned work, fault finding and improvement activity.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Planned preventative maintenance

  • Electrical and mechanical fault finding

  • Breakdown response and repair

  • Supporting continuous improvement projects

  • Working closely with production to maximise equipment reliability

  • Maintaining high standards of safety and engineering practice

Shift Pattern

You'll work a 3-week rotating shift pattern:

  • Week 1: 6am-2pm, Monday-Friday

  • Week 2: 2pm-10pm, Monday-Thursday; 2pm-9pm Friday

  • Week 3: 10pm-6am, Monday-Thursday

What We're Looking For

  • Engineering apprenticeship with NVQ, City & Guilds or equivalent

  • Electrical or mechanical engineering background

  • Experience within manufacturing, FMCG, food, packaging or a similar environment

  • Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills

  • PLC experience would be advantageous

  • A proactive engineer who takes pride in doing things properly

Why Consider It?

The real attraction here is the working environment.

This is a site where engineering matters. The product has a long shelf life, production is well planned and the operation isn't constantly running from one crisis to the next.

That means you can actually maintain equipment properly, investigate recurring faults and make improvements, rather than simply resetting machines and waiting for the next breakdown.

The engineering team is stable, management are supportive and there's a genuine focus on doing things properly.

If you're looking for a well-paid shift engineering role where you can work in a professional, organised manufacturing environment without the constant drama, this is well worth a conversation.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
We are looking for a Solutions Architect to design, deliver, and maintain complete technical solutions that address specific business needs, in line with our product strategy and organisational standards.

Reporting to the Principal Architect, you will own the architectural direction for an assigned stream of value, working closely with its Head of Stream and engineering leaders across multiple teams. You will own the full lifecycle of your solution designs — from selecting the right technologies and platforms to owning the non-functional requirements that keep them scalable, secure, and reliable in production. You will be expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, driving decisions through to implementation while keeping the relevant stakeholders aligned.

You will contribute directly to technical strategy, championing standards across engineering, and mentoring Software Engineering Team Leads and Engineers across your portfolio.

We have fully embraced AI-based spec-driven design, integrating AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle. From specification to implementation, AI tooling shapes how we architect, build, and iterate — making us faster, more deliberate, and focused on what matters most. This isn't an experiment. It's how we work.

Responsabilities

• Provide and maintain scalable, feasible and flexible solution designs in alignment with business requirements.

• Select key technologies, platforms and frameworks in line with technical standards and best practices.

• Own the solution-wide non-functional requirements — performance, security, scalability and reliability.

• Contribute to, and advocate for, technical strategy and technical standards across the organisation.

• Mentor and guide Software Engineering Team Leads and Engineers of all levels.

• Convey complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Drive a culture of innovation and engineering excellence.

Requirements

• 7+ years of experience in software engineering and at least 2+ years of experience in solution architecture.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.

• Expertise in system architecture and cloud computing.

• Expertise in software engineering and DevOps practices.

• Proficiency in AI and generative AI technologies, applied across the software development lifecycle.

• Proficiency in data architecture, AI security, and responsible AI principles.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking, with a deep understanding of the entire software engineering lifecycle.

• Deep understanding of, and alignment with, the company's core business principles, goals and strategy.

Nice to have skills

• Experience mentoring engineers at multiple levels of seniority.

• Experience contributing to organization-wide architecture standards or governance frameworks.

• Background working in multinational, cross-functional engineering organisations.

Benefits

• We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy. 2 days of work at home, with the possibility of working fully remote 3 months per year.

• 29 days of holidays.

• Pension plan and private medical insurance paid by the company.

• Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year.

• Flexible schedule.

• 7 hours per day work during August.

• 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support).

• Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub.

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination — including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

title: Senior Associate, Digital Assets
description:
Tower Research Capital is a leading quantitative trading firm founded in 1998. Tower has built its business on a high-performance platform and independent trading teams. We have a 25+ year track record of innovation and a reputation for discovering unique market opportunities.

Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.

Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.

At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best.

At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.

Responsibilities :

  • Supporting day-to-day trading operations across multiple markets, venues, and counterparties, including account onboarding, KYC, account maintenance, and operational setup with external counterparties.
  • Analyzing daily trade, position, cash, and transaction reconciliations, investigating breaks and driving timely resolution while maintaining accurate books and records.
  • Coordinating cash, collateral, and asset movements across venues and banking partners, and ensuring trading accounts are appropriately configured for collateral, leverage, margin, and settlement requirements.
  • Monitoring transaction and settlement activity, investigating and resolving failed or delayed movements, maintaining accurate books and records and reviewing and signing off daily P&L while escalating discrepancies and key items to management.
  • Collaborating with Trading, Finance, Compliance, Technology, and external counterparties to resolve operational issues and continuously improve workflows.
  • Optimizing operational processes by automating manual activities, strengthening controls, and enhancing operational reporting.

Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree in economics, finance, or a related field; CFA certification or progress toward the CFA designation is a plus.
  • At least 3–5 years of experience in capital markets or cryptocurrency operations.
  • Expertise in Microsoft Excel, including lookups, PivotTables, and conditional statements.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and transition seamlessly across diverse responsibilities while maintaining a high standard of quality and attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with sound judgment and the ability to perform effectively under pressure.
  • The ability to work in a fast-paced, 24/7 market environment with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Benefits:

Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.

At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.

Our benefits include:

  • Generous paid time off policies
  • Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region
  • Hybrid working opportunities
  • Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily
  • In-office wellness experiences and reimbursement for select wellness expenses (e.g., gym, personal training and more)
  • Company-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)
  • Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving
  • Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year
  • Workshops and continuous learning opportunities

At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.

Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

title: TV & Digital Media Analyst
description:
TV & Digital Media Analyst – Meta & GA4, London – Up to £38k


Are you a data-driven Media Analyst with direct, hands-on experience managing and analysing campaigns within Meta Ads Manager?


Do you understand how to evaluate campaign, ad-set and advert-level performance, recognise emerging trends and translate your findings into practical optimisation recommendations?


This independent, international agency is looking for a TV & Digital Media Analyst to join its London team. Working across global campaigns for charities and NGOs, you’ll analyse performance across digital and traditional TV channels, helping clients acquire and retain supporters for some genuinely important causes.


You’ll work closely with the agency’s digital and media teams, using Meta Ads Manager, GA4 and Excel to evaluate campaign performance, identify opportunities and support optimisation. You’ll also have the opportunity to develop your Power BI skills, with full training provided.


This role would suit someone with at least two years’ experience in digital analytics, performance marketing or media analysis who has worked directly inside Meta Ads Manager and understands how campaigns are structured, measured and optimised.


Please note: direct professional experience managing and analysing campaigns within Meta Ads Manager is essential. Experience using Meta data solely through Power BI, reporting dashboards or automated data models will not be sufficient for this position.


The experience we need:


  • At least two years’ experience in digital analytics, performance marketing or media analysis
  • Direct, hands-on experience managing and analysing campaigns within Meta Ads Manager
  • A strong understanding of Meta campaign structure, including campaign, ad-set and advert-level performance
  • Experience monitoring campaign budgets, delivery, pacing, targeting and creative performance
  • Confidence analysing key metrics such as spend, reach, impressions, CPM, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversions and ROAS
  • Hands-on GA4 experience, including campaign, traffic, conversion and customer-journey analysis
  • The ability to recognise performance trends, diagnose issues and recommend campaign optimisations
  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with complex datasets
  • Experience producing reports and translating analysis into practical recommendations
  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills
  • Confidence communicating with clients and answering campaign-related questions
  • Excellent organisation and the ability to manage several projects simultaneously
  • An enthusiastic, collaborative and calm approach


Experience within a media or performance marketing agency would be particularly useful. Power BI, Looker Studio or Tableau experience would be advantageous, although training will be provided. Experience within fundraising, charities or NGOs—or fluency in German—would also be a bonus.


The role:


  • Analyse TV and digital campaign performance across multiple international markets
  • Work directly with Meta campaign data to identify trends, performance issues and optimisation opportunities
  • Evaluate performance at campaign, ad-set, audience and creative level
  • Centralise and benchmark global digital campaign results
  • Use Meta Ads Manager, GA4 and Excel to evaluate and optimise campaigns
  • Monitor performance and emerging trends across channels including Meta and Performance Max
  • Build reports and presentation decks that turn data into clear client recommendations
  • Support forecasting, media planning and campaign performance reviews
  • Develop your knowledge of attribution methodologies and explain them clearly to clients
  • Manage day-to-day client queries, campaign briefings and data presentations
  • Build relationships with media-agency partners across international markets
  • Identify new tools, technologies and AI developments that could improve efficiency and performance


The agency offers a friendly, supportive environment, hybrid working and the opportunity to contribute to campaigns that raise millions for important causes around the world.


Salary: £33,000–£38,000, depending on experience

Location: London – hybrid working

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am–6pm

description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
​
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

The mission of the Engineering Program Management Office (PMO) is to implement program and project management methodologies that enable Fivetran to deliver complex products and initiatives on time and within expectations. In addition, the Engineering PMO serves as the subject-matter expert on project and program management standards, directing a department-wide approach to project delivery and communication. You will help plan, track, and execute the company's most critical and cross-cutting product and engineering objectives. You will be responsible for leading cross-functional teams, managing complex programs and projects, and ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality solutions that meet the needs of our customers. You will communicate and work in close collaboration with partners across the engineering team as well as other business partners to achieve this vision.

This is a full-time position based out of our Novi Sad, Serbia office.

Technologies You'll Use

G Suite, AI LLM and Agents (Claude Code, Gemini, ChatGPT, and similar), Jira, Looker, Graphana, Lucid Charts, Workday, Sigma, Figma.

What You’ll Do

Program/Project Management

  • Manage key engineering projects, and/or programs, or initiatives from initiation to closing.
  • Provide regular status updates on a variety of internal channels to all levels of the organization.
  • Define program charters, plans, and schedules. Drive Program execution.
  • Drive Product representatives in providing timely direction and requirements.
  • Lead internal cross-functional teams in engineering and validation activities.
  • Ensure tight inter-team coordination and communication.
  • Digest, understand, and communicate complex, technical/engineering issues.
  • Identify and resolve conflicts or issues quickly, efficiently, and effectively.
  • Surface and mitigate risks or defects, and lead technical task forces to ensure proper risk responses or issue resolution.
  • Manage interdependencies across multiple engineering disciplines and stakeholders, including platform, SRE, & QA.
  • Develop creative solutions, remove obstacles, and redefine approaches to balance cost, quality, and delivery priorities.
  • Work closely with product management, data analytics, enablement & support.
  • Define and own specific program metrics and objectives.
  • Track and report on PMO KPIs.

Process Improvement

  • Act as a role model for project management processes.
  • Surface feedback and enhancement to processes.
  • Align stakeholders and team members towards project management best practices.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in a technical position (software engineer, QE, platform engineer, etc.)
  • 6+ years of experience in technical project/program management
  • Software project management experience is a strong plus
  • Agile and waterfall project/program management experience
  • Familiarity with project management tools like Jira, Trello
  • Can lead large and complex initiatives with minimal oversight.
  • Can introduce structure and order in volatile conditions.
  • Can clarify vague goals and requirements.
  • AI LLMs and AI Agents usage proficiency.
  • In-depth knowledge of the technologies and methodologies used in program management.
  • Ability to work directly with senior leadership on programs, including leading R&D-wide (engineering, product, design, security) initiatives from start to finish.
  • You can facilitate discussions with engineering subject-matter experts on topics such as System Design, Data Architecture, Infrastructure Management (including cost management), and Quality in the context of engineering operations.
  • Ability to leverage AI to increase your own productivity and leverage it in the solutions you’re building.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact and collaborate with technical and non-technical groups at all levels.
  • A data-driven and action-oriented mindset with excellent planning, analytical, problem-solving, project/program management, organizational, and leadership skills.
  • Proficient in addressing technical issues and providing effective mitigation plans.
  • Can align team members to program goals and objectives.
  • Conveys a clear understanding of how own activities relate to critical business drivers.
  • Discourages “us vs them” thinking in self and others.
  • Stays calm and professional even when situations become difficult.

Bonus Skills​

  • Start-up experience a strong plus
  • PMP certification is a plus
  • Familiarity with the following technologies is a plus: Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), ETL or ELT, modern data stack.

title: Graphic Designer (Digital Design Focus) - Remote
description:
Healthesystems offers workplace flexibility with our Work-From-Home model, and a competitive compensation and benefits package including healthcare coverage, PTO, paid holidays, 401(k), company-provided life insurance/disability coverage, wellness options, and more.

Healthesystems welcomes candidates from these states:

AL, AZ, CO, FL, GA, ID, IN, LA, MD, MS, MO, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA

Summary: The Graphic Designer is responsible for the creation, design, and delivery of high-impact digital marketing assets that support brand awareness, lead generation, customer engagement, and new business development initiatives. This role focuses primarily on digital design, including landing pages, website experiences, digital advertisements, email and social media graphics, video assets, and other multimedia content that support both paid and organic marketing campaigns. The Graphic Designer also contributes to the development of print and traditional marketing materials such as article layouts, sales collateral, brochures, and event-related materials as needed.

Working in a highly collaborative environment, this role partners closely with the Senior Graphic Designer, Web Developer, Digital Media Strategist, and Marketing leadership to translate business objectives into compelling visual experiences that align with brand standards and drive measurable results. The ideal candidate combines strong creative and technical design skills with a digital-first mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects while delivering high-quality work on schedule.

Key Responsibilities: “To simplify complexities for each customer.”

  1. Produce creative assets in a variety of mediums and channels with a digital-first philosophy that convey the appropriate message and brand with art direction from the Senior Graphic Designer and Marketing leadership.
  2. Designs digital marketing assets, sales collateral, informational pieces (e-newsletters, white papers, presentations, training materials) and other assets.
  3. Designs multimedia projects including landing pages, email campaigns, PowerPoint presentations, videos, etc.
  4. The creation and ownership of an email template library within our marketing automation platform (eg., Hubspot, Pardot)
  5. Creates video content – from storyboard concepting through video editing – for a variety of video types in support of sales and marketing campaigns.
  6. Produces designs for tradeshow booths, signage and large displays.
  7. Assists with implementing effective marketing campaigns that align to business objectives and meet marketing goals across various media channels such as print, email, and digital advertising. Suggests strategies to optimize performance and partners closely with Digital Media Strategist.
  8. Maintains a high standard with regards to detail and accuracy of all marketing materials and assets. Supports deliverable/approval workflows through project system prior to publication and distribution.
  9. Follows the Healthesystems corporate style guide and works closely with the Senior Graphic Designer to help manage the Healthesystems brand. Supports the continued evolution and maintenance of our brand and style guide.
  10. Maintains and updates projects in Workamajig (or current project system of record) including project files, deliverables and time management.
  11. Follows established process for file management and storage.
  12. Manages the entire lifecycle of marketing assets – from creation through prepress/printing and/or digital publication; interfaces with print and other marketing third-party vendors to hand off and manage final production.
  13. Stays on top of emerging trends and technologies, seeks out new methods of working and gaining efficiencies and improvements, and shares knowledge; possesses a desire to learn and advance knowledge and skills.

Qualifications/Education/Certifications:

Bachelor's degree from four-year College or university with a focus on Graphic Design or related field; and three to five years business-to-business graphic design experience with demonstrated experience in digital asset creation; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Must present a professional design portfolio
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; possess the ability to deliver clear, concise and accurate message through written and verbal means
  • Extremely organized and detail oriented individual who is able to work on multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
  • Ability to take creative direction and constructive feedback
  • Superior time management skills; possess the ability to establish priorities, complete projects with excellence and organize effective workflows to meet deadlines
  • Ability to work effectively under tight deadline and reprioritize as necessary
  • Project management skills
  • Presentation and Mockup skills and experience.
  • Software knowledge must include:
  • Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere, and Express)
  • Basic working knowledge of HTML and CSS
  • Experience working in no-code website-builder environments
  • Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Copilot)
  • Should be comfortable in Figma

Role-Based Competencies:

  • Shows Drive & Initiative
  • Collaboration & Teamwork
  • Delivers Quality Results Timely
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Job Knowledge & Skills

Physical Demands/Working Conditions:

Duties are performed primarily in a home office setting utilizing computer equipment. Travel to attend meetings and visit locations throughout the country may be required. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to use hands. The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. *** Job descriptions will be reviewed and are subject to changes of business necessity. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographical cost of labor, etc. In addition to base pay, Healthesystems offers a comprehensive benefits package including, health, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, wellness resources, recognition programs, 401k contribution, and PTO & Holiday pay (all subject to eligibility requirements). Applicable statutory benefits also provided, including the Colorado HFWA.

Anticipated Starting Pay Range
$59,800—$82,170 USD

To facilitate working from home, and as a requirement for this role, candidates must provide their own reliable, high speed internet access with sufficient bandwidth to execute all job functions. Company laptop will be provided - (except for temporary internship roles)

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
An established manufacturer are seeking to recruit an experienced Quality Lead following a reorganisation and planned expansion into larger premises. Backed by a major engineering group , you will be joining a business who are investing heavily in their facilities and have a strong & secure order book.
Senior Quality Engineer / Lead
Salary: up to £50,000
Location: Birmingham
Our client is currently a medium size manufacturer of precision CNC machined components for the aerospace market who, under new ownership, are moving to new modern facilities and investing in new advanced production machinery to fulfil new orders. To facilitate this expansion a Senior Quality professional is sought to lead the quality assurance and quality management function and staff.
Duties:
o Lead and organise the production focused Quality team
o Main contact for all in-production quality issues and questions
o Monitor and report key quality measures (e.g. defects, non-conformances) and drive corrective and preventive actions using root cause analysis
o Ensure drawings, specifications and customer requirements are followed, including through regular product & process audits.
o Lead problem solving and RCA to control and close out non-conformances
o Work closely with Operations, Supplier Quality and Project Quality to resolve issues and keep product flowing on time, to the right quality and cost
o Support internal and external audits and help maintain EN9100 / AS9100 and other approvals
o Coach, mentor and develop team members and wider operations staff in good quality practices.
Experience:
Applications are sought from Senior Quality professionals – Quality Manager, Quality Supervisor, Quality Lead or Senior Quality Engineer – who can demonstrate a good balance of hands on production problems solving skills, strong quality toolbox plus experience leading and mentoring Quality Engineers, Technicians & Inspectors.
o Proven track record of success in a complex / precision engineering/ manufacturing facility producing parts for Aerospace, Defence or Oil & Gas sectors
o Strong problem-solving skills with experience of root cause analysis, corrective action and tools such as PFMEA, PPAP/ APQP, Control Plans, First Article Inspection
o AS/EN9100 quality management systems maintenance and auditing
o Confident communicator who can set expectations, delegate, challenge and support others.
o Continuous improvement mindset, always looking for better ways of working and encouraging ideas from the shop floor
The opportunity:
This a great opportunity for an experience Senior Quality Engineer or Quality Manager who is looking to grow and develop their career with an expanding business who have solid relationships and contracts with major aerospace clients and are moving into larger modern factory late 2026. There is a role here that will provide a great deal of variety and will need a strong Quality Leader with good communication skills, good organisational skills and a strong Quality Toolbox.

title: Lead Driller
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role description:

Arcadis are looking for an Experienced Lead Driller based at our Gloucester facility. The position will involve working throughout the UK across a variety of sites and sectors including manufacturing, petrochemical and construction environments.

As part of our Environmental team, you’ll help improve quality of life. With your specialism in environmental management, or your technical or sustainability expertise, your work could involve protected species, pollution, surface water and materials management, air quality or noise. And in some of the world’s busiest and most beautiful locations.

We work to protect our natural environment and water resources, while powering our world for future generations. Around the world, we’re feeling the effects climate change, rapid urbanization, loss of biodiversity. The rate at which we’re seeing large-scale, unforeseen events such as floods and wildfires, is becoming more frequent. We are here to protect our natural environment and water resources, while powering our world for future generations.

Role accountabilities:

The successful candidate would be expected to work independently, demonstrating leadership, and taking a key role in the development of Assistant Drillers, and Health and Safety Stewardship.

Benefits open to the role include:

  • Competitive market salary dependent on experience.
  • National living wage employer
  • Overtime and Bonus schemes.
  • 25-day Annual holiday allowance, increasing with period of service, plus the option to buy additional days.
  • Single occupancy rooms when away from home.
  • Generous overnight and daily allowance.
  • External and Internal training opportunities.
  • One of the best contributory pensions in the industry – matched up to 8%
  • Other benefits available include: Private medical, Dental, cycle to work scheme and gym membership

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Clean and valid UK driving licence, held for at least 12 months.
  • Experience acting in the role of Lead Driller – preferably holding an NVQ Level 2 in Land Drilling. – BDA audit would also be beneficial.
  • Experience in Logging to BS5930 and knowledge of Eurocode 7 would be beneficial.
  • A full, clean driving licence (Category B) is essential, supplementary entitlement for C1+E and/or C preferable.
  • Valid CSCS Card.
  • It would also be beneficial if the applicant holds Personal Track Safety (PTS) accreditations or an SPA/PIA training card.

The position will involve working away throughout the week with accommodation provided directly by the company and a daily subsistence allowance provided.

Please note that although most of the work will be away, daily commuting to Gloucester may be required at times; therefore, the successful candidate will reside within a reasonable commute from the depot.

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We believe that by working together diverse people with different experiences develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of how we improve quality of life and we work closely with our people across six ED&I Workstreams: Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+ and Race.
