title: Creator Intern
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Praytell is a creative communications agency made up of strategic minds, spirited hearts and people with a strong instinctive recoil from anything remotely boring. We create culture-driven, integrated work that earns attention, sparks conversation and makes people… well, give a shit. But more than that, we’re a team of curious builders, thoughtful challengers and collaborative problem-solvers who believe the best work starts with a simple question: what if we?

What if we pushed the idea further? Solved the problem differently? Built something better?

Our work moves fast, evolves constantly and rarely fits neatly inside a box - which is exactly how we like it. The people who thrive here ask questions, chase ideas, spot opportunities and care enough to go beyond the brief. They don’t wait for a perfect roadmap or a tap on the shoulder - they’re energized by figuring things out, making things better and helping shape what comes next.

We hold ourselves to a high bar, but we’re not pretending to be a perfect agency filled with perfect people doing perfect work 100% of the time. We’re humans. Sometimes the work runs late. Sometimes the process is still being built. Sometimes there isn’t a policy, playbook or perfect answer for every little thing. What we do have is a genuine commitment to getting better - evolving how we work, support our people and build the kind of agency we want to be, together.

So that’s our promise to you. If curiosity drives you, ownership excites you and “what if we?” feels more like a life mantra than a question - we’d love to hear from you.

The Opportunity

Overview:

  • Dates: Tuesday, September 8 - Friday, February 26 (six-month internship)
  • Hours: Monday - Friday, 9am - 6pm local time, with a commitment of 40 hours/week
  • Location: Chicago or New York. This is a hybrid role, with interns expected to work from the office approximately once per week and attend in-person client events, activations or team needs as they come up.
  • Pay: $19/hour, with overtime eligibility
  • Benefits: Since you're expected to work more than 30 hours/week, you will be eligible for medical insurance. You will also receive 40 hours of paid sick time, which will be frontloaded at the start of your employment.
  • Commitment: This is designed as a full-time internship, so candidates should be available during standard business hours throughout the six-month program
  • Post-Internship: While there may be an opportunity to transition into a full-time role following the internship, it is not guaranteed and will depend on individual performance and company needs

As a Creator Intern, you will:

  • Support social and creative teams across a range of brands and industries
  • Help create social-first content for platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and emerging channels
  • Assist with designing and editing social content, including static graphics, short-form video, Reels, TikToks and other platform-native content
  • Take a first pass at social copy, captions, headlines and other short-form creative
  • Keep a pulse on social trends, memes, creators, sounds and cultural conversations to help spot opportunities for brands
  • Contribute ideas during brainstorms for social content, campaigns, activations and real-time cultural moments
  • Support content shoots from prep through production, including shot lists, props, filming and capturing behind-the-scenes content
  • Help edit and adapt content for different social platforms, formats and audiences
  • Research brands, competitors, creators and emerging trends to help inspire new creative ideas
  • Support social content calendars and help keep creative assets, feedback and deliverables organized
  • Participate in creative reviews, client calls and internal team meetings
  • Incorporate team feedback into copy, designs and content while learning how creative work evolves from idea to final execution
  • Collaborate with teammates across departments, including Integrated Communications, Influencer, Creative and Strategy to learn how integrated campaigns come together
  • Jump into other creative and strategy-related projects and opportunities based on client and team needs

What You Bring

  • No prior professional experience required! We’re looking for curious, creative people who are excited to learn, make things and get hands-on experience creating content for real brands. Previous internships, freelance work, relevant coursework or personal creative projects are a plus, but not required.
  • You’re a recent graduate or early in your career and looking to build real-world experience in social media and content creation
  • You genuinely love social media and understand what feels native, current and worth paying attention to across platforms like TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
  • You have an eye for what makes great social content, from visuals and editing to copy, tone and storytelling
  • You’re comfortable creating content yourself, whether that’s filming, editing, designing, writing or experimenting with new formats
  • You’re comfortable using creative tools like Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut and other editing and design platforms to bring social content to life
  • You’re comfortable behind the camera and open to appearing in content when it makes sense
  • You’re curious about brands, creators, internet culture and what’s happening online and IRL
  • You’re collaborative, organized and comfortable juggling multiple projects and priorities
  • You’re eager to learn, take feedback, contribute ideas and try things you haven’t done before
  • You’re able to commit to the full six-month internship and 40-hour workweek

Interview Process

Please note: due to the high volume of applications we receive, we're unfortunately not able to respond to every applicant individually. While we review every application, we'll only be in touch with candidates we're moving forward with.

We know how tough it can be to wait and wonder, especially in today's job market, so we want to be clear about what to expect. If you haven't heard from us within 10 business days of applying, it means we've decided to move forward with other candidates for this particular role. We truly appreciate the time, energy and care that goes into every application and will keep your information on file for future opportunities that may be a fit.

Our interview process typically takes 4-6 weeks and includes:

  1. Application Review: Before applying, please review the location requirements for this role. Unfortunately, candidates who do not meet the location requirement will not be considered.
  2. Phone Screen (30 minutes)
  3. Team Interview (30-60 minutes)
  4. Leadership Interview (30 minutes)
  5. Take-Home Exercise (TBD): A short, client-agnostic assignment designed to help us better understand how you think, approach challenges and tackle the work. Candidates who complete the exercise will receive a stipend via electronic gift card.
  6. Offer
  7. Target Start Date: September 2026

Who We Are

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all people and do not discriminate - period. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment in accordance with federal, state and local laws. We prohibit workplace harassment and discrimination of any kind and are committed to building an inclusive workplace in every location where we operate.

title: HEALTHCARE ASSISTANT, OPERATION THEATRE
description:
ORGANIZATION AND MANAGEMENT

Provide basic nursing care that aligns with the vision, mission, philosophy, goals, and objectives of the nursing services and the hospital.

Notify the nursing leaders of any situations that impact the quality of care.

Obtain unit report and assignment at the beginning of each shift and perform additional tasks as assigned by the Unit Manager or Senior Registered Nurse.

Daily routine in Operation theatre:

  • Perform thorough cleaning each morning, including sanitizing operating tables, lamps, and others.

  • Inspect supplies and gas cylinders to ensure their safety and guarantee well-stocked anesthesia machine.

  • Transport patients from the ward, transporting the patient to the induction room, and assisting the patient until they are evaluated by an anesthetist.

  • Transport patients to the operating room and assist in their safe lifting onto the operating table.

  • Provide assistance to the anesthetist, adjust the operating light according to the surgeon's instructions, and consistently maintain the sterility and cleanliness of the operating theatre.

  • Transport the patient to the recovery room and assist in their comfort.

  • Conducts regular nursing rounds to assess patients’ needs and communicate with them and their families.

  • Perform cleaning of the floors, operating tables, walls, and lamps, as well as disinfection of the operating theatre (OT) and scrub room after each procedure.

  • Conduct weekly cleaning of the entire unit to maintain high standards of cleanliness and hygiene.

  • Keeps the unit, store, fridge and its facilities clean and tidy.

  • Collect pharmacy and surgical supplies from pharmacy and the store as required to maintain adequate stock levels for operations.

  • Answer phone calls and relay messages.

  • Attendants to patients call the bell promptly.

  • Ensure portable oxygen continuous supply for emergency needs

Assists the trained staff in various aspects:

  • Carried out of basic nursing care, such as patient comfort, safety, nutrition, hygiene, transfer, dressing, intravenous lines, catheterization, etc.

  • Cleans and disinfects the trolley and instruments after use and stores them properly.

  • Records the daily charges for the items used in the unit and updates the patients’ charges accordingly.

  • Lifts, turns, and positions patients safely using the correct body mechanics.

  • Accompanies the consultant or anaesthetist in performing procedures and involve in all activities in operation theatre in the absence of trained staff.

Daily routine in Central Sterile Supply Services

  • Receive and inspect returned sets from wards.

  • Distribute sterilized sets on an exchange basis.

  • Clean and dry various instruments.

  • Inspect the instruments are functional and sets are complete.

  • Prepare and label sets for sterilization.

  • Uphold cleanliness in workspaces, including sinks, tables, and trolleys.

  • Keep the linen store and stock areas tidy and well-organized.

  • Assist in inventory management for linen and instruments.

  • Procure necessary solutions, tapes, sutures, and instruments from the store.

Attend meetings held by the service.

HUMAN RESOURCE AND DEVELOPMENT

Proactive in our own learning and development, and to meet the minimum requirement of 20 hours of continuing education per year.

Involve orienting new staff members to the unit routines.

Maintain a record of personal leave and training attendance.

POLICIES AND PROCEDURE

Adhere to the hospital's policies and nursing code of conduct, ensuring patient confidentiality and standard infection control practices are upheld.

FACILITIES AND EQUIPMENT

Assist the trained staff in managing the proper storage, condition, and availability of biomedical equipment in the unit, maintaining a sufficient supply of ward stock, and maintaining accurate records for equipment, medical supplies, and consumable item specimen collections.

SAFETY AND QUALITY IMPROVEMENT ACTIVITIES

Participate in new services, comply with 5S activities, patient safety policies, and adherence to ISO, MSQH, JCI, PSG, and NNA, ensure comply with patient safety goals, and occupational safety measures.

Adhere to the Occupational Safety and Health Act and Regulations 1994, take reasonable care at work, cooperate with employers, wear proper PPE, and follow all safety and health instructions and measures.

Education:

  • Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia

  • Certified healthcare assistants would be a priority.

Knowledge and Experiences:

  • Experience working in a hospital setting is an advantage

Special skills required

  • Able to converse fluently and write in English language and Bahasa Malaysia

Personal attributes

  • Have interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Caring, honest, and responsible worker.

  • Willingness to work on scheduled hours, shifts and weekends, public holidays and any time called during an emergency.

description:
Location: London/Hybrid (Strong preference for 1 day a week in the office)

Department: Engineering/Data

Employment Type: Contract (B2B)

About YLD:

Everything we do is to empower our clients to move forward. Our purpose is to help our clients develop the capabilities they need to outperform their competitors. Our success is a consequence of ensuring our clients are successful. Our company is built on extraordinary people; we aim to attract, inspire, develop and retain them. YLD is a software engineering and design consultancy; we create digital capabilities for our clients that last beyond our engagement. We have offices in London, Lisbon, Porto.

About the role:

As a Data Scientist, you will take responsibility for data, insights, and models that help our clients grow quickly. You’ll have Machine Learning Engineering experience and use this to build data capabilities that integrate well with software products. You'll work closely with the clients' cross-functional innovation team to build new and novel products.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will look like this:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and understand business problems and define data-driven solutions;
  • Lead end-to-end data science projects, from problem formulation and data exploration to model development, validation, and deployment;
  • Apply advanced statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to derive actionable insights and drive strategic decision-making;
  • Develop and implement predictive and prescriptive models to solve complex business challenges;
  • Collaborate with software and data engineers to integrate data from multiple sources and ensure data quality and integrity;
  • Communicate complex analytical concepts and insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner;
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in data science, machine learning, and AI technologies, and proactively identify opportunities to apply them to business problems.

Technical competencies:

  • Proven experience as a Data Scientist, with a strong focus on developing and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
  • Expertise in programming languages such as Python, with proficiency in data manipulation, analysis, and model development libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Proven experience with machine learning algorithms, such as supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, time series analysis, and natural language processing.
  • Strong statistical modelling skills and familiarity with statistical analysis tools.
  • Proficiency in SQL and working with relational databases.
  • Solid understanding of data engineering concepts, data preprocessing, and feature engineering techniques.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think creatively and develop innovative solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.

Non-Technical competencies:

  • Experience in a professional engineering role iteratively shipping software with a team of close collaborators;
  • Problem-solving skills that balance innovation with pragmatic technology choices to solve business needs;
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic production environment and taking care of client expectations effectively;
  • Distinct customer focus and quality mindset;
  • An exemplar of YLD’s brand and safeguarder of our reputation;
  • Good communication skills (both verbal and written).

What you’ll get in return:

  • The chance to work with a forward-thinking, ethical, and fun group of people and to develop and grow your skills in a fast-moving business

Our typical Recruitment Process looks like this:

  • 1st Interview with someone from the Talent team (30/45 mins)

  • Meet and discuss with a Client Partner (15/30mins)

We live and breathe our values, and know you will too:

  • Winning together

We’re an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. title: Senior Verification Engineer (CPU group)
description:
Job Overview:

This is a great opportunity for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Engineer to join Arm’s CPU team in Cambridge. The role involves working on the next generation of CPU products.

You will build and refine simulation-focused verification environments for future CPU IP, working in close collaboration with design and verification teams. You will be able to affect both design and verification decisions and assist in shaping technology used in billions of devices worldwide.

As CPU designs become increasingly complex, robust and efficient verification is essential to delivering high-quality products. You will apply and evolve modern simulation-based verification methodologies to address complicated problems, improve verification effectiveness, and push the boundaries of CPU verification.

Responsibilities:

We are seeking a Senior Verification Engineer who can contribute throughout all stages of the CPU verification lifecycle. Responsibilities include:

  • Take ownership for verification in a particular area of the CPU, covering everything from unit-level testbench development to the complete verification approach.
  • Deliver functional verification to agreed quality standards and project schedules.
  • Develop test plans, verification strategies, and coverage goals.
  • Work closely with project leads and management on planning, scheduling, and quality checkpoints.
  • Use data-driven analysis to assess verification progress, coverage, and product quality.
  • Contribute to verification methodology and productivity improvements across the CPU group and wider Arm verification community.
  • Investigate, debug, and drive root-cause analysis of issues identified throughout the verification process.

Required Skills and Experience :

  • Experience building verification environments for sophisticated RTL designs.
  • Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog and scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Tcl.
  • Proven grasp of the complete verification process, starting from test planning and continuing through to verification closure.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex specifications and translate them into effective verification scenarios.
  • Strong understanding of computer architecture fundamentals, including pipelining, exception handling, and memory systems.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to a range of audiences.

“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :

  • Solid knowledge of Arm architecture.
  • Experience with verification methodologies such as UVM or equivalent experience.
  • Programming experience in C/C++ and Python.
  • Practical experience verifying microprocessor or CPU designs.
  • Understanding of constrained-random stimulus, functional coverage, checking methodologies, and behavioural reference models.
  • Experience conducting detailed technical reviews of verification or design work.
  • Interest in applying AI tools and techniques to improve engineering productivity.

In Return:

Arm is a global community of dedicated, creative engineers united by a shared mission: to design technology that enables innovation and shapes the future.

We cultivate an inclusive, dynamic, and merit-based culture, where everyone can learn, grow, and make an impact.

Our hybrid working model supports flexibility. It encourages in-person collaboration for creative problem-solving. It also gives you autonomy to balance work and life in a way that suits you best.

Your unique perspective and contributions will help drive Arm’s success in the global marketplace.

Additional Information:

Please note that no relocation package is available for this role.

If skilled worker sponsorship is required, Arm will meet costs associated with sponsorship for the employer only. All fees associated with the individual’s application e.g. visa application fee and Immigration Health Surcharge, will be the responsibility of the successful candidate.

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm:

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application, and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you.

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com. To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed to the extent necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process.

Hybrid Working

Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. title: Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to fueling decisions with expert insights. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.

1. Role Summary

The AI Implementation Analyst is a hands-on, early-career technical role within the AI Implementation team inside Private Markets Strategy. Working under the AI Implementation Lead and alongside Senior Analysts, you will help build, test, and maintain the AI-powered systems that make Third Bridge's research faster to produce, cleaner, and easier to use. It is an ideal first or second role for someone who is technically strong, genuinely curious about applied machine learning and large language model (LLM) workflows, and eager to learn how AI is deployed in a fast-moving commercial environment.

You will work on real production problems from day one, not synthetic exercises. Over your first 12 to 24 months you will develop depth in one or more of the team's core workstreams and will be coached closely by the Senior Analysts and the Lead. Strong performers progress toward the Senior Analyst level.

2. What You Will Do

  • Write clean, readable Python to gather, clean, and prepare data from internal sources for use in machine learning and LLM pipelines.
  • Build and iterate on prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and lightweight evaluation harnesses under the direction of a Senior Analyst or the Lead.
  • Maintain and improve existing internal tools and integrations — fixing bugs, extending functionality, and keeping systems running as requirements evolve.
  • Help move promising prototypes toward stable, repeatable production systems, in partnership with our Technology, Product, and Data teams.
  • Support diagnosis of data-quality issues and propose practical fixes within the constraints of internal systems.
  • Contribute to documentation, testing, and quality assurance across the team's active builds.

3. What This Role Is Not

  • Not a research or academic data science role. The emphasis is on deployment and integration, not novel model development.
  • Not a fully autonomous role. You will work within scoped tasks defined by a Senior Analyst or the Lead, with close coaching and structured feedback.
  • Not a slides or reporting role. The primary output is working code and reliable, maintained systems.

4. What You Bring

  • 0–2 years of experience in a technical, analytical, or engineering role. Recent graduates in computer science, engineering, statistics, or a related quantitative field are welcome.
  • Working proficiency in Python, with comfort handling data (for example pandas) and calling APIs. Exposure to LLMs or prompt engineering is a strong plus but not essential — aptitude and curiosity matter more.
  • Sound fundamentals in data structures and clean coding habits, and a willingness to write tests and documentation.
  • A pragmatic, problem-solving mindset: happy to work within messy real-world constraints and iterate quickly.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the humility to ask questions early and take feedback well.
  • Genuine interest in how AI creates commercial value in a research and expert-network business.

5. How You Will Be Measured

  • Quality and reliability of the code and tooling you own or contribute to.
  • Rate of learning — how quickly you move from supervised tasks to owning small pieces of a workstream.
  • Consistency, responsiveness, and how well you collaborate with Senior Analysts and cross-functional partners.

6. Career Path

The natural progression is to Senior Analyst, typically after 18 to 24 months in role, subject to performance, demonstrated ownership of at least one production-grade component, and evidence of independent problem-solving.

Additional information

Why work for us?

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
  • Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
  • Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
  • Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
  • Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
  • Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
  • Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
  • CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
  • Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

title: Senior Project Manager – Software Delivery
description:
If you enjoy managing software projects, coordinating work across different teams and keeping delivery on track, this role offers plenty of variety. MaxSoft is a remote-first Australian software company supporting the strata management industry. We are looking for someone who is experienced in software project delivery, steady under pressure, clear in communication and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical teams.

This role combines software project delivery, internal business projects and process improvement. You will work closely with product owners, business analysts, developers, testers, support teams and leaders to ensure projects are properly planned, progress is clearly communicated and risks are addressed early.

This is a newly created role reporting to the Managing Director, and you would be our first dedicated project manager, shaping how projects are planned and delivered across the business from the ground up. The role has no direct reports and will cover a broad mix of work, from smaller operational improvements and software enhancements through to larger cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives. Some projects may involve coordinating a handful of contributors, while others may span multiple teams and business areas.

About Us

We are a certified Great Place to Work for 2024, 2025 and 2026, with a culture grounded in collaboration, learning and autonomy. Our remote-first model allows all employees to work from home, with the option to hot desk at our Varsity Lakes office for those living locally. We focus on practical support, flexibility and meaningful professional development.

What the role involves

Project Planning and Delivery

  • Manage software development and internal business projects from kick-off through to release or implementation.

  • Projects may range from small enhancements and process improvements through to larger software initiatives involving multiple teams.

  • Work with product owners, business analysts, developers and stakeholders to agree on project scope, objectives and success measures.

  • Build and maintain project plans, timelines, resource requirements and delivery schedules.

  • Coordinate project activities across development, testing, support and other areas of the business.

  • Manage dependencies and coordinate work across multiple projects, escalating priority conflicts where required.

  • Monitor progress against agreed milestones and address delays, risks and blockers early.

  • Support the release and rollout of new software features, enhancements and system changes.

Project Coordination and Communication

  • Maintain a clear and accurate register of projects underway across MaxSoft.

  • Apply the level of project planning, documentation and oversight appropriate to the size, risk and complexity of each project.

  • Maintain accurate project plans, status reports, risk registers and decision records.

  • Facilitate project meetings, planning sessions, reviews and stakeholder updates as required.

  • Provide clear updates to leadership on project status, timelines, resourcing and risks.

  • Ensure changes to project scope, priorities or timelines are documented and communicated.

  • Present project information and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Participate in occasional client or external stakeholder discussions where project delivery input is required.

Leadership and Continuous Improvement

  • Provide leadership to project teams and contributors without direct reporting authority.

  • Build strong working relationships across product, development, testing, support and other areas of the business.

  • Guide contributors, follow up agreed actions and work with stakeholders to keep projects moving.

  • Promote accountability, collaboration and clear communication within project teams.

  • Identify opportunities to improve project delivery, reporting, tools and ways of working.

  • Assist team members in understanding and adopting improved project practices.

  • Use AI tools appropriately to support project planning, delivery, reporting and administration.

  • This is a hands-on role where you'll be expected to coordinate delivery, follow up actions, solve problems and keep momentum across projects rather than simply report on project status.

What you bring

  • Senior-level project management experience in software development, SaaS, technology or a similar environment.

  • Experience managing software or technology projects from initial planning through to release or implementation.

  • A healthy balance of business understanding and technical knowledge.

  • Confidence working with product owners, business analysts, developers, testers and other technical specialists.

  • The ability to manage multiple projects, changing priorities and competing deadlines.

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.

  • The ability to build effective working relationships and influence people who do not report directly to you.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making and prioritisation skills.

  • The ability to identify project risks early and take appropriate action.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.

  • High attention to detail and a resilient approach in a fast-paced environment.

  • The ability to learn quickly across different products, technologies and business areas.

  • Experience establishing or improving project delivery processes, tools and reporting.

  • Confidence using AI tools to support project management and delivery.

  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

Experience in strata management, property services or property technology would also be beneficial but is not required.

Eligibility and Additional Information

Applicants must be Australian Citizens or Permanent Residents living in Australia.

Because our software supports trust account and financial processes in the strata industry, MaxSoft has obligations under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act. Background screening is therefore a condition of employment, and may include identity verification, reference checks, criminal history checks, immigration checks, verification of academic qualifications and bankruptcy checks.

What you can expect:

  • A remote-first work environment that supports work-life balance.

  • A varied role combining software project delivery, internal business projects and process improvement.

  • The opportunity to contribute to how projects are planned and managed across MaxSoft.

  • A supportive team environment with access to experienced technical and business professionals.

  • Opportunities to broaden your knowledge of software development, business operations and the strata management industry.

  • The opportunity to work closely with experienced leaders and contribute directly to how projects and initiatives are delivered across the business.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a cover letter via SEEK, detailing your experience and how your skills align with this role. Highlight your experience managing software or technology projects, coordinating work across multiple teams and improving project delivery processes.

If you’re passionate about software project delivery and enjoy combining planning, communication and problem-solving, we’d love to hear from you.

Join MaxSoft Group and be part of a high-performing team shaping the future of body corporate and strata management.

Apply now to join our team and be part of the exciting future of MaxSoft Pty Ltd.

(Pro Tip: only applications supported by a cover letter will be viewed)

title: Senior Financial Crime Investigator - Business Banking
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

UK Remote | 💰 £31,100 - £39,350 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Hear from the team ✨

⭐ About our Senior Financial Crime Business Banking Investigator Team

The Senior Financial Crime Business Banking Investigator team serves as Monzo’s frontline defence against complex economic crime, safeguarding our ecosystem and customers, from startups to established SMEs, against sophisticated fraud and money laundering. Operating within a specialised, risk-focused "Pillar," this critical operational team builds deep subject matter expertise to ensure financial integrity across the entire customer lifecycle. The team is responsible for conducting rigorous onboarding and ongoing compliance checks, unravelling complex financial crime typologies, and directly mitigating risk through thorough investigation, reporting, and account closures.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

  • Taking ownership of the most complex FinCrime Business Banking tasks, including Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) for high-risk businesses, Complex Customer Reviews (e.g., sensitive areas like Sexual Services flags), and multi-jurisdictional money muling investigations.
  • Writing, reviewing, and submitting high-quality Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) to the National Crime Agency (NCA), ensuring they meet the highest legal and evidential standards.
  • Maintaining a regular schedule on core investigative tasks to sustain your competency levels, directly support the domain’s Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and remain connected to frontline challenges.
  • Actively coaching Investigators on complex financial crime typologies, best practice, and performance improvement to help drive a culture of excellence.
  • Working closely with our Operations Analysts to share emerging trends and ensure that operational guidance is continuously updated and effectively embedded across the domain.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...

  • You have deep KYB & AML expertise, with significant experience conducting end-to-end business due diligence (KYB/EDD) and complex investigations within a regulated financial setting.
  • You are a skilled researcher, with a proven ability to leverage open-source intelligence and analysis to thoroughly corroborate customer profiles and transactional activity.
  • You know regulations and typologies, possessing a strong grasp of UK and international financial crime trends affecting business accounts and the UK SAR regime.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, maintaining high flexibility and adapting positively to shifting priorities, new guidance, and process changes at short notice.
  • You are impact-driven, with a genuine desire to protect Monzo and its customers by making a tangible difference in the detection and prevention of financial crime.
  • You bring leadership and improvement skills, ideally with experience mentoring peers, a track record of escalating process improvements, or a relevant qualification (such as ICA or ACAMS).

⏰ Shifts you’ll be working

You will work 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, from 9:00am to 5:30pm. You will also work one full weekend (Saturday and Sunday) once every 4 weeks, with 2 set days in lieu provided when working the weekend shift.

We cannot approve any time off during your first 6 weeks of employment with us due to training.

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 Salary range of £31,100 - £39,350 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

🎂 We guarantee to approve time off on your birthday if it falls on a scheduled work day (outside of your training period).

📍 This role is fully remote and based within the UK.

📚 A £1,000 annual budget to spend on books, training courses, and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up for success from home; all employees are provided with MacBooks, and fully remote workers receive extra support for their work-from-home environment.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  1. Application questions – Please take the time to answer these, as we read every single one.
  2. Recruiter call – A 30-minute video call to assess skills fit
  3. Hiring Manager interview – A 60-minute video call focusing on values and technical questions.

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation


At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. Job Overview:

We are currently looking to hire a Lead Data Analyst within the Enterprise Data and Information Services team, which is a part of LPL’s Technology organization. This position is responsible for providing data expertise in one or more data domains. The individual in this role will establish and promote a deep understanding and awareness of data in the specific domain, serve as a lead data analyst and data champion on data projects, and adhere to an enterprise-wide data governance framework to achieve the highest level of consistency, quality, and protection of data.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the definition, documentation, and management of data requirements, business rules, and data standards for assigned enterprise data domains.

  • Conduct data analysis and data profiling activities to identify data quality issues, validate business requirements, and support data management initiatives.

  • Partner with Data Stewards, Data Owners, business stakeholders, and technology teams to establish and maintain authoritative data sources and ensure alignment with enterprise data standards.

  • Develop and maintain key data management artifacts, including data lineage documentation, data mappings, data dictionaries, business glossaries, and data catalogs.

  • Collaborate with Enterprise Data Modelers and technology teams to create and enhance conceptual and logical data models that align with the Enterprise Data Model.

title: Project Manager, Account Production (Internal)
description:
The Project Manager, Account Production (Internal), will successfully plan, coordinate, and execute internal projects and event-related deliverables. This position partners closely with the Project Management (PM) team, cross-functional departments, and, when necessary, external clients and vendors to ensure seamless project execution and adherence to established timelines.

Key Contributions of the Role

  • Maintain and track the Event Production inbox with oversight from the Manager, Account Production (AP).
  • Create and track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones to ensure timely completion.
  • Provide overflow support to the Account Service Representative (ASR) and Sponsorship teams on day-to-day logistical planning and execution of event needs.
  • Partner with Account Executives (AEs) and Operations teams to prepare and maintain required event data and on-site documentation.
  • Manage pre-show planning activities for trade shows, including oversight of in-house, special, and custom event projects.
  • Communicate professionally with vendors and external partners, coordinating services such as electrical, audiovisual, and rigging needs.
  • Facilitate project meetings, document outcomes, and follow up on action items to drive accountability.
  • Fulfill requests related to structural design, graphic design, floor plans, technical issues, and writing work orders as directed by the AP Management team.
  • Assist with financial tracking, including pre- and post-show budget activities, KPI reporting, and show analysis as needed.
  • Assist exhibitors while placing orders for posters or custom booth upgrades (exclusive of Exhibits upgrades), following the department’s SOPs for use of ExhibitorPro and/or Salesforce.
  • Oversee inventory management and storage operations, ensuring accurate tracking of materials, shipments, and on-site logistics.
  • Provide on-site event support and coverage during peak periods or team absences.
  • Support planning and execution for internal AP departmental functions.

Requirements

  • Minimum 2-4 years of experience in project management, event coordination, or a related field.
  • Demonstrate professionalism and deliver a high level of service in all internal and external interactions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Technology-driven mindset, with the ability to research and implement process improvements that drive efficiency, leveraging company-approved AI solutions such as Copilot, Claude, and Perplexity.

title: Compliance Program Manager
description:
We are currently seeking a Compliance Program Manager to join our team of highly qualified professionals that share our mission of Empowering Children to Conquer their World!

  • 15 Days of Paid Time Off

What you will do:

The Compliance Program Lead will be instrumental in planning, implementing, maintaining, and administering a system-wide compliance program for Pediatrics Plus, ensuring adherence to healthcare regulations, including HIPAA, billing codes, and internal policies. They will proactively monitor potential compliance risks, develop and implement preventative measures, and foster a culture of compliance to protect the practice, its clients, and stakeholders. The Compliance Program Lead will empower teams to prioritize compliance as a business enabler, promote ethical behavior at all levels, and ensure seamless integration of compliance practices into day-to-day operations. The Compliance Program Lead will also provide strategic guidance to ensure compliance practices align with the growth goals of Pediatrics Plus while mitigating risk.

Regulatory Compliance and Governance

  • Ensures adherence to all healthcare regulations, including HIPAA, HITECH Act, OSHA, Stark Law, and federal/state requirements for pediatric practices.
  • Under the guidance and direction of the Chief Legal Officer and Compliance Committee, the Compliance Program Lead will develop and implement strategies to ensure ongoing compliance with evolving healthcare laws and regulations.
  • Coordinates internal and external compliance audits and inspections and as designated by the Chief Legal Officer, serves as a point of contact with regulatory agencies.

Compliance Program Administration

  • Under the direction of the Chief Legal Officer and Compliance Committee, develops, maintains, monitors, and continuously improves a comprehensive compliance framework, including policies, procedures, and standards aligned with healthcare regulations and best practices.
  • Establishes governance structures to ensure compliance initiatives are effectively monitored and reported.
  • Conducts regular evaluations of compliance programs to identify areas for improvement.
  • Assists the Chief Legal Officer in developing the annual Compliance Work Plan and is responsible for coordinating and tracking implementation of approved work plan activities.

HIPAA and Data Privacy Oversight

  • Develops policies to safeguard Protected Health Information (PHI) and ensure full compliance with HIPAA and other privacy regulations.
  • Leads investigations into data breaches or privacy violations and implements corrective actions.
  • Conducts regular team member training on privacy practices, data security, and the importance of protecting patient information.

Billing, Coding, and Documentation Compliance

  • Monitors and reviews billing processes to ensure accurate coding and compliance with payer requirements.
  • Conducts internal compliance audits to detect errors, prevent fraud, and improve the accuracy of claims submissions or other regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborates with the operations, billing, and finance teams to implement corrective actions for discrepancies.

Risk Management and Incident Response

  • Identifies, assesses, and proactively mitigates compliance risks across Pediatrics Plus.
  • Reports and investigates compliance concerns, including anonymous reporting channels.
  • Conducts and documents investigations into compliance incidents and, as appropriate, recommends corrective and preventive measures to mitigate risk of recurrence.

Team Member Training and Culture Building

  • Develops and delivers ongoing education and training programs for clinical and administrative team members on compliance topics, including regulatory changes, HIPAA, billing, and ethical behavior.
  • Fosters a culture of integrity, accountability, and transparency within Pediatrics Plus.
  • Ensures all team members understand their responsibilities regarding compliance and the ethical standards of Pediatrics Plus.

Compliance Audits and Assessments

  • Designs and implements routine and targeted audits to monitor compliance with internal policies and external regulations.
  • Prepares reports on audit findings and presents recommendations for corrective actions.

Performance Reporting and Continuous Improvement:

  • Develops metrics to track the effectiveness of compliance initiatives and regularly reports results to senior leadership and stakeholders.
  • Stays abreast of industry trends and emerging risks, incorporating them into proactive compliance strategies.
  • Leads efforts to continuously improve compliance processes, leveraging technology and best practices for greater efficiency.

General

  • Participates in one-on-one meetings with leader.
  • May perform other related and non-related duties, as assigned.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

What you have:

  • In-depth knowledge of HIPAA regulations, healthcare billing practices, and federal/state healthcare laws.
  • Experience conducting audits, risk assessments, and investigations.
  • Proven ability to communicate compliance concepts to both clinical and administrative team members.
  • Strong business acumen and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate vision into actionable plans and initiatives.
  • Strategic problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on driving results and continuous improvement.
  • Strong organizational and leadership skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • High level of integrity and commitment to confidentiality.
  • Travel may be required.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree, required.
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare compliance or a related field; experience in pediatrics or clinical healthcare, preferred.
  • Certification in healthcare compliance (CHC) or similar credential, preferred.

Physical Demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the team member is frequently required to accurately communicate information and ideas so others will understand through sight and hearing. The team member is regularly required to move including walking, running, jumping, and sitting. The team member is regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle, lift, reach, and feel. The team member is frequently required to stand and stoop, twist, bend, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The team member must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. If the team member is working at a Farm location, they must be comfortable around standard farm animals, including minimal allergies to touching, smelling, feeding, and engaging with animals.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Location: Lisbon,Lisbon,Portugal

Overview:

The IT Business Analyst will manage the complete lifecycle of a requirement, from initial specification to final delivery for the end user. The Business Analyst will work mainly in an Agile environment, driving iterations, managing backlogs, and ensuring that software meets both technical and business standards through rigorous testing.

This Business Analyst will work on a project focused on the evolution of third-party data ecosystems, aiming to streamline the integration of new data and technologies such as data virtualization, APIs, etc., enhancing the accessibility and real-time availability of data across systems.

The Business Analyst will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and the development team, ensuring business needs are accurately captured, analyzed, and translated into clear functional requirements. The role involves gathering information from multiple sources, facilitating workshops to align stakeholders, and understanding and writing business processes, requirements, and design phasing.

Furthermore, the Business Analyst will work closely with developers to clarify requirements, define acceptance criteria, validate solutions, and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Additionally, the role plays a key part in testing activities. This includes defining the test strategy, preparing complex test scenarios for Integration System Testing (IST) to ensure data flows correctly between providers and outputs, and coordinating both Functional Testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

Using tools like ALM Octane and Jira, the Business Analyst will manage defect tracking and assist end users throughout the validation process to ensure a successful deployment and adoption of the solution.

What will you do?

  • Requirements Gathering & Management: Manage workshops and interviews to elicit, analyze and document detailed Business Requirements. Translate high-level needs into clear functional/technical specifications (User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Maps) while managing and prioritizing the product backlog against the MVP.
  • Process Analysis & Optimization: Analyze current ("As-Is") business processes to design efficient future-state ("To-Be") workflows. Identify bottlenecks, gaps and opportunities for automation or digital transformation to improve time-to-market and operational efficiency.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary bridge between business units and IT/Development teams. Manage stakeholder expectations regarding project scope and timelines, and present complex technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Own the testing lifecycle, including defining test strategies, writing complex IST (Integration) scenarios for data flows/APIs, and performing regression testing. Manage the full defect lifecycle and ensure requirements are successfully validated by end-users.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Perform deep analysis of data ecosystems to investigate quality issues, identify root causes of inconsistencies, and utilize data-driven insights to validate business assumptions and measure the success of implemented solutions.

What are we looking for?

  • Requirements & Process Modeling: Proficiency in gathering and documenting requirements using User Stories, Use Cases, and Business Rules. Expert in process modeling (eg.: BPMN, UML) to visualize workflows and identify system impact/gaps.
  • Agile Product Management: Advanced expertise in Agile methodologies, including backlog refinement, sprint management, and strict prioritization of features to ensure the delivery of the Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
  • Testing & Quality Engineering: Deep knowledge of the testing lifecycle, specifically in designing complex Integration System Testing (IST) for APIs/interfaces and leading User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Experienced in defect management and ensuring full traceability from requirement to test case.
  • Systems & Data Integration Analysis: Strong understanding of application architecture, system interfaces, data flows, and integration patterns (e.g., APIs, Data Virtualization). Ability to analyze data quality and ensure consistency across multiple REFERENTIALS data sources.
  • Software & Tooling Mastery: Proficiency in ALM Octane (for requirement-to-test traceability and defect management), Jira (for task/backlog tracking), and Confluence (for documentation and collaboration).
  • English ➔ Expert (mandatory)
  • IT - Business/IT relationship
  • Good oral and written communication skills
  • Creativity & Innovation / Problem solving
  • Ability to understand functional requests from end users, explain and support change
  • Ability to collaborate/Teamwork
  • Attention to detail / rigor
  • Educational background: Information Technology & Computer Science / Information Systems or Business Management;
  • More than 3 years of Experience as a Business Analyst or a similar role (within IT environment);
  • Professional experience in Referential administration (data management, database).

What can you expect from us?

  • A permanent job contract for a long term project;
  • Tech equipment + SIM Card + personal smartphone;
  • Health and Life Insurance;
  • Social events and team buildings;
  • The commitment of letting you grow with us, and be rewarded accordingly;
  • A dynamic and young team that will be always there to support you;
  • Training in the latest technologies;
  • Coffee, fruits, snacks and a warm welcoming when you pass by the office.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who embeds directly with our most strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption. You will collaborate closely with customer teams to ship advanced AI applications that solve real world business problems. Our FDEs engage with customers to accelerate the adoption of existing products and create new applications built on our models.

Working closely with our Post-Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll combine engineering expertise, an understanding of frontier AI applications, and customer-facing skills to understand customer workflows and develop innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and serve as one of our founding FDEs who helps to shape our forward-deployed motion. We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive under ambiguity, and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. This is a significant responsibility: you’ll play a key role in championing our mission in the enterprise.

Responsibilities
  • Work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, ensuring that these products meet customer requirements.
  • Deliver technical artifacts for customers like MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills that will be used in production workflows.
  • Provide white glove deployment support for Anthropic products in enterprise environments.
  • Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks.
  • Build long term relationships with customers and proactively identify new opportunities for AI deployment throughout the lifecycle of an engagement.
  • Travel frequently (25-50%) to customer sites to build in person with customers.
  • Be a champion for Anthropic’s mission in the field.


You May Be a Good Fit If You Have
  • 4+ years of experience in a technical, customer facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, or as a Software Engineer with consulting experience. Former technical founders are also encouraged to apply.
  • Native French speaker with fluent English proficiency
  • Production experience with LLMs including advanced prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale.
  • Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python (and ideally in one or more additional languages like TypeScript, Java, etc) and experience shipping production applications
  • High agency with an ability to navigate ambiguity present in complex organizations.
  • High cooperation mindset for cross-organizational collaboration, balancing competing priorities with integrity.
  • Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications.
  • Strong communication skills to conduct discovery with customers and to convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders while maintaining a low ego and collaborative approach.
  • A background in financial services, healthcare/life sciences, or another enterprise vertical is a plus.
  • Experience with enterprise IT systems and/or AI deployment patterns is a plus.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Campaign Organizer- Norfolk, NE
description:
Campaign Organizer- Nebraska

Location and Timeline: We are hiring a full-time Campaign Organizer to begin by the end of August and continue through Election Day. The locations are Scottsbluff, North Platte, Grand Island, Hastings, Alliance, Chadron, and Norfolk. This will expand over the program, so if you are a Nebraskan who lives further away, please still apply!

Who We Are: The Outreach Team is the national engine of campaigners and organizers building a fairer, cleaner, safer, and more peaceful world. We invest in people at every level with industry-leading pay/benefits, rigorous training and support and real paths to leadership.


General Overview:
Neighbor, it’s your time to step up for Nebraska. We need your love for our state and its people, your skills earned from years of hard work, and your ability to connect with other Nebraskans. Frankly, it’s the only way we are going to pry back our government and economy from the billionaires who have taken over. The good news is that there are more of us than there are of them. We just need to harness our power… conversation by conversation, on every porch, corner, driveway, sidewalk, field, and farm in Nebraska. And we need you to lead the charge. Join us on behalf of the Working Class Majority Pac.

We are looking for Organizers to talk to voters about Dan Osborn’s run for Senate in Nebraska’s upcoming election. If you believe that real political power is built from the ground up through deep organizing and face-to-face conversations, we want you on our team in Omaha and Lincoln, Nebraska
Organizers will be charged with recruiting, training, and working with a team of volunteers in key counties in Nebraska. The Organizer will start by building and recruiting a team of supporters and volunteers around canvassing. From there, Organizers will continue to engage volunteers through a series of campaign events and actions.

What You’ll Do:

  • Recruit and Train a Community of Volunteer Activists
  • Call and text supporters and recruit them into grassroots actions.
  • Identify new supporters and volunteers by knocking doors, gathering petitions, flyering, and conducting in-field recruitment efforts in the community and on local campuses
  • Run grassroots skills trainings to develop effective campaigners among volunteers.
  • Keep meticulous track of a volunteer list so that no potential volunteer falls through the cracks.
  • Represent the campaign through participation in community spaces and events, while engaging and uplifting coalition and partner organizations.

Generate Campaign Actions

  • Gather over a thousand petitions from the community in support of key campaign issues
  • Generate hundreds of additional actions targeting key Members of Congress with a particular focus on social media posts, phone calls, postcards, and photo petitions.
  • Recruit and train volunteers to generate more petitions and volunteer engagement at events.
  • Recruit and engage with community leaders, organizational partners, and VIPs to build meaningful relationships while generating new supporters, volunteers, and event attendees.
  • Register voters in key Iowa districts
  • Generate hundreds of new voter registrations in key Iowa counties
  • Maintain strong QC systems for ensuring compliance with VR laws and rules

Organize High-Volume Visibility Events

  • Organize and execute exciting, high-visibility in-person events demonstrating support for climate, jobs, and justice.
  • Educate community members about historical climate investments and the urgency of continued actions.
  • Nail 100% of all messaging and legal requirements and ensure that volunteers do the same.
  • Manage Digital Campaign, Data Management, and Reporting Tools
  • Demonstrate public support by recruiting volunteers to post on their own social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter.
  • Use peer-to-peer texting services and relational organizing tools to communicate with community members.
  • Send timely and compelling email campaigns to recruit activists to campaign activities.
  • Track every interaction with detailed notes in order to report numbers daily and write weekly reports on the results of the campaign.

Who You Are & Keys to Success (the must-haves):

To be successful in this job, you will excel in these areas:

  • Relationship Building: You develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with a diverse group of local and statewide community members. You are attentive and empathetic to the communities we serve, regardless of race, ethnicity, class, gender, or ability, and can identify shared values across communities for collective growth. You can build authentic relationships through authenticity and reliability, continuously uplifting others and their goals. You are comfortable and experienced in public speaking to a group about environmental, jobs, health care issues and climate change.

  • Inclusive and Collaborative Leadership: You approach leadership with a “power with” mindset that recognizes the impact power hierarchies have in different settings. You can learn from others, see and hear other perspectives, and step in or step back as necessary. You are reliable and accountable, always transparent about your abilities, capacities, and expectations. You honor the time and commitments of others while inspiring them to meet goals.

  • Commitment to Equity and Inclusion: You have a proven ability to develop meaningful connections with diverse communities, including a wide range of community organizations, community leaders, and community members. You work with the community and within the workplace to identify areas of improvement for a more equitable environment. You take continued action and efforts to improve your REI knowledge, skills, and tools.
  • Drive to Achieve Results: You have experience accomplishing ambitious goals and getting results, even when there are obstacles. You have the experience or ability to plan backwards to meet multiple goals timely and effectively. When there are unexpected changes, you bounce back and adjust quickly, learning and improving from any mistakes.


Must be able to drive, have a valid drivers license, and also you will need to meet our driver authorization standards

  • Skills and Experiences we Expect of all Outreach Team employees:
  • Commitment to equity and justice.
  • Experience bringing a lens of inclusivity to all of your interactions with colleagues and community members.
  • Passion for the role that your work plays in creating change in the world.
  • Kindness and consideration for others.
  • Drive to work collaboratively: learning from others; stepping-in or stepping-back when needed.
  • Transparency: comfort admitting what you do and don’t know, your capacity, and abilities.
  • Task management: Able to adapt to the evolving needs of a project. Able to tackle big-picture projects and break them down into smaller pieces.
  • Organized and efficient: Experience or demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects or goals at once in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Acute attention to detail: Track interactions and tasks with detailed notes. Plans ahead for roadblocks and bounces back quickly when problems arise.
  • Effective communication skills (written or spoken) that are clear, concise and honest.
  • Comfortable and excited to speak about the campaign publicly.
  • Coach and learning mentality: successful experience or willingness to learn new things and pick up new skills on the job. Able to learn from mistakes and try again.
  • Understanding of how your words and actions affect others, including an awareness of power language and communication accessibility.
  • Ability to work weekends and weekday evenings, occasional holidays.

Nice-to-Haves, but Not Required:

  • Organizing experience within or around Iowa.
  • Experience working for nonprofits and issue campaigns.
  • Data Management and Evaluation Experience: Experience working with various data management systems and tools, mainly Google Suite.
  • Experience with Relevant Campaign Tools and Technologies: VAN, Action Network, ThruText, MailChimp, eCRMs like EveryAction, or social media tools (Twitter, Facebook, Instagram).
  • Event or Project Planning & Management, Implementation or Evaluation.
  • Knowledge or previous experience working on this issue is a plus, but not required.


If you were here right now, you would be:

  • Recruiting, training and developing activist leaders in your community to collect supporter petitions, educate others on key campaign issues, and recruit constituents to in-district events and actions.
  • Planning and executing events around corporate accountability, climate action, and health care including, but not limited to: door knocking, phonebanking, petitioning, visibility events, educational events, and more.
  • Developing relationships with community and campus leaders on corporate accountability, health care, and justice for collaborative recruitment, event planning, and power building.
  • Engaging and expanding our support network through public visibility actions, voter outreach, and relationship-building.

Salary, Benefits and Perks:
The salary for this position is $55,000 to $67,000 for full-time at 50 hours per week.

title: DevOps Engineer (w/m/d) - Google Cloud Platform
description:
We use AI to accelerate – not to replace thinking.
We design the system, steer the output, and take responsibility for what we ship.
Fast where it makes sense. Careful where it matters.

Most companies treat DevOps as a ticket-system: „I need a database“, „My pipeline is broken“. That is not what we do at smartclip.

We don’t want a gatekeeper. We want a Platform Architect. Build an ecosystem where developers can ship code to production without friction, without fear, and without waiting for a ticket. Turn the infrastructure into a product. Make the platform invisible, scalable, and bulletproof.


Your Mission

  • Architect the Developer Experience: Design and automate platforms that empower our teams to move fast and ship with absolute confidence. Eliminate bottlenecks. Kill the friction.
  • Weaponise CI/CD: Integrate modern tooling into our pipelines. Ensure functional safety and reliability are baked into the process, not added as an afterthought.
  • Dominate the Cloud: Take full ownership of our GKE / Kubernetes infrastructure on Google Cloud. Shape it, evolve it, and push it to its limits.
  • Harden the Perimeter: Execute proactive security engineering. Hunt for vulnerabilities before the pen-testers do. Build a fortress, not a fence.
  • Scale the Future: Continuously evolve the platform. Make development faster, safer, and infinitely more scalable.

Requirements

  • Bring 5+ Years of Combat Experience: Prove your track record in DevOps engineering. Be a builder, not an observer.
  • Command the GCP Ecosystem: Master Google Cloud Platform. Work confidently with Kubernetes and Linux. Treat the cloud as your playground.
  • Code Your Infrastructure: Use Infrastructure as Code, Docker/CRI-O, and shell scripting as your primary weapons. If you have to do it twice, automate it.
  • Own the Stack End-to-End: Kill the ticket ping-pong. Stop the handovers. Take full responsibility from the first line of Terraform to the final production pod. No excuses.

Bonus XP

  • Leverage Graylog, Grafana, Prometheus, Python, or Jenkins to gain total observability.
  • Deploy with Ansible, Terraform, or AWS.

Team
