title: Editorial Innovation Intern
description:
Role Title: Editorial Innovation Intern
Department: Innovation Team
Company: Daily Mail / dmg media
Location: High Street Kensington, London, UK
Contract Type: Full-time Internship (2 months, with strong potential for permanent hire upon
successful completion)
Target Audience: Early-career candidates, current university students, or recent graduates

About the Role
The Daily Mail is seeking a tech-literate and forward-thinking Editorial Innovation Intern to join its cutting-edge Innovation Team. We are looking for an early-career journalist who is
genuinely excited about how new technology can enhance journalism and who wants to spend their days building systems in one of the world's biggest newsrooms. Or someone from a tech background who wants to pursue a career in media. High performers will learn future-facing skills and have a clear pathway to transition into a permanent full-time role.

The successful applicant will sit within the Innovation Team, a new team that designs, tests, and ships the AI tools journalists use daily. That work is delivered through Mail iQ, a suite of AI-powered tools which helps journalists across all aspects of their work. Successful applicants do not need a formal background in journalism. But they do need an interest in emerging technology, a passion for news, and a strong desire to learn new ways of telling stories. Experience and experimentation using LLMs, or forward-facing tech platforms/processes are desired.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI tool creation: Collaborate with the Innovation Team to design, test, and refine new AI agents and utilities within Mail iQ, dmg’s multi-agentic AI ecosystem.
  • Investigations and special projects: Work alongside other desks in the newsroom, such as the award-winning Deep Dive team, on flagship journalism projects to build custom datasets using AI by analysing complex records.
  • Content repurposing: Take existing Daily Mail reporting and use bespoke software to translate it into dynamic audio/visual formats, social assets, and other media for global distribution.
  • Newsroom integration: Work dynamically across the newsroom to engage with subbing, pictures, graphics, design, social media, and data desks to identify workflow friction and build solutions.
  • Journalist research & training: Continuously research new technological developments and translate them into useable information for the journalists. Help run hands-on training sessions to empower reporters and editors to adopt new tools effortlessly.
  • Editorial quality control: Ensure that every AI workflow strictly upholds the Daily Mail’s rigorous editorial standards, enforcing human-in-the-loop oversight where
    accuracy and quality always take priority over raw speed.

Essential Requirements

  • Early career status: A recent graduate, or in the early stages of a tech, media, or product career.
  • AI & tech fluency: A deep practical understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, and generative AI platforms.
  • Exceptional capability to learn, evaluate, and master new software and digital tools at speed.
  • Passion for News: A genuine interest in current affairs, pop culture, sport, global events, and the future of media.
  • Evidence of an interest in the intersection of technology and journalism: Preferably a portfolio of work showing a project, blog, GitHub, newsletter or side hustle that shows it.

Desirable Skills

  • AI-assisted coding: Familiarity with using AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to build quick scripts, web tools, or prototypes.
  • Data & visualisation: Experience with data analysis, Excel/Python, or creating interactive visual assets (charts, maps, timelines, graphics).
  • Workflow automation: Knowledge of building light automations or integrations (e.g., via APIs, Zapier, Make, or custom scripts).
  • Multimedia production: Basic editing skills in visual or audio software (Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Figma, or AI multimedia generators).
  • Clear communication: You will need to explain technical concepts to non-technical colleagues.

Not required

  • A journalism degree, an NCTJ, or prior newsroom experience.

What We Offer

  • Direct path to hire: Exceptional candidates will be considered for immediate, permanent, full-time placement upon completion of the internship.
  • Real newsroom impact: The tools you work on will help tell stories to millions of readers globally from week one.
  • Cutting-edge experience: Direct exposure to enterprise-level multi-agentic AI development in partnership with leading global technology providers such as Google, Microsoft and Amazon.
  • Mentorship: Work directly alongside the Innovation Director, Innovation Editor, and Innovation Engineers, alongside investigative journalists, data specialists, and software engineers.

How to apply
Send us a CV and a short covering note of 400 words telling us about one thing you have built, broken, automated or figured out with AI. You should also provide a bullet point list of ideas you think would provide the biggest benefit to the Daily Mail newsroom. Please include links to anything you've made or written: projects, repos, prototypes, visualisations, published work, or something you built for fun.

About Us

dmg media maintains an unwavering commitment to uncovering the stories that matter most. Its brands Daily Mail, The Mail on Sunday, Metro, The i Paper, MailOnline, and Mail+reach more than 9 million people daily in the UK.
Globally, dmg media’s brands reach 160 million unique browsers every month across its domains and apps.*

Its global newsroom of journalists, formidable story-getting power, and breadth of content formats, delivers highly engaging, trusted content to loyal and new audiences, 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

The Mail brand reaches three in five Brits every month and is officially the best-read, most recognised, most engaged newsbrand in the country. It is the largest news publisher on TikTok with over 28 million total followers and nearly 45 billion views** in the past year.

*GA Sept 2024 **March 2024 - Feb 2025 inclusive

Our Commitment

We are committed to increasing diversity and maintaining an inclusive workplace culture. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of their ethnicity, race, gender, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability.

We are Disability Confident Committed. Please let us know if you require any recruitment documentation in other formats or if you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process. Please be assured that any such information will be held separately to your recruitment application and will not be considered as part of the selection process.

As a trusted technical advisor, you'll work closely with Cisco Sales, channel partners, and customers to design, position, and implement Cisco's industry-leading Security portfolio while enabling partners to build long-term technical capabilities and deliver secure business outcomes.

Your Impact

  • Cisco Duo

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Technical Project Manager - Sim Center Team Lead
location: Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates; London, England, United Kingdom
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

At Anduril, we are developing unmanned systems for subsurface, surface, land, and air domains that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of multi-mission capability to our customers. In addition to the physical systems being produced, Anduril is providing training and experimentation services to our partners and customers. These projects require Warfighting Systems Analysts who can connect operational needs to system architecture, technical performance, integration choices, and mission-level outcomes. We are looking for our next Lead Warfighting Systems Analyst to join our rapidly growing team in Abu Dhabi, UAE. The candidate will first be hired into London, UK, before relocating upon completion of the center.

The Warfighter Simulation Team Lead is a project manager responsible for producing, iterating, and supporting Modeling, Simulation, and Analysis (M&SA) including wargaming and experimentation for Anduril products. This has a three-fold purpose: Train the customer in Anduril capabilities, conduct internal analysis to support the iterative improvement of current and future products, and learn the specific customers’ needs to ensure we produce the right product for the right reasons. As the team leader, you will need to serve as the fusion between analysts, wargamers, system administrators and engineers, and warfighters. You will be responsible for game design, systems, warfighter interactions, and a Agile team of wargaming analysts.

This role is ideal for individuals who can reason across military operations and technical systems, lead an interdisciplinary team, and communicate to key stakeholders while keeping the wargaming project on time and budget.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Serve as project manager for standing up a tactical wargaming center in the UAE
  • Develop scenarios based on customer needs to demonstrate capabilities
  • Design, execute, and analyze tactical (engagement-level and mission-level) analysis and wargames to assess autonomous system capabilities and refine tactics
  • Develop physics-based models and relevant operational scenarios, with an emphasis on modeling red and blue force systems and tactics
  • Assess system-of-systems interactions, integration risks, dependencies, constraints, and mission impacts
  • Lead the wargamers, system administrators, and operations personnel to ensure the center remains operational, providing training services to warfighters, who also participate in wargaming and training
  • Collaborate with engineering and business development teams to demonstrate Anduril's capabilities and value proposition through rigorous, data-driven analysis

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently possess and be able to maintain an active country specific Secret security clearance
  • 7+ years of experience in Operations Research, Systems Analysis (ORSA), systems engineering, mission engineering, test and evaluation, or a related technical-operational discipline
  • 4+ years of experience in project management, agile project management, SCRUM, KANBAN, etc.
  • Experience with tactical experiments and wargaming design, including scenario development, data analytics, and trade-space analysis
  • Ability to connect system performance, architecture, and design choices to mission outcomes
  • Ability to assess and solve problems, and to effectively communicate results through strong verbal and written skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a country specific Top Secret security clearance
  • Experience with DevOps, DevSecOps, and other hardware/software integrations
  • Operational military background with a subsequent transition into an ORSA, M&S, or Operations Analyst position
  • Familiarity with model-based systems engineering, digital engineering, operational test, or experimentation
  • Experience developing KPPs, KSAs, MOEs, MOPs, requirements, test objectives, or system performance assessments
  • Experience with defense systems, autonomous systems, maritime systems, undersea systems, sensors, effectors, communications, navigation, C2, or ISR mission systems

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Platform
description:
About Proton

Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

The team:

The DevOps Platform team builds, maintains and scales the developer tooling platform and infrastructure that hundreds of engineers at Proton rely on daily, across both on-premises and cloud environments. Security isn't an afterthought — it's a core constraint we design around.

What you will do:

  • Own and scale CI/CD infrastructure handling tens of thousands of jobs daily and growing — that means capacity planning, runner architecture, and making the platform reliable as load patterns shift in ways that don't follow simple rules
  • Deepen our GitOps workflows built on ArgoCD, from day-to-day operational improvements to more structural work on how we manage cluster state across environments
  • Advance our supply chain security posture — we've made deliberate investments in SAST and artifact attestation, and there's meaningful work ahead to see them through

title: Windows & Unix Engineer
description:
You’ve picked a great time to join Avon. We’re the company that puts purpose, people and relationships at the heart of everything we do. The company that’s 135 years young and only just getting started. As part of the Regent LP family, we’re committed to being the best beauty company for the world by generating a positive environmental, economic and social impact for our communities across the globe.

Role Type

Permanent

What you'll be doing:

As a Windows & Unix Engineer, you'll play a key role in ensuring the stability, security, and performance of Avon’s enterprise server environments across Windows, Linux, and AIX platforms. Working as part of our infrastructure support team, you'll provide Level 2 operational support, manage virtualised environments, maintain system compliance, and help keep critical business services running smoothly. You'll collaborate closely with application, network, storage, and security teams to resolve complex issues, support upgrades and migrations, and continuously improve the reliability and resilience of our technology landscape.

Key responsibilities:

  • Building, configuring, and maintaining Windows, Linux, and AIX servers, virtual machines, clusters, and related infrastructure.
  • Monitoring server and virtualisation platform health, performance, and availability, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
  • Executing operating system patching, kernel updates, and security remediation activities within agreed maintenance windows.
  • Investigating and resolving incidents related to server operating systems, authentication services, group policies, access controls, and application dependencies.
  • Supporting Active Directory domain integrations, authentication mechanisms, and access management controls.
  • Managing backup solutions, performing restore testing, and validating disaster recovery readiness.
  • Tracking end-of-life operating systems, platforms, and components, and supporting upgrade and migration projects.
  • Managing certificates, TLS configurations, SSH keys, and security-related settings to maintain compliance with organisational standards.
  • Diagnosing and resolving performance issues across CPU, memory, storage, network, and system resources.
  • Ensuring antivirus and endpoint detection tools are operating effectively and addressing identified gaps.
  • Collaborating with application, network, storage, and security teams to resolve cross-functional technical issues.
  • Implementing, maintaining, and optimising monitoring tools, dashboards, thresholds, and alerts to improve operational visibility.
  • Participating in disaster recovery exercises, failover testing, and recovery validation activities.
  • Maintaining accurate documentation, operational runbooks, system diagrams, asset records, and CMDB information.
  • Producing operational metrics and KPI reporting, including system availability, patch compliance, backup success rates, incident trends, and capacity insights.
  • Supporting continuous improvement initiatives, operational excellence activities, and infrastructure modernisation programmes.

What we're looking for:

  • Proven experience supporting enterprise Windows Server environments.
  • Experience administering Linux and/or AIX operating systems within large-scale production environments.
  • Strong understanding of virtualisation technologies, including virtual machine administration and platform support.
  • Hands-on experience with server monitoring, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and incident management.
  • Experience managing operating system patching, upgrades, migrations, and vulnerability remediation activities.
  • Knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, authentication services, and identity management concepts.
  • Experience supporting backup, restore, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes.
  • Familiarity with security best practices, server hardening standards, least-privilege principles, and compliance requirements.
  • Understanding of certificates, TLS configurations, SSH key management, and secure system administration practices.
  • Experience working with infrastructure monitoring and alerting tools.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across server, storage, network, and application layers.
  • Strong documentation skills, with experience maintaining operational procedures, runbooks, and CMDB records.
  • Experience working within ITIL-based support environments, including incident, problem, and change management processes.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • A proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and service excellence.

What we offer:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package along with wellness resources and work-life balance support in line with your country practices and Avon purpose aiming to help you live a healthier life, protect you and your dear ones, and ensure you’re at your best.

At Avon, we believe beauty is for everyone and that it’s beautiful to be you. We celebrate our differences, champion self-expression and are committed to inclusion for all. We embrace diversity and individuality to build a culture that represents our communities and enables everyone to bring their best self to work. We also support reasonable adjustments both within our recruitment process and job design when required to empower you to work in a way that works for you.

Ready to be a part of it? Join us.

title: Nasjonal leder Blå Kors barnas stasjon
description:
Blå Kors barnas stasjon er et av Blå Kors’ sentrale tilbud til barn og familier og er et gratis lavterskeltilbud for barn i alderen 0–16 år som vokser opp i familier med flere sårbarhetsfaktorer. Tilbudet skal bidra til trygghet, støtte og mestring for barn og familier som trenger et tilgjengelig og tillitsskapende tilbud i hverdagen.

Barnas stasjon er lokalisert i Oslo, Skien, Hamar, Trondheim, Askøy, Drammen, Kristiansand, Lister, Lindesnes og Fredrikstad. Høsten 2026 åpnes en ny avdeling i Oslo, på Søndre Nordstrand. I 2025 hadde Barnas stasjon en årlig omsetning på om lag 86 millioner og rundt 60 årsverk.

Nasjonal leder har det samlede ansvaret for Blå Kors barnas stasjon, herunder har direkte personalansvar for fem virksomhetsledere samt oppdragsansvar for ytelsene ved stasjonene i Fredrikstad, Kristiansand, Lister, Lindesnes og Drammen.

For nærmere informasjon se:

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Lede og videreutvikle Blå Kors barnas stasjon og sikre god økonomisk drift

  • I samarbeid med dine virksomhetsledere styrke våre tilbud og tjenester

  • Inspirere og tilrettelegge for et godt fag- og arbeidsmiljø i virksomhetene

  • Være en tydelig brobygger og pådriver for beste praksis på tvers

  • Videreutvikle samarbeidet med samarbeidspartnere og offentlige myndigheter

  • Proaktiv i forhold til strategiarbeid og samfunnsmessige endringer nasjonalt

  • Være en viktig og positiv bidragsyter inn i divisjonens ledergruppe

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Relevant utdanning på høyskole- eller universitetsnivå, fortrinnsvis på masternivå innen helse, sosialfag, barnevern, ledelse eller tilsvarende

  • Solid ledererfaring, gjerne fra ideell sektor, offentlig sektor eller virksomheter med komplekse rammebetingelser

  • God forståelse for økonomistyring, drift og resultatoppfølging

  • God samfunnsforståelse og innsikt i samspillet mellom fag, politikk, forvaltning og ideelle aktører

  • Kjennskap til barnevernsfaglig arbeid, forebyggende arbeid eller tjenester rettet mot barn, unge og familier

  • Erfaring med samarbeid med kommuner, direktorater eller andre offentlige oppdragsgivere vil være en fordel

Personlige egenskaper:

  • God arbeidskapasitet og evne til å stå godt i en bred og krevende lederrolle

  • Tydelig, trygg og relasjonssterk lederstil

  • Evne til å skape tillit, engasjement og retning sammen med medarbeidere og samarbeidspartnere

  • Godt overblikk, høy gjennomføringsevne og sans for presisjon

  • Evne til å kombinere strategisk utvikling med nærhet til praksisfeltet

  • Målrettet, løsningsorientert og fleksibel

  • Identifiserer seg med Blå Kors’ verdigrunnlag og samfunnsoppdrag

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfull nasjonal lederstilling med mulighet til å gjøre en forskjell for barn og familier

  • Ansvar for et viktig og synlig tilbud i Blå Kors, med mulighet til å påvirke videre utvikling og retning Del av en ambisiøs og kompetent ledergruppe

  • En fremoverlent ideell aktør med korte beslutningsveier og høy gjennomføringskraft

  • En veldrevet organisasjon med vekt på samhandling, læring, utvikling og endring

  • Nyoppussede kontorlokaler med sentral beliggenhet ved Oslo S.

  • Fleksibilitet, også når det gjelder arbeidssted. Oslo/Østlandet er ønskelig, men andre løsninger kan vurderes

  • Tariffavtale, pensjonsordning og lønn etter avtale

Søknadsfrist: 28.sept.

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

For nærmere informasjon gjerne kontakt vår samarbeidspartner Skagerak Consulting ved Jan Inge Hiorth tlf. 911 10 038, eller Blå Kors ved divisjonsdirektør Anita Ellefsen, tlf. 951 92 669.

I Blå Kors jobber vi med forebyggende tiltak, spesielt rettet mot barn og unge, samt behandling, oppfølging etter behandling og inkludering. Rus er en av våre største samfunnsutfordringer og Blå Kors har i over hundre år gjort en viktig innsats for å hjelpe personer som er direkte eller indirekte rammet. Blå Kors er en ideell aktør og eier og driver 62 virksomheter fordelt over store deler av Norge. Med nærmere 1600 dyktige medarbeidere, 1800 engasjerte frivillige og 1700 aktive medlemmer når vi langt ut. Vår organisasjon ønsker også å gjenspeile mangfoldet i befolkningen i vår rekruttering. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifiserte til å søke ledige stillinger uansett kjønn, alder, funksjonshemming og flerkulturell bakgrunn. Det samme gjelder dersom man har hatt et lengre opphold fra arbeidslivet.

Skagerak Consulting er et tverrfaglig miljø innen rekruttering og rådgivning. Vi jobber med å utvikle mennesker og organisasjoner for å skape varige forbedringer og verdier i offentlige og private virksomheter. Vårt arbeid er basert på en kombinasjon av dokumentert metodikk, praktisk erfaring og en god porsjon sunn fornuft.

title: Technical Data Engineer (d/m/w)
description:
Job Description:

Zur Unterstützung der Technischen Dokumentation an unserem Standort Donauwörth sucht Airbus Helicopters mit Fokus auf den Illustrierten Teilekatalog und die Ersatzteilkonfiguration der deutschen Muster wie H145, H135, BO105 eine/n

Die Technische Dokumentation erstellt Ersatzteilkonfigurationen, Beschreibungen und illustrierte Daten mit denen der Kunde Ersatzteile identifizieren kann, die während der Wartung der Hubschrauber benötigt werden. Der illustrierte Teilekatalog (Illustrated Parts Catalog - IPC) ist ein Schlüsseldokument, welches vom Kunden, aber auch für interne Zwecke (wie z.B. TechRep, MRO), verwendet wird. Zu dessen Erstellung arbeiten wir eng mit Engineering, Logistik, Quality, Zulassung und allen anderen Support&Service Abteilungen zusammen um die Kundenzufriedenheit bezüglich Ersatzteilverfügbarkeit zu gewährleisten.

Dein Standort:

Am Standort Donauwörth am Ufer der Donau nahe Augsburg entwickeln wir Hubschrauber von der ersten Idee bis zum flugfähigen Produkt. Erlebe mit uns, wie sie auf unserem eigenen Testflugplatz abheben und landen.

Deine Vorteile:
  • Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen
  • 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe
  • Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und gute Entwicklungsperspektiven
  • Sonderleistungen: arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersversorgung, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, vergünstigtes Auto Leasing, Sonderkonditionen für Versicherungen, Fahrtkostenzuschuss, Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen
  • Vor-Ort-Einrichtungen: Standortnaher Kindergarten, Arzt für Check-ups und andere gesundheitsbezogene Dienstleistungen, Kantine, Cafeteria, Kiosk und SB-Markt, gute Verkehrsanbindung


Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

Der Stelleninhaber (d/m/w) analysiert und unterstützt das Design zur Auswahl des Wartungskonzepts und der Ersatzteilkonfiguration und stellt sicher, dass die Designlösung die Anforderungen der Kunden optimiert erfüllt
  • Selbständige Analyse von Änderungsanträgen und Schätzen von Aufwänden, Definition von Liefergegenständen
  • Ermittlung von Ersatzteildaten aus technischen Bauunterlagen (Stücklisten, Zeichnungen, Herstellerunterlagen) und Festlegung der Ersatzteilkonfigurationen/Ersatzteil-Kits sowie Erstellung und Pflege der Teilekatalogdaten (CSN) mit Illustrationen
  • Datenpflege für Ersatzteile und Ersatzteilversorgbarkeit (Stammdatenpflege SAP) sowie Festlegung, Koordination und Freigabe von „Material-Evolution-Table" (MET)
  • Vorbereitung, Verfassen bzw. Validierung von technischer Dokumentation in Übereinstimmung mit internationalen Standards um eine sichere und effiziente Wartung und den Betrieb von Luftfahrzeugen zu gewährleisten


Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen:
  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Luft-/Raumfahrttechnik oder Techniker (m/w/d) mit mehrjähriger einschlägiger Berufserfahrung
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von bebilderten Teilekatalogen (IPC) für Hubschrauber, S1000D ist von Vorteil
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit dem Konfigurationsmanagement und verfügen über IT-Kenntnisse
  • Du bringst gute Hubschrauberkenntnisse für die deutschen zivilen Baumuster mit
  • Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse


Keine 100%ige Übereinstimmung? Kein Grund zur Sorge! Airbus unterstützt deine persönliche Entwicklung mit maßgeschneiderten Entwicklungslösungen.

Bring deine Karriere auf ein neues Level und bewirb dich jetzt online!

For the support of our Technical Documentation with focus on Illustrated Parts Catalog (IPC) and spare configuration of our helicopter fleets H145, H135, BO105, Airbus Helicopters in Donauwörth is looking for a

Technical Data Engineer - IPC (d/m/w)

The Technical Documentation creates spare part configurations, descriptions and illustrated data for the customer to identify the required spare parts during aircraft maintenance. The Illustrated Parts Catalog (IPC) is a key document used by customers and Airbus support organisations. For its creation, we closely collaborate with Engineering, Logistics, Quality, Airworthiness Office and all Support&Service departments to ensure customer satisfaction regarding spare part availability.

title: Analytics & Reporting Intern
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Praytell is a creative communications agency made up of strategic minds, spirited hearts and people with a strong instinctive recoil from anything remotely boring. We create culture-driven, integrated work that earns attention, sparks conversation and makes people… well, give a shit. But more than that, we’re a team of curious builders, thoughtful challengers and collaborative problem-solvers who believe the best work starts with a simple question: what if we?

What if we pushed the idea further? Solved the problem differently? Built something better?

Our work moves fast, evolves constantly and rarely fits neatly inside a box - which is exactly how we like it. The people who thrive here ask questions, chase ideas, spot opportunities and care enough to go beyond the brief. They don’t wait for a perfect roadmap or a tap on the shoulder - they’re energized by figuring things out, making things better and helping shape what comes next.

We hold ourselves to a high bar, but we’re not pretending to be a perfect agency filled with perfect people doing perfect work 100% of the time. We’re humans. Sometimes the work runs late. Sometimes the process is still being built. Sometimes there isn’t a policy, playbook or perfect answer for every little thing. What we do have is a genuine commitment to getting better - evolving how we work, support our people and build the kind of agency we want to be, together.

So that’s our promise to you. If curiosity drives you, ownership excites you and “what if we?” feels more like a life mantra than a question - we’d love to hear from you.

The Opportunity

Overview:

  • Dates: Tuesday, September 8 - Friday, February 26 (six-month internship)
  • Hours: Monday - Friday, 9am - 6pm local time, with a commitment of 40 hours/week
  • Location: Chicago or New York. This is a hybrid role, with interns expected to work from the office approximately once per week and attend in-person client events, activations or team needs as they come up.
  • Pay: $19/hour, with overtime eligibility
  • Benefits: Since you're expected to work more than 30 hours/week, you will be eligible for medical insurance. You will also receive 40 hours of paid sick time, which will be frontloaded at the start of your employment.
  • Commitment: This is designed as a full-time internship, so candidates should be available during standard business hours throughout the six-month program
  • Post-Internship: While there may be an opportunity to transition into a full-time role following the internship, it is not guaranteed and will depend on individual performance and company needs

As an Analytics & Reporting Intern, you will:

  • Support analytics and reporting across social media, PR, digital and integrated client accounts
  • Work alongside analysts and account teams to help build monthly and quarterly performance reports that measure our work and its impact
  • Gather, organize and QA data from social platforms, earned media tools and other digital sources to make sure reporting is accurate and consistent
  • Help analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, patterns and what may be driving performance
  • Analyze social content and earned media coverage to help understand what performed well, what didn’t and why
  • Help turn data into clear takeaways, charts and visualizations for client-ready reports and presentations
  • Work with tools and data sources like Meltwater, Meta Business Manager, Cision, Tagger and Google Trends to gather and analyze performance data
  • Support competitive analyses, share of voice reports, benchmarking, audience research and new business projects
  • Research competitors, audiences, cultural trends and industry conversations to add context to performance data
  • Build and maintain spreadsheets, trackers and other tools used to organize and analyze data
  • Support dashboard testing by validating data, testing functionality and documenting potential issues
  • Learn how teams establish KPIs and use measurement to evaluate PR, social and integrated campaigns
  • Explore AI and LLM tools to support research, data analysis and more efficient analytics workflows
  • Help test new analytics tools, processes and AI-powered workflows and share feedback on what works
  • Support research around AI search and how brands appear across LLMs and emerging search platforms
  • Participate in team meetings and client calls to see firsthand how data and insights inform PR, social and integrated brand strategies
  • Collaborate with teammates across departments, including Integrated Communications, Influencer, Creative and Strategy

What You Bring

  • No prior professional analytics experience required! We’re looking for someone who is curious about data, eager to learn and excited to understand the story behind the numbers. Previous internships, relevant coursework, research or personal projects are a plus, but not required.
  • You’re a recent graduate or early in your career and interested in analytics, consumer insights, marketing, social media, PR or brand communications
  • You’re comfortable working in Google Sheets and/or Excel and using spreadsheets to organize and analyze information
  • You enjoy working with numbers, but you’re equally interested in understanding why something happened and what can be learned from it
  • You have strong attention to detail and naturally notice when numbers or information don’t look quite right
  • You’re curious about social media, digital culture, news and how brands connect with audiences
  • You’re excited to experiment with AI and LLM tools to support research, analysis and more efficient ways of working
  • You’re comfortable learning new platforms and tools and don’t need to have experience with every analytics platform on day one
  • You’re a clear communicator who can help turn complicated information into simple, understandable takeaways
  • You’re organized, collaborative and comfortable juggling multiple projects and deadlines
  • You’re eager to learn, ask questions, take feedback and build your analytical skills
  • You’re able to commit to the full six-month internship and 40-hour workweek

Interview Process

Please note: due to the high volume of applications we receive, we're unfortunately not able to respond to every applicant individually. While we review every application, we'll only be in touch with candidates we're moving forward with.

We know how tough it can be to wait and wonder, especially in today's job market, so we want to be clear about what to expect. If you haven't heard from us within 10 business days of applying, it means we've decided to move forward with other candidates for this particular role. We truly appreciate the time, energy and care that goes into every application and will keep your information on file for future opportunities that may be a fit.

Our interview process typically takes 4-6 weeks and includes:

  1. Application Review: Before applying, please review the location requirements for this role. Unfortunately, candidates who do not meet the location requirement will not be considered.
  2. Phone Screen (30 minutes)
  3. Team Interview (30-60 minutes)
  4. Leadership Interview (30 minutes)
  5. Take-Home Exercise (TBD): A short, client-agnostic assignment designed to help us better understand how you think, approach challenges and tackle the work. Candidates who complete the exercise will receive a stipend via electronic gift card.
  6. Offer
  7. Target Start Date: September 2026

Who We Are

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all people and do not discriminate - period. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment in accordance with federal, state and local laws. We prohibit workplace harassment and discrimination of any kind and are committed to building an inclusive workplace in every location where we operate.

You are commercially minded, curious and solutions focused. You enjoy understanding how a business operates and recognising how systems, processes and data can be used to improve commercial performance.

Safety is at the forefront of everything we do, and we live by our promise: The Safe Way is the Only Way. Apply now to get started. A career at Monadelphous is a career with a difference. Make it yours.

description:
Job title: Master Data Operator - Materials

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

The GBS mission is to contribute to CHC simplification by developing and implementing a new operating model to execute some of the financial & accounting processes (Account-to-Report, Customer-Invoicing-to-Cash, Source-to-Value, Master Data Management, among others). The purpose of this role is to:

  • Ensure the master data maintenance process results in the highest level of master data quality.
  • Ensure the Service Level Agreement ( SLA ) on master data maintenance is met on regular basis.
  • Identify and involve in continuous process improvement in the master data maintenance.

  • Perform the Restricted Party Screening ( RPS ) activities to mitigate risk and due diligence.
  • Participate in escalation meeting with the RPS Escalation Committee to resolve positive match.

Master Data Maintenance:

  • Participate in regular review with the Master Data Governance team on the master data quality and involve in continuous process improvement opportunity.

  • Participate in escalation meeting with the RPS Escalation Committee to resolve positive match.

title: Graduate FPGA Engineer (2027 Start)
description:
As an FPGA Engineer, you’ll work side-by-side with teammates to build real-world applications that power a global trading firm. You’ll create solutions with nanosecond response times, highly parallelized algorithms, and customized low-level networking that solve business challenges effectively and efficiently. Collaborating closely with our business, you’ll have in-depth insight into a problem before developing the solution.

Optiver is building with cutting edge AI technology in the most competitive, data rich landscapes in the world: financial markets. Our FPGA engineers use AI to speed up verification, debugging, and technical research, while retaining full ownership of the designs and decisions it supports.

What you’ll do

Your onboarding

You will participate in Optiver’s comprehensive Global Academy and be equipped with the knowledge needed to make an impact the moment you join your team. The comprehensive training covers trading theory and Optiver’s tech stack to hone your skills for your role. In addition, you will be paired with a dedicated mentor who will empower you to take ownership of your work and make a difference.

Your responsibilities

  • Accelerate network infrastructure and trading system components with high-speed hardware designs.

  • Research new low-latency techniques and platforms and identify opportunities for integration with our trading system.

  • Collaborate in a multidisciplinary team of traders, software developers, and infrastructure engineers.

  • Leverage the best hardware available or build in-house versions to ensure our FPGAs can interface with cutting-edge server hardware.

What you’ll get

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

  • A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool

  • The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 different countries

  • 25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards

  • Training opportunities, discounts on health benefits, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses

  • Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, sport and leisure activities, bi-weekly massages and Friday afternoon drinks

  • Training and continuous learning opportunities

  • International transfer opportunities for global career growth

  • Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats

Who you are

  • University degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or similar, with outstanding academic achievements

  • Graduating between August 2024 and August 2027, with a maximum of 3 years of work experience

  • Academic design experience with FPGAs or ASICs

  • Academic experience in VHDL, Verilog, or SystemVerilog

  • An open, collaborative, self-critical attitude and willingness to learn from your mistakes

  • A desire to understand how the systems you build fit into our trading activities

  • Able to work closely with other engineers, traders, and business operations

How to Apply:
Apply directly via the form below for the position of Graduate FPGA Engineer. Please provide us with a CV in English. Unfortunately we cannot accept applications via email for data protection reasons.
If your application is selected to proceed to the next round, you will be required to complete online assessments. By submitting your application you are confirming that you will be able to take the assessment within 7 days.
Kindly note that we do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via the contact form

Diversity statement

Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion.

We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via the contact form, selecting "Reasonable Adjustments" as the subject of your inquiry.

For answers to some of our most frequently asked questions, refer to our FAQs.

For applicants based in India, our entry route is via the placement office internship hiring season (July/August).

Optiver has a global application re-apply policy for our intern and graduate roles. If you have completed an online assessment or interviewed for a technology graduate or internship role at any Optiver location in the past 8 months, please note that you are not yet eligible to reapply. We welcome you to re-apply after the 8-month cool off period.

This is a hands-on and influential role where you’ll work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain and Project Management to ensure products can be manufactured safely, efficiently, consistently and to the required customer and quality standards.

The Role

You’ll be responsible for developing and improving manufacturing processes for both new and existing products, while ensuring the documentation, controls and training are in place to support production.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Developing manufacturing processes, process flows, tooling, fixtures, inspection methods and test procedures.
  • Creating and maintaining PFMEA, Control Plans and Process Flow Diagrams.
  • Managing manufacturing documentation including Route Cards, Bills of Materials, Work Instructions and Technical Specifications.
  • Ensuring robust document control, revision control, traceability and change management.
  • Supporting production readiness and introducing new or improved manufacturing processes.
  • Analysing manufacturing and test data to identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency and process capability.
  • Delivering training to production teams on manufacturing processes and controlled documentation.
  • Ensuring manufacturing procedures are being followed and supporting corrective actions where required.
  • Supporting quality investigations using 8D and Root Cause Analysis.
  • Participating in audits and corrective actions.
  • Driving continuous improvement across safety, quality, delivery and cost.
  • Supporting risk assessments and Safe Systems of Work and maintaining strong HSE standards.
What We're Looking For

We’re looking for someone with solid experience developing manufacturing processes within an engineering or manufacturing environment, together with a strong understanding of controlled manufacturing documentation.

You’ll ideally have experience with:

  • Manufacturing/process engineering
  • Route Cards, Work Instructions and Technical Specifications
  • PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, PPAP and 8D
  • Document control and engineering change management
  • Working within an ISO 9001 environment
  • Root Cause Analysis and structured problem solving
  • Continuous improvement and Lean Manufacturing
  • Training or mentoring production personnel
  • Microsoft Office

A degree in Engineering, Manufacturing or a related discipline would be advantageous, although strong demonstrable industrial experience will absolutely be considered.

Desirable Experience

Experience within electric motor manufacturing would be particularly interesting, especially exposure to areas such as winding, rotor and stator assembly, lamination stacking, balancing and end-of-line testing.

Knowledge of IEC 60034 or NEMA MG1 standards would also be highly beneficial, as would experience with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001.

Why Apply?

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to take genuine ownership of manufacturing processes and documentation within a technically interesting engineering environment.

You’ll have the opportunity to influence how products are manufactured, improve processes, support production teams and work across multiple functions rather than being confined to a purely documentation-based position.

Location: Rugby

Salary: £40,000 – £45,000

Role: Process & Documentation Lead

Sector: Engineering / Manufacturing

If you’re a Manufacturing Engineer, Process Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering Lead or similar and you're looking for a role where you can really make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Experienced Professional, Mining Engineering
description:
WSP is seeking a Principal Water Resources Engineer to join our large and growing technical support
team in Bengaluru. The role involves working closely with our global Mining Team. The successful
applicant will undertake specialized analyses and studies related to hydrology and hydrotechniques
for mining water projects. This work will be carried out under the direction of a global team of mining,
geotechnical, and civil engineering professionals.

The applicant will report to the Mining Team Leader as part of WSP's GCC-IN Global Mining Team. The
goal is to deliver the highest standards of technical work, contributing to the ongoing success of the
mining projects by supporting the client-focused delivery of projects. Close collaboration with WSP's
mining leaders will be a key aspect of the role. Technical responsibilities will include conducting
hydrotechnical studies, reviewing data, and preparing inputs for reports related to mine water
projects.

The successful applicant would be responsible for the following.
• Lead and manage comprehensive water resource management studies for mining projects, from
conceptual design through to implementation and optimization.
• Utilize advanced modelling and simulation tools to predict water-related risks and evaluate
mitigation measures, enabling data-driven decision-making for clients.
• Evaluating mine tailings dam integrity, encompassing computed aided models for dam break scenarios.
• Conduct hydrological studies, including desk-based research, conceptual, analytical, and numerical modeling, and analyze data along with input/output uncertainties.
• Conduct analysis of storms, undertake hydraulic computations, and engage in 1D/2D hydraulic
simulation to estimate floods and assess risks. This includes the preliminary design and estimation of costs for flood mitigation measures at mining sites.
• Lead the team in the design of water management infrastructure for mines, spanning from initial feasibility studies to detailed civil engineering stages.
• Provide technical expertise and guidance to junior engineers, fostering their professional growth and contributing to the overall knowledge sharing within the firm.
• Prepare detailed reports, technical documentation, and presentations for clients, showcasing project outcomes, findings, and recommendations.
• Execute project management responsibilities, such as composing reports and proposals, interacting with clients, and offering guidance to staff members.

Key Competencies
Mandatory Skills

• Experience undertaking flood related studies for environmental assessments and infrastructure
design projects across a range of sectors, with a particular focus on Mining, Water and Urban
Development sectors would be desirable.
• Total Experience 10+ Years.
• Strong knowledge hydrology, hydraulics, and water quality modelling practices and guidelines.
Proficiency in relevant Australian guidelines is preferred.
• Experience in software used for hydrology models and hydraulic models such as TUFLOW, ICM,
HEC-RAS and associated GIS software programs (QGIS).
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a demonstrated ability to apply them to Australian water resources challenges.
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills for collaborating with diverse stakeholders.

Desired Skills
• Track record of successfully delivering water related projects.
• Meeting Clients needs, as well as programme and budgetary constraints.
• Proven technical expertise in the civil/water resource enginering field with an established reputation in the local market.
• Provide technical expertise and guidance to junior engineers, fostering their professional growth and contributing to the overall knowledge sharing within the firm.
• Experienced with managing a water resource engineers and supporting mining business based outside of India.
• Ability to challenge the status quo and apply innovation in day-to-day work.

• Master/Phd degree in water resource engineering is preferred.
• Extensive professional experience 10+ years in water resources engineering.
• Experience in the International context is preferred.

BGV:

• Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Intermediate Supervisor, Eastern District of Wisconsin
description:
Summary

The Intermediate Supervisor manages all government-facing coordination and contract execution, including supervision of security personnel, staffing oversight, and performance compliance. The role holds full authority for personnel decisions, maintains daily communication with the COR, ensures accountability of government property, and provides on-call support for emergencies.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Government to discuss technical and security-related requirements through regular site visits to primary and sub-offices. It is the fiscal responsibility of the Contractor to provide adequate site visits necessary to successfully manage contract requirements.

  • Have the ability and authority to make decisions on behalf of the company, particularly on personnel-related issues.

  • Have the authority to supervise all CSOs and LCSOs working under this contract.

  • Be available to the Government on a 24-hour basis, to ensure Contractor response in the event of an emergency or other exigent circumstance.

  • Maintain daily contact with the COR to ensure adherence to the needs of the client/contract, with regards to manpower and hour usage.

  • Receive and execute daily technical direction from the COR.

  • Maintain and monitor all post-performance required by this contract and correct any and all issues or problems brought to his/her attention.

  • Keep the COR informed about post coverage, potential problems, and the actions are taken to correct any and all issues or problem(s) brought to his/her attention.

  • Act on and report all Performance Service Violations (PSV) without hesitation or necessary delay.

  • Assure all Government-issued equipment and property is tracked and accounted for, and otherwise safeguarded until the time it is returned to the Government, in accordance with an approved property control system.

  • Have the ability to carry out all administrative tasks efficiently, e.g., timely, complete, and correct (without reliance and further assistance of the CSOs).

  • Are prohibited from performing duties as that of a CSO or LCSO and shall not be subject to the uniform, medical or physical requirements stated in this contract.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • The Intermediate Supervisor shall oversee and manage the security operations performed by Court Security Officers and Lead Court Security Officers.

Competency

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies (minimum of 5):

  • Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Change’s approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events; adapt to new product introduction, emergent business needs, and business evolution.

  • Judgement – Displays willingness to make decisions; Exhibits sound and accurate judgement; Supports and explains reasoning for decisions; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process; Makes timely decisions.

  • Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff; Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus in others; Improves processes, products and services; Continually works to improve supervisory skills.

  • Professionalism – Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.

  • Oral Communication - speaks very clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions; demonstrates group presentation skills; participates in various meetings.

  • Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

  • Technical Skills - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares expertise with others.

  • Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

  • Customer Service - Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service ; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.

  • Interpersonal Skills - Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Maintains confidentiality; Listens to others without interrupting; Keeps emotions under control; Remains open to others' ideas and tries new things.

  • Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

title: Laser Safety Specialist (6279)
description:
Laser Safety Specialist – Global EHS

itD is seeking a Laser Safety Specialist to support global EHS initiatives by ensuring laser and radiation safety compliance across research and product environments. The ideal candidate will bring strong Laser Safety Officer (LSO) experience, expertise in ANSI Z136.1, and hands-on experience with laser and radiation safety programs, including laboratory inspections, hazard analysis, laser exposure calculations, equipment evaluations, and X-ray safety.

Location: Redmond, WA – Onsite
Primary Lab Coverage: Sunnyvale, Burlingame, and Fremont, CA; travel to Redmond, WA and other locations as needed
Travel: Required as needed

Pay Rate: $40–$46 per hour, depending on experience.
We provide comprehensive medical benefits, a 401k plan, paid holidays, and more.
Please note that we are only considering direct W2 candidates at this time, as we are unable to offer sponsorship.

Responsibilities

  • Audit laboratories for laser and radiation safety compliance and identify potential hazards or gaps.
  • Analyze safety hazards and assist with developing requirements for hardware containing hazardous elements such as lasers, LEDs, and X-ray sources.
  • Implement laser and optical safety standards, including ANSI Z136.1 and applicable FDA/CDRH and IEC standards.
  • Conduct laser and LED power, spectral, and temporal measurements and perform exposure calculations to evaluate safety risks.
  • Create, review, and approve laser and optical hazard-related SOPs, procedures, and safety documentation.
  • Review work performed by external laser service technicians and support corrective action development and communication with stakeholders.
  • Support radiation safety activities, including X-ray leakage surveys, training and procedure audits, equipment testing, and compliance with applicable California requirements.

Internal Responsibilities

  • Attend regular internal practice community meetings.
  • Collaborate with your itD practice team on industry thought leadership.
  • Complete client case studies and learning material (blogs, media material).
  • Build out material to contribute to the Digital Transformation practice.
  • Attend internal itD networking events (in person and virtual).
  • Work with leadership on career fast-track opportunities.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • 5+ years of experience as a Laser Safety Officer (LSO).
  • Strong proficiency with ANSI Z136.1 – The American National Standard for the Safe Use of Lasers.
  • Experience supporting laser safety programs, including laboratory inspections, hazard assessments, and establishing appropriate area controls.
  • Experience with safety investigations, failure analysis, field testing, reliability, or a related technical/engineering function.
  • Familiarity with multiple radiation sources, including X-ray generating machines, lasers, and LEDs.
  • Experience performing or supporting laser exposure calculations and measurements.
  • Strong communication, technical writing, reporting, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams across research and product environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Physics, Optical Sciences, Engineering, Health Physics, Nuclear Engineering, Nuclear Physics, or a related discipline, or equivalent direct LSO/RSO experience.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience working as both an LSO and Radiation Safety Officer (RSO).
  • Proficiency with FDA/CDRH FLPPS, IEC 60825-1, and IEC 62471-1.
  • Strong understanding of laser calculations, including MPE, NOHD, and NHZ, for various laser types and configurations.
  • Certified Laser Safety Officer (CLSO) credential from the Board of Laser Safety.
  • Experience working in a hardware research or production environment.
  • Experience supporting additional EHS programs such as LOTO, laboratory safety, chemical safety, electrical safety, or machine guarding.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams through timely, accurate, and effective technical analysis.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Physics, Optical Sciences, Engineering, Health Physics, Nuclear Engineering, Nuclear Physics, or a related discipline required, or equivalent direct experience as a Laser Safety Officer (LSO) or Radiation Safety Officer (RSO

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja - Pielavesi
description:
Hei, sinä iloinen ja aktiivinen työnhakija!

Kiireetön kotihoito – onko se mahdollista? Meillä on, hae siis sinäkin mukaan tekemään merkityksellistä työtä!

Haemme nyt henkilökohtaista avustajaa vahvistamaan tiimiämme Pielaveden läheisyyteen. Työ on osa-aikaista ja tapahtuu arkipäiväsaikaan. Tällä hetkellä vapaana 6h työvuoroja ja asiakkaan luokse kulkeminen vaatii oman auton käyttöä.

Henkilökohtaisena avustajana autat asiakasta tavallisen elämän asioissa, joita asiakas ei pysty itse vamman tai sairauden vuoksi tekemään. Et tarvitse erillistä koulutusta, sillä meiltä saat kattavan perehdytyksen sekä tuen. Reipas asenne ja terve maalaisjärki mahdollistavat hyvin tehtävistä suoriutumisen.

Työ sopii monenlaisissa elämäntilanteissa oleville, sillä voit itse vaikuttaa siihen, mitä asiakkaita otat vastaan. Voit olla reipas eläkeläinen, opiskelija, terveydenhuollon ammattilainen tai jotain siltä väliltä. Asiakkaan luona käy aina sama hoitaja tai hoitotiimi vakioaikoina, mikä tarkoittaa sitä, ettei työ ole varsinaisesti keikkatyötä, vaan käynteihin tulee pystyä sitoutumaan pitkäaikaisesti.

  • Kiireettömän, vastuullisen ja merkityksellisen työn

  • Eläke- ja työttömyysmaksut sekä lomakorvaukset

  • Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työaikoihin ja työtehtäviin

  • Lämminhenkisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

  • Hyvän perehdytyksen

Edellytämme:

  • Hyviä sosiaalisia taitoja

  • Positiivista asennetta

  • Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

  • Sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutus tai työkokemus katsotaan eduksi

Tarkistamme valittujen rikosrekisteriotteet Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvontalain mukaisesti.

Palkkaus tehtävässä on 12.79-14.50 €/h. Olemme vastuullinen työnantaja ja meillä kaikki työntekijät ovat työsuhteessa. Kerrytät työssäsi normaalisti eläkettä ja olet luonnollisesti oikeutettu myös lomakorvauksiin. Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa maanantaisin ja torstaisin 9-14 välillä Eetu Saapunki, 050 4784077 sekä sähköpostitse eetu@suomenseniorihoiva.fi.

Mikäli välität aidosti ikäihmisistä ja haluat liittyä iloiseen tiimiimme, hae rohkeasti paikkaa viimeistään 31.8.2026 mennessä urasivujemme kautta osoitteessa . Toimi nopeasti, sillä paikkoja täytetään jo hakuaikana.

Suomen Seniorihoiva Oy on täysin kotimainen hoiva-alan kasvuyritys, jonka tehtävänä on rikastaa senioreiden elämää. Yritys on perustettu vuonna 2013 ja se toimii kaikkialla Suomessa työllistäen noin 700 hoiva-alan ammattilaisia. Yritys tuottaa luotettavia ja korkealuokkaisia avustus-, seuranpito- ja hoivapalveluita 24 tuntia vuorokaudessa vuoden jokaisena päivänä. Yritys on merkittävä kotimainen sote-palveluiden tuottaja.

About us

Our purpose is simple: to save lives at sea. 24 hours a day, every day, RNLI lifesavers are ready to launch to the rescue. They depend on the lifeboats and equipment we provide 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Our lifeboats are amongst the best in the world, but we’re constantly looking at ways in which we can improve their performance, safety and reliability.

Some of the benefits

- £29,951 to £35,236 (dependent on experience)
- Performance-related pay scheme annually reviewed
- 26 days’ annual leave plus Bank Holidays
- Time off in lieu available
- Flexible working opportunities
- Competitive pension scheme
- Life assurance
- Health and dental cashplan

Your role

We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled Engineer with a strong foundation in marine engineering and practical experience in marine electronics. This role is ideal for someone passionate about supporting and enhancing the performance of marine systems throughout their operational lifecycle.

As an Engineer, you will be tasked with focus on the following areas:

- Provide engineering support for the maintenance, troubleshooting, and upgrade of marine systems, with a focus on electronic and electrical subsystems.
- Conduct diagnostics and root cause analysis of electronic and control system faults.
- Support integration of new electronic systems into existing marine platforms.
- Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams to deliver effective engineering solutions.
- Prepare technical documentation, including test procedures, reports, and modification proposals.
- Ensure compliance with relevant maritime regulations and standards.
- Engage with coastal teams, surveyors, suppliers, OEMs, and stakeholders to ensure timely and effective resolution of technical issues.

Essential skills and experience

- Degree or equivalent qualification in Marine Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience in marine engineering with a strong understanding of electronic systems (e.g., navigation, communication, control systems).
- Familiarity with fault-finding tools and techniques for electrical and electronic systems.
- Knowledge of marine safety standards and regulatory compliance.
- Strong communication and documentation skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Desirable

- Experience in defence or commercial maritime sectors.
- Knowledge of systems integration and software-hardware interfacing.
- Incorporated Engineer status or working towards professional registration.
- Experience with PLCs, SCADA systems, or embedded systems in marine applications.

Please apply via the button shown.

Safeguarding

The RNLI is committed to safeguarding; protecting a person’s health, wellbeing, and human rights, enabling them to live free from harm, abuse, and neglect. We expect all employees and volunteers to share this commitment and have a zero-tolerance approach. The suitability of all prospective employees and volunteers will be assessed during the recruitment process in line with this commitment. This will include relevant criminal record checks being carried out dependent on the eligibility of the role. (England & Wales; DBS check, Scotland; Disclosure Scotland PVG, Northern Ireland; Access NI, Republic of Ireland; Garda Vetting; International, International Child Protection Certificate process).

Diversity at the RNLI

Our staff and volunteers have been saving lives at sea without prejudice for 200 years. We respect and value diversity of background, skills and perspectives within our teams, and consider it essential to help us deliver a world-class lifesaving service. We are an inclusive organisation and welcome applications from everyone. In addition to having the skills needed for the role, we also look for applicants who share our commitment to living our RNLI values (trustworthy, courageous, selfless, and dependable) and helping us work towards Our Vision: To save Every One.

title: Senior Hardware Engineering Program Manager
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/17/2026

Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

This is an onsite position at the San Jose, CA location with Austin, TX as an alternative location.

Meet the team

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco’s core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms—like Silicon One—are shaping the technology industry. We value diverse perspectives and foster an inclusive environment where every team member is empowered to share their ideas and drive meaningful outcomes.

Our CHG HW PMO team serves as the engine for Cisco’s hardware portfolio, redefining complex strategies into predictable, high-quality delivery through multi-functional governance and operational excellence. As a Hardware Program Manager, you will act as the primary orchestrator for next-generation platforms, driving the end-to-end product lifecycle while ensuring financial rigor and seamless alignment across our engineering and business partners.

Your Impact

  • Lead program management of large-scale, high-risk hardware products for Cisco with multiple interdependencies across functions, ensuring successful end-to-end delivery from concept to customer release.

  • Orchestrate multi-functional activities by aligning hardware and software engineering, product management, and operations teams to ensure cohesive, high-quality execution.

  • Drive complex problem-solving by interpreting current business trends to identify and implement innovative, strategic solutions for program delivery.

  • Monitor program health, lead critical path roadmaps, risk mitigation and necessary course corrections.

  • Lead all aspects of budget preparations, resource allocation, and financial rigor to ensure effective utilization and alignment to business plans

  • Influence and persuade partners at all levels, providing executive-level status updates and strategic recommendations for maintaining relationships.

  • Provide technical expertise and mentorship to engineering project management staff, fostering process improvements and the implementation of continuous integration methodologies.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering with 8+ years of experience or a master’s degree in engineering with 6+ years of experience in technical program management, or PhD with 3+ years.

  • Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end, complex hardware programs with moderate to high risk and multiple multi-functional interdependencies.

  • Experience in defining and delivering program plans, schedules, and budgets, including monitoring critical path activities and resource allocation.

  • Experience in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, MS Project) to track program metrics.

  • Experience using AI tools e.g. ChatGPT, Codex, Claude to improve the program management process.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Expertise in Design Verification Testing (DVT) processes within complex hardware development lifecycles.

  • Extensive knowledge of hardware manufacturing environments, production workflows, and supply chain operations.

  • Strategic background in supply chain operations or procurement for large-scale hardware programs.

  • Current program management certification (e.g., PMP, PgMP) reflecting advanced professional standards.

  • Proven ability to communicate difficult concepts and influence outcomes across internal and external partner groups.

  • Demonstrated expertise with leading multi-functional dependencies in fast-paced engineering environments

  • Familiarity with demonstrating advanced analytical tools and AI-enabled methodologies to optimize program management efficiency.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Code Creation Analyst
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Code Creation Analyst to join our global Code Creation team. In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and integrity of supplier master data within our integrated ERP (iERP) system.

The ideal candidate will manage the end-to-end lifecycle of supplier codes—including creation, holds, and releases—while collaborating with global stakeholders to resolve queries and improve processes. This position requires strong operational knowledge of Accounts Payable (AP), Master Data Management (MDM), and compliance standards.

1. Master Data & Code Management

  • Supplier Code Creation: Facilitate the creation and maintenance of Local Supplier Codes within the MDM system.
  • Hold & Release Management: Efficiently execute hold and release actions on all designated iERP run days to prevent payment or procurement bottlenecks.
  • Regional Support: Support the North America (NA) code creation process as a secondary responsibility, maintaining the flexibility to work occasional night shifts as required by business needs.

2. Query Resolution & Stakeholder Management

  • Global Inbox Management: Actively monitor and manage multiple shared mailboxes handling supplier and internal queries across the AP (Asia-Pacific), EU (Europe), and NA (North America) regions.
  • Supplier Liaison: Proactively contact global suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve Master Data inconsistencies and clarify payment/registration queries.

3. Metrics, Quality, and Compliance

  • Reporting: Prepare and deliver daily and monthly operational metrics to monitor team performance, volumes, and SLA compliance.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Investigate operational gaps, prepare thorough RCAs, implement corrective actions, and resolve TGWs (Things Gone Wrong) within established internal timelines.
  • Governance: Strictly adhere to established operational guidelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and internal "rules of the road."

Qualifications & Requirements

Educational Background

  • Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com), Master of Commerce (M.Com), MBA in Finance, or CA/CWA Inter.

Experience

  • 1 to 4 years of hands-on experience in Accounts Payable (AP), Master Data Management (MDM), or a shared services environment.

Technical Skills

  • Core Systems: Hands-on experience or solid working knowledge of MDM (Master Data Management), SAP S/4HANA, and SAP Ariba SLP (Supplier Lifecycle and Performance) is highly preferred.
  • Office & Automation Tools: Proficiency in MS Office (particularly Excel and Word). Knowledge of Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate is a strong advantage.
  • Process Knowledge: Strong understanding of the end-to-end Accounts Payable/Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workflow.

Soft Skills & Competencies

  • Communication: Excellent oral and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with global teams and external vendors.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical capabilities to perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and handle complex data issues.
  • Adaptability: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and flexible to adjust to different regional time zones (including occasional night shifts for NA support).

title: Inventory Specialist
description:
