Supports pharmacy inventory management activities, including receiving, counting, ordering, and facilitating returns. Champions On-Shelf Availability and is responsible for receiving, counting, pricing, returns, and all in-store inventory processes. Validates and ensures accuracy of planograms.
  • Responsible for reviewing and coordinating the proper use of reports and system applications, which have an impact on the accuracy of front end and pharmacy on-hand balances and pricing.
  • Responsible for executing and maintaining front end and pharmacy asset protection techniques, and filing claims for warehouse and vendor overages (merchandise received, but not billed), shortages (merchandise billed, but not received), order errors or damaged goods including prescription drugs.
  • In designated stores, as required, opens and closes the store in the absence of store management, including all required systems start-ups, required cash handling and cashier responsibilities, and ensuring the floor and stock room are ready for the business day.
Customer Experience

  • Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).
Operations

  • Maintains accurate inventory counts. Maintains the accuracy of on-hand quantities including but not limited to basic departments, stockroom, overstock locations.

  • Attends company-based trainings for continuous development and completes all e-learning modules including safety training requirements.

title: Director, Executive Programs & Global Engagement
description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

As Director of Executive Programs & Global Engagement, you will own and lead FICO's global strategy for C-suite relationship building, executive engagement, and VIP customer programs, a senior, highly visible role sitting at the intersection of marketing, sales, and executive leadership, with a mandate to deepen FICO's relationships with the most senior decision-makers at our most strategic accounts worldwide.You'll design and execute programs that introduce FICO to new executive audiences and strengthen existing C-suite relationships, owning global executive events, VIP sponsorship programs, Customer Advisory Boards (CABs), executive briefings, and thought leadership initiatives.You'll lead and develop a growing team, initially two interns based in India and EMEA, with the expectation both may convert to full-time roles as the team scales, coaching and mentoring while driving world-class program execution. This role is ideal for a seasoned B2B marketing leader who combines strategic vision with strong operational discipline, energised by building executive relationships at scale across global markets.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Define and lead FICO’s global executive engagement strategy, building a structured framework to identify, target, and engage C-suite executives across strategic accounts in EMEA, LAC, APAC, and the Americas.
  • Own FICO’s global portfolio of VIP customer programs, executive sponsorships, and high-touch experiences, including executive dinners, roundtables, Customer Advisory Boards, Innovation Days, and bespoke customer summits.
  • Design and execute Customer Advisory Board (CAB) programs globally, managing nominations, agendas, facilitation, and follow-through.
  • Build and manage a global executive engagement calendar, partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and field marketing to align engagement with pipeline, retention, and account plans for FICO’s top 20–30 strategic accounts.
  • Manage global event and sponsorship budgets, ensuring efficient allocation and demonstrable return on investment.
  • Oversee the development of executive-facing thought leadership content, including the global executive newsletter, briefing materials, CAB presentations, and event content.
  • Define KPIs and measurement frameworks for executive engagement and sponsorship ROI, using Salesforce to track engagement and reporting quarterly to senior leadership.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Executive Programs team, building scalable processes and playbooks that enable consistent, high-quality execution across regions.

What We’re Seeking

  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute global executive engagement or customer marketing strategies in a B2B enterprise environment, with clear evidence of business impact.
  • Significant experience leading C-suite engagement programs, VIP customer initiatives, executive events, and sponsorship programs at scale, ideally within a global technology or financial services organization.
  • Strong understanding of B2B marketing principles, with experience partnering with Sales and Customer Success to drive pipeline, retention, and account growth through executive engagement.

Joining The American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Develop enterprise execution capabilities across a portfolio of initiatives, products, and programs. title: Freelance Web Designer
description:

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Web Designer, your focus will be on marketing pages, landing experiences, and conversion-driven layouts. We need a core specialist dedicated to owning the look and feel of all web-based materials, ensuring they feel consistent, polished, and perfectly aligned with the broader brand ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-converting one-pagers, pitch-style landing pages, and simple marketing sites based on textual copy, outlines, or existing drafts.
  • Translate brand assets and social media visuals into responsive web layouts, structured components, and sections that can be easily implemented by developers or no-code tools. • Prepare and securely package production-ready files (organizing Figma frames, exporting assets, and detailing specs) for seamless handoff.
  • Ensure absolute visual consistency between interactive web pages, static PDFs, and social materials.
  • Enforce layout quality standards through systematic verification of responsiveness, proper spacing, clarity, and adherence to modern web trends prior to delivery.

Educational qualifications

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on landing pages, marketing websites, and product or startup one-pagers demonstrating clear hierarchy and strong typography. We are looking for specialists who are confident working from rough prompts, AI-generated drafts, or existing brand systems to convert them into structured, implementation-ready web designs. A user-centric, conversion-minded approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Web & UI Design: Deep proficiency in Figma for creating scalable, responsive web layouts, auto-layout components, and comprehensive design systems.
  • Conversion-Driven Layouts: Expertise in structuring high-converting, pitch-style landing pages with a strong eye for clarity, spacing, and modern design trends.
  • Developer Handoff: Solid understanding of how to prepare, spec, and package digital assets for efficient implementation via developers or no-code platforms (e.g., Webflow, Framer).
  • Cross-Platform Consistency: Ability to seamlessly translate core brand aesthetics across varying touchpoints, ensuring web pages match existing social materials and pitch decks.

Additional requirements

  • A structured, user-centric, and conversion-minded approach to design.
  • Strong eye for clarity, white space, and modern web layout trends.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver production-ready assets fast.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with web design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant web design cases, will not be considered.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Operations Associate
description:
About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

  • Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets
  • Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS
  • Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

About the Role

This is an operations-first role in a fast-growing digital healthcare company. As our patient base in Germany continues to scale, we need to make sure the operational engine behind the patient experience scales with it. As an Operations Associate, you’ll help run and improve the processes that keep our German business moving — solving day-to-day operational challenges while helping build better, more scalable ways of working. You’ll work across Patient Experience, Product, Tech, Growth, and other teams, with support and direction from your manager. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, working with data, improving processes, and turning ambiguity into action.

What You’ll Do

Keep our operations running smoothly

  • Own and maintain key day-to-day operational processes across the German business
  • Troubleshoot issues across areas such as payments, orders, invoices, discounts, verification, referrals, and patient communications
  • Fix problems as they arise while identifying opportunities to make our processes more reliable and efficient

Improve the patient experience

  • Use patient feedback and recurring issues to understand where we can create a better experience
  • Help turn patient pain points into practical improvements across our processes and journeys
  • Support areas such as Trustpilot and referrals, improving how we engage with and learn from our patients

Use data to drive decisions

  • Track key operational metrics and investigate where performance is changing or falling short
  • Use data to understand the scale and root cause of operational problems
  • Turn analysis into practical actions and improvements

Deliver operational initiatives

  • Support and deliver projects that improve the performance of our German operations
  • Help test and implement new processes, workflows, and ways of working
  • Take ownership of defined initiatives from planning through to execution, with support from your manager

About You

  • 3–5 years of experience in operations, consulting, startups, marketplaces, digital health, or another fast-moving environment
  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfortable getting into the details to understand why something isn’t working
  • Confident working with data, KPIs, and spreadsheets; SQL experience is a plus
  • Organised and able to manage multiple priorities while following through on the details
  • Comfortable working in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment
  • Strong attention to detail and able to balance speed with accuracy
  • Proactive, practical, and motivated by making things work better
  • Fluent in English, preferably German too, both written and spoken

Experience in healthcare, consumer technology, marketplaces, or high-growth businesses is a plus, but not essential.

What Success Looks Like

Keeping Operations Running & Improving — You reliably solve the day-to-day problems that keep the business moving, while spotting and making improvements along the way.

Turning Ambiguity into Structure — You can take an unclear or messy problem, break it down, work out what matters, and move towards a solution.

Balancing Speed with Precision — You move quickly and pragmatically while maintaining a high bar for accuracy and patient experience.

Compensation

  • The salary range for this role is €55,000 – €65,000 gross per year, depending on experience and qualifications, plus additional benefits.

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

  • confidence in working at the intersection of business and technology, translating business needs into solutions that are both valuable and technically feasible,
  • a goal-oriented, independent, and confident approach, with the ability to remain focused and effective in dynamic, rapidly changing project environments,
  • strong leadership and ownership skills, with the ability to foster collaboration and drive teams toward shared project goals,
  • a strategic mindset and the ability to balance business priorities with technical, operational, and project constraints,
  • familiarity with emerging technologies will be an advantage,
  • fluent command of English,
  • practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot Chat, or similar) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in analysis and software delivery.

Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required.

Nice to have:

  • experience with or a good understanding of mobile technology, specifically mobile networks, services, and provisioning,
  • experience applying GenAI in a more structured way within the SDLC, including defined workflows, prompt patterns, or tool integrations embedded into daily analytical and documentation work,
  • interest in and familiarity with emerging AI-driven practices (e.g. automation of analysis tasks, AI-supported documentation, or workflow optimization), with a willingness to explore and experiment beyond standard approaches.

CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision

description:

Tässä roolissa vastaat strategisesti merkittävien asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä, kasvattamisesta ja pitkäjänteisestä kumppanuudesta asiakkaidemme kanssa."}

Solita on teknologia-, data- ja designkumppani, joka auttaa organisaatioita uudistamaan liiketoimintaansa datan, tekoälyn, ohjelmistokehityksen, pilvipalveluiden ja strategisen neuvonannon avulla. Työskentelemme Suomen johtavien yritysten kanssa esimerkiksi vähittäiskaupan, finanssialan, teollisuuden, energia-alan ja muiden yksityisen sektorin toimialojen parissa.

Roolissa toimit asiakkaan ylimmän johdon ja Solitan asiantuntijaorganisaation välisenä strategisena kumppanina. Johdat asiakkuuksien pitkän aikavälin kehitystä, rakennat uusia kasvumahdollisuuksia sekä varmistat, että asiakkaamme hyödyntävät parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla Solitan laajaa osaamista strategiasta ja palvelumuotoilusta aina dataan, tekoälyyn, ohjelmistokehitykseen ja pilvipalveluihin asti.

Roolisi pähkinänkuoressa

  • Johdat ja kehität strategisesti yhtä tai useampaa Solitan merkittävää yksityisen sektorin asiakkuutta
  • Rakennat luottamusta ja yhteistyötä asiakkaan ylimmän johdon, liiketoimintojen ja IT:n kanssa
  • Edistät asiakkuuden kasvua ja Solitan ratkaisujen jalkautumista
  • Varmistat, että asiakkuustiimi toimii tavoitteellisesti ja ketterästi
  • Verkostoidut aktiivisesti asiakkaan organisaatiossa ja toimit linkkinä eri sidosryhmien välillä

Onnistumiseen tässä roolissa tarvitset:

  • Vahvaa kokemusta IT-alan asiakkuusjohtamisesta, ratkaisumyynnistä ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä. Olet työskennellyt konsultatiivsessa myynnissä tai liiketoiminnan kehitysroolissa vähittäiskauppa-, finanssi- tai teollisuustoimialalla. Erityisesti vähittäiskaupan toimialan tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.
  • Näyttöjä myynnillisistä onnistumisista yksityisen sektorin asiakkuuksissa, olet ollut myymässä tai omistanut +5 miljoonan euron kokoluokassa olevia hankkeita.
  • Kykyä keskustella teknisistä aiheista niin teknisille kuin ei-teknisille sidosryhmille Solitan palveluportfoliosta
  • Ihmisten johtamistaitoja ja kykyä innostaa muita
  • Itseohjautuvaa ja joustavaa työotetta – meillä ei aina ole valmista mallia, mutta on paljon vapautta ja vastuuta
  • Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa
  • Sijaintia Helsingin, Turun tai Tampereen alueilla. Asiakastapaamisia Helsingissä 2–3 päivänä viikossa.

Lisäksi odotamme, että sinulla on kokemusta AI-työkalujen hyödyntämisestä ja ymmärrät, miten tekoäly sekä agenttipohjaiset ratkaisut muuttavat asiakkaiden toimintaympäristöä ja liiketoimintaa. Hyödynnät AI-työkaluja asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan analysoinnissa, strategisessa suunnittelussa, kasvumahdollisuuksien tunnistamisessa ja raportoinnissa. Pystyt toimimaan asiakkaan johdon luotettuna neuvonantajana, kun he arvioivat teknologian, datan ja tekoälyn roolia liiketoimintansa kehittämisessä sekä uusien kilpailuetujen rakentamisessa. AI:n hyödyntäminen ei ole sinulle vain teknologia-aihe, vaan liiketoiminnan kehittämisen väline.

Tehtävän kuukausipalkka sijoittuu tyypillisesti 6 000–7 500 euron välille osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi riippuen. Palkan lisäksi tarjoamme mahdollisuuden erillisiin kannustimiin sekä laajan työsuhde-etupaketin.

Miksi Solita on loistava työpaikka myynnin ammattilaiselle?

Ympärilläsi on monialainen ja kokenut asiantuntijayhteisö, joka auttaa sinua onnistumaan. Solita on asiakkaiden ja asiantuntijoiden arvostama teknologiatalo, jossa yhdistyvät strateginen konsultointi, data ja AI, ohjelmistokehitys, pilvipalvelut sekä palvelumuotoilu. Tämä mahdollistaa sen, että voit rakentaa asiakkaillesi aidosti laajoja ja liiketoimintaa uudistavia ratkaisuja sen sijaan, että myisit vain yksittäisiä palveluita.

Jatkuva oppiminen ovat osa kasvavan yrityksemme DNA:ta. Tarjoamme laajan valikoiman erilaisia oppimismahdollisuuksia ja panostamme osaamisen kehittämiseen. Saat käyttöösi sekä Solitan oman asiantuntijaverkoston että uusimmat teknologiat ja AI-ratkaisut, joiden avulla voit luoda asiakkaillesi entistä enemmän arvoa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos innostuit, kuulemme mielellämme sinusta! Lähetäthän meille CV:si ja vapaamuotoisen hakemuksesi jo tänään, tai viimeistään 1.9.2026 alla olevan hakulomakkeen kautta. Huomioithan, että emme tietoturvasyistä vastaanota emmekä käsittele hakemuksia sähköpostitse.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Head of Talent Acquisition Johanna Lintunen sähköpostitse etunimi.sukunimi@solita.fi.

Keskeisenä teknologia-, data- ja designkumppanina Solitan liiketoiminta perustuu luottamukseen ja vastuullisuuteen. Tästä syystä valitun hakijan henkilöllisyys tarkistetaan. Nämä tarkastukset suoritetaan työelämän yksityisyyden suojasta annetun lain mukaisesti ja sen rajoissa. Tässä tehtävässä työskentely voi edellyttää asiakkaamme pyynnöstä tehtävää turvallisuusselvitystä. Turvallisuusselvitys toteutetaan turvallisuusselvityslain mukaisesti, ja sen hyväksytty läpäiseminen on tehtävässä työskentelyn edellytys.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain complex software components that align with business and technical requirements. You will take ownership of feature implementation, troubleshoot technical challenges, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. Your role will involve contributing to technical discussions, refining best practices, and supporting junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing. Your expertise in programming and software engineering will be essential for achieving project goals and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products.

What will you be doing?

  • Contribute to system architecture discussions and develop software components aligned with functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Creating high-quality, maintainable code in accordance with company best practices and standards.
  • Participate in software testing, debugging, and optimization to ensure performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Develop and maintain cloud-based APIs, microservices, and integrations as part of a collaborative engineering team.
  • Support junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and sharing technical insights.
  • Collaborate with the team to refine task prioritization and align work with project goals.
  • Tackling complex problems requiring deep analysis and evaluation of diverse factors.
  • Collaborating closely with other teams and departments, such as product teams to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and external stakeholders to clarify requirements and share progress updates.
  • Participate in technical discussions, advocate for improvements, and help resolve disagreements constructively.
  • Providing timely, concise, and actionable feedback to team colleagues.
  • Share knowledge through documentation, workshops, or informal team sessions.
  • Assist in technical interviews to evaluate candidates for your team.
  • Maintaining openness to communication with both local and external partners.
  • Proactively learn new tools and practices (e.g., DevOps, cloud services) to expand technical expertise.

What are we looking for?

  • Experience in designing and developing advanced software systems.
  • Proficiency in object-oriented programming concepts, algorithms, and data structures.
  • Continuous focus on enhancing skills in software architecture design, and product development.
  • Strong orientation toward task automation to save time and effort.
  • Implementation of improvements and optimizations in daily operations.
  • Planning and managing complex multi-system deployments without impacting client operations.
  • Ability to balance the demands of delivering high-quality software within tight deadlines.
  • Programming across multiple languages (C#, JavaScript, Java in plus).
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
  • Expertise in cloud infrastructure automation.
  • Knowledge and experience in use of design patterns
  • Fluency in English is required for this role.

The tech stack

  • C# .NET - Required
  • RDBMS / SQL - Required
  • TypeScript - Preferred
  • Javascript - Preferred
  • Amazon Web Services - Required

What do we offer?

💸 Clear and transparent compensation plan. The salary range goes from 47,000 € to 68,000 €. We will discuss the indicated range with you in the first recruiting call to ensure that we are on the same page.

💰 Flexible salary benefits
Save on personal income tax with Cobee for expenses like transport, restaurants, and kindergarten.

Free for all employees via Cigna, plus we cover 50% for your family members.

🌅 Generous time off
Enjoy 26 days of holiday per year (23 base days + your 🎂 birthday off, Christmas Eve, and New Year’s Eve).

💻 Your gear, your choice
Whether you prefer Mac or Windows, or need an extra screen, we’ll make sure you’re set up for success from day one.

🗓️ Annual Salary Review
We’re committed to recognizing your professional growth. Every year, we review salaries to reflect your individual development, achievements, and impact on our business success.

📙 Grow your skills
We offer up to €2000/year in training (certifications, conferences, workshops) to boost your growth—both technical and personal.

📺 Learning resources
Access internal and external training, including platforms like LinkedIn Learning, completely free.

🧘‍♂️ Holistic wellness program
Includes access to Wellhub, Curalinc (psychological support), Rocketlawyer (legal advice), and regular health webinars & challenges.

😊 Volunteer day
Take one day off a year to volunteer and give back. Bonus points for sharing pics on Slack!

👩‍⚕️ Free therapy vouchers
Because your mental health matters.

Get up to €55/month to cover your gym or fitness classes (yoga, boxing, pilates, etc.).

🗺️ Weekly language classes
Improve or learn a new language (English, Spanish, French, Italian, or German) in small groups with expert instructors—on us!

Get 8 hours per year for personal medical appointments and 10 hours per year to support your family’s medical needs.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
GENERAL DESCRIPTION

The Project Manager is responsible for the overall leadership and management of construction projects, in a role and reporting structure as designated for the project. The Project Manager is further responsible for the overall administration of the project, including subcontracting, procurement and purchasing of trades and vendors, design management, client management, scheduling, documentation, meetings, reports, document control and management, and cost management, including budgets and internal cost reporting, profitability, subcontractor and vendor payments, owner billings, and change orders. The Project Manager collaborates closely with the Superintendent in a role as outlined in the organizational and reporting structure. The Project Manager serves as the primary liaison with the Client and Design Team, and subcontractors.

Project Manager, I should be capable of all duties of Assistant Project Manager, and should have previously demonstrated success in that role, or an equivalent role. Project Manager I should be capable of successfully managing a project up to an approximate worth of around $5M at the entry level to around $20M at the upper range of the position.



PRINCIPLE AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

In general, the primary areas of responsibility are:

  1. Project budget
  1. Project schedule
  1. Project safety
  1. Project quality
  1. Project profitability and cost controls
  1. Project documentation, communication, and document control
  1. Contract Management
  1. Design management and Change management.
  1. Client relations and communication
  1. Subcontracting, purchase orders, procurement, purchasing.
  1. Client and subcontractor/vendor billings and payments
  1. Enhancing Business development opportunities by performance and relationships
  1. Manage, training, and development of subordinate staff.




GENERAL LISTING of JOB DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES

The following is a general listing of job-related duties. This list is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or skills required for this position. These may be modified, added to, or eliminated for the specific requirements of the assigned project. Some of these duties may be delegated to subordinate staff according to the project.

  1. Review of and assistance with the budget/estimate for complete understanding of the project scope and budget. Establishment of project budget cost coding breakdown and enter in JDE.
  1. Reviews of all subcontractor and vendor bids and perform procurement by the de-scoping and interviewing process in collaboration with preconstruction and the project team.
  1. Prepare detailed scopes of work for all subcontractors and purchase orders (including all schedule requirements and any other obligation required by the subcontractor or vendor), issue and execute the formal agreements (within limits of authority). Ensure Superintendent and all staff are familiar with subcontractor work scopes.
  1. Conduct preconstruction meetings (with Superintendent) with all subcontractors as they begin work on site. Meetings are to cover all project procedures, including the company safety rules, contract document requirements, schedule and the level of quality expected.
  1. Develop, with the Superintendent, a "rolling punch list" of substandard and deficient work items that must be corrected by the company or subcontractors in a timely manner with the goal of achieving a zero-punch list at project completion. Learn what the Owner's needs and expectations are so these areas can be managed and educate the Owner to what he can expect.
  1. Oversee the construction and renovation of pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities, specifically those involved in the production of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs).
  1. Ensure all construction activities comply with industry standards, GMP regulations, and FDA guidelines.
  1. Coordinate with engineering teams to integrate specialized equipment and systems required for API production.
  1. Thorough review and understanding of the Owner's contract to ensure compliance with all contractual requirements.
  1. Collaborate with superiors to ensure proper project staffing.
  1. Establishes the overall project's procedures and execution plan.
  1. Works with the Superintendent and subcontractors to prepare the overall detailed project schedule. Ensure that the schedule is incorporated into appropriate subcontracts and purchase orders. Works with Superintendent to ensure the schedule is updated a minimum of once a month or more often as necessary. Monitor critical path activities frequently to document and if necessary, intervene to keep project on or ahead of schedule. When project is 90% complete, assist the Superintendent in preparing "Work Completion Lists" to help ensure the project is fully completed in a timely manner.
  1. Establishes the project document control system to ensure the project is using the most current contract documents for construction. This includes the system to initiate and monitor Request for Information (RFIs) as well as the shop drawing control and management.
  1. Responsible for the overall communication and documentation on the project, including the filing system, letters, emails, meeting minutes, correspondence, and all reports.
  1. Attend weekly subcontractor meetings and prepare meeting minutes as documentation and follow-up. Involved as participant or lead, according to project responsibility.
  1. Staff leadership position for the Owner/Architect meetings with required minutes and documentation.
  1. All aspects of cost and profitability management. This includes change orders, internal cost coding, profitability analysis, and all other logs, reports, and tools to review, evaluate and manage cost expenditures.
  1. Approval of subcontractor and vendor billings and invoices for payment after Superintendent has approved.
  1. Preparation and submission of monthly billings to the Owner.
  1. Monitor labor, material, and equipment costs with Superintendent to maintain budget. Prepare monthly status reports and progress reports.
  1. Review safety program being implemented on site with Superintendent to ensure compliance.
  1. Develop relationships with Clients for possible repeat business. Participate in business development activities and assist in preparation of proposals and promote productive client relationships.
  1. Provide leadership in the professional and career development of subordinates as well as timely and fair performance evaluations. Provide mentoring, training and development as needed. Maintain effective communication with clients. Understand the client's needs to achieve an acceptable level of satisfaction.
  1. Perform all the closeout documentation required.





EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  1. BS/BA degree in engineering, architecture, or construction management.
  1. Proven prior success at Assistant Project Manager level, or equivalent role. Already operating in general at Project Manager I level.
  1. As a general guideline, there is a minimum of five (5) years' experience in the construction industry, with at least two (2) in the position of Assistant Project Manager.



KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  1. Those of Assistant Project Manager plus:
  1. Sound understanding of essential job functions, duties, and responsibilities of Superintendent and general understanding of Senior Project Manager.
  1. Competent with will computer requirements necessary for JDE profitability forecasting and reporting.
  1. Additional technology skills
  • Planning and scheduling
  • Cost Control
  1. Additional leadership skills
  • Management and Leadership styles
  • Control conflict resolution.
  • Negotiation techniques
  • Managing workforce diversity

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to perform physical activities such as climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, and handling materials.
  • Must be able to work in various weather conditions, including extreme heat and cold.
  • Capable of standing and walking for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

BE&K Building Group is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship.

title: Commercieel Technisch Adviseur Stuc

Wat ga jij doen als Commercieel Technisch Adviseur?|
Voor de regio Zuid-Nederland ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ondersteunen van klanten bij het maken van weloverwogen keuzes voor hun stukadoorsprojecten. Je zal fungeren als technisch expert en adviseur en samenwerken met verwerkers en andere belanghebbenden om op maat gemaakte oplossingen te bieden. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opbouwen en onderhouden van sterke klantrelaties en het vergroten van de marktpositie van Knauf.

  • Geven van commercieel en technisch advies aan klanten en verwerkers;

  • Identificeren van nieuwe zakelijke kansen en het ontwikkelen van strategieën om de verkoop te vergroten.

  • Bezoeken van stukadoors en stukadoorsbedrijven en (bouw)projecten ten behoeve van verkoopdoelstellingen;

  • Geven van trainingen en demonstraties op locatie, in samenspraak met je collega’s;

  • Bijhouden van CRM systeem en zorgdragen voor opvolging (Salesforce).


“In deze functie ben je de ambassadeur van Knauf in jouw regio. Samen met een team van zeer gemotiveerde collega’s kun je het verschil maken en bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de positie van Knauf bij stukadoorsbedrijven. Je krijgt de kans om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, te leren en te ondernemen in een zeer dynamische omgeving” Jan Wouters, Sales Manager


Wat zoeken wij in jou als Commercieel Technisch Adviseur?
Omdat je veelal stukadoors en stukadoorsbedrijven bezoekt, snap je heel goed wat er bij deze organisaties spelen en wat jij daar met jouw adviezen kan toevoegen. Je bent klant- en resultaatgericht, werkt graag samen en beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden, waarbij je makkelijk schakelt tussen verschillende niveaus. Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Afgeronde MBO opleiding in de richting commercie/bouw/techniek;

  • Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring in verkoop of technisch advies in de buitendienst;

  • Ervaring als stukadoor of minimaal afgeronde opleiding gezel stukadoor;

  • Ervaring in relatiebeheer en/of acquisitie (pre)

  • Uitstekende beheersing van Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift;

  • Ondernemerschap, waaronder assertiviteit en creativiteit;

  • Kennis van CRM (Salesforce is een pre).

Dit krijg je van ons:
Je krijgt bij Knauf de ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, jezelf te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan een sterk A-merk. Daar staan aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden tegenover

  • Een salaris wat past bij jouw ervaring, tussen €4.000,- en €5.500,- bruto per maand, op basis van fulltime.

  • Een afwisselende en zelfstandige baan bij een prachtig A-merk bedrijf;

  • Een prettige werksfeer binnen een no-nonsense cultuur;

  • Lease auto en bonusregeling

  • De mogelijkheid tot het volgen van (technische) trainingen en cursussen, zodat jij je werk goed kan doen;

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden waaronder 25 vakantiedagen en 12 ATV dagen.

Word jij onze nieuwe collega?
Solliciteer nu en kom in contact met onze recruiter Sibel Armut via sibel.armut@knauf.com. Na een telefonische intake volgt een gesprek met je toekomstige leidinggevende en HR. Zijn we daarna allemaal enthousiast? Dan ontvang je van ons een aanbod en heten we je graag welkom aan boord.

In verband met de privacywet willen we je vragen te solliciteren via de onderstaande button en je cv en motivatiebrief niet naar ons te mailen.

Over Knauf
Het Duitse familiebedrijf Knauf kent een rijke historie. Al decennia lang is het één van de wereldmarktleiders binnen de bouwsector. Over de hele wereld levert Knauf een volledig assortiment aan innovatieve afbouwsystemen en -materialen voor nieuwbouw en renovatie. En met ruim 43.000 medewerkers wereldwijd werken wij samen aan het succes van onze afnemers.

Met meer dan 200 medewerkers van Knauf Nederland zetten wij ons dagelijks in om de ideale omgeving voor wonen, werken of verblijven te creëren. Dat doen we door bij het ontwikkelen van onze producten en oplossingen niet alleen oog te hebben voor kennis en kunde, maar ook voor de behoefte van onze klanten en eigen medewerkers. Op deze manier willen wij echt impact maken. Doe je mee? We zijn benieuwd naar jouw talenten en helpen je graag deze verder te ontwikkelen.

Huvudsyftet med stödet är att bryta isolering och möjliggöra ett aktivt liv trots en svår synskada. Som ledsagare är du en viktig trygghet vid praktiska måsten såsom läkarbesök och apoteksärenden, där du ansvarar för säker förflyttning hela vägen in i undersökningsrummet. Du hjälper till att syntolka miljön, läser upp post och ser till att vårdpersonal presenterar sig, vilket skapar kontroll och delaktighet i viktiga möten.

En central del av uppdraget är att ge visuell vägledning vid promenader och sociala aktiviteter. Du går ett halvt steg före så att individen kan hålla i din armbåge, samtidigt som du löpande beskriver terräng, hinder och omgivningens skiftningar. Mycket vikt läggs vid att du kan syntolka det som inte sägs med ord, såsom miner, gester och kroppsspråk hos andra människor. Det finns även en stark önskan om att utöka den sociala samvaron till restaurangbesök eller andra publika platser. Där bistår du med att läsa menyer, beskriva atmosfären och orientera kring bordet. Vi söker dig som är lyhörd och vill erbjuda ett personcentrerat stöd som ger mod att ta steget från praktiska måsten till en mer berikande fritid.

Om dig

Vi söker dig tycker om att arbeta med människor och kan sätta dig in i andra individers behov. Vidare bör du vara lyhörd, initiativtagande, lösningsfokuserad samt engagerad, då stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

KRAV:

  • Behärskar det Persiska (Farsi) språket.

Meriter:

  • Tidigare erfarenhet med att stötta personer med synnedsättning.

Sysselsättningsgrad: 8,7% eller 15 timmar i månaden.

Tiden används flexibelt där dag, kväll samt helg arbete kan förekomma.

Tillträde: Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

Att tänka på inför din ansökan:

En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos på Olivia är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID -handling och lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ned på Skatteverkets hemsida.

På grund av att tjänsten kan omfatta ensamarbete, nattarbete och arbetsuppgifter som enligt Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter (AFS 2012:3) inte får utföras av minderåriga, måste du ha fyllt 18 år.

Om du vill arbeta med barn och unga under 18 år behöver du uppvisa utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Det är viktigt att utdragen beställs i god tid, eftersom Polisens handläggningstid kan variera.
Med anledning av lagändring från den 1 mars 2026 utökas registerkontrollen till att omfatta både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag från misstankeregistret.

Du beställer enkelt utdragen med BankID via denna länk:


Vi rekommenderar att du säkerställer att du har aktuella utdrag enligt de nya reglerna.

Om rekryteringsprocessen:Om du ger ditt samtycke kan vi dela din profil med våra systerbolag om din profil matchar en annan tjänst inom Team Olivia.

För dig med Anställningsstöd:

Olivia är ett inkluderande företag. Vi välkomnar alla sökanden och även du som har rätt till någon form av anställningsstöd genom arbetsförmedlingen . Det är frivilligt att ange denna information i din ansökan, alternativt kan du även meddela detta vid en eventuell intervju.

Som medarbetare omfattas du av kollektivavtal och självklart är du försäkrad på och till/från arbetet om något oförutsett skulle inträffa.

POP MART (09992.HK) is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Centered around IP, POP MART has built a comprehensive platform for creative incubation and IP operation, empowering global creators while delivering exciting products, services and immersive entertainment experiences to consumers.

POP MART identifies and nurtures emerging artists and designers worldwide, creating popular character IPs through a well-established development and operation system. Our portfolio includes iconic characters such as MOLLY, SKULLPANDA, DIMOO, THE MONSTERS and Hirono. POP MART operates over 500 physical stores and more than 2,300 Robo Shops across more than thirty countries and regions, and through multiple cross-border e-commerce platforms reaches audiences in over ninety countries and regions, bringing joy to young consumers around the world.

POP MART has developed a comprehensive IP commercialisation ecosystem that spans multiple industries, deepening emotional bonds between fans and IPs while exploring broader opportunities for value creation. Our ventures include the world’s first immersive intellectual property themed park in the designer collectible pieces industry, the expansion of its IPs into global markets through licensing and co-branding with leading global brands, and the curation of designer collectible pieces art expos and intellectual property themed exhibitions internationally.

In Europe, POP MART has built a strong presence in key markets including the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands and Spain, and is expanding into new high-potential markets. Our expansion brings POP MART closer to European fans and offers new ways for them to connect with our IPs and stories.

POP MART is a fast-paced company with a young and multicultural team where you can expect to:

As a Supervisor, you will play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the store, leading and motivating the team, maintaining excellent operational standards, and helping deliver an outstanding experience for every POP MART customer.

This leadership position requires strong organisational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for retail management. Your enthusiasm for designer collectible pieces, POP MART’s IPs, and creating memorable customer experiences will make you a competitive candidate.

Required Qualifications

Desirable but Not Essential

title: Service Charge Financial Coordinator
description:
Fixed Term / Secondment Opportunity - 12 Months

Hackney is one of the most dynamic and progressive local authorities in the UK. We are a resilient, vibrant, and creative borough in the heart of London, with strong, diverse communities and a powerful set of shared values.

Over the past twenty years, the Council has built up first-class services, outstanding public infrastructure, and a reputation for excellence, innovation, and ambition. We are leading the way on essential work such as our fight for equity in Hackney with a particular focus on becoming an actively anti-racist borough. But the work doesn’t stop there, we are proactive in our approach to bringing fairness to all aspects of life including gender, neurodiversity and across the poverty divide.

Hackney Council is on the lookout for a dedicated and detail-oriented Service Charge Financial Coordinator to enhance our Service Charge Team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for calculating service charges, reserve funds, shared ownership rent, and ground rent, ensuring high-quality customer service for our residents.

You will collaborate closely with the Service Charge Team Leader and Manager to produce accurate estimated and actual invoices in line with legislation and local policies. Maintaining and managing the service charge database will be essential, as will ensuring accurate financial records and documentation. Your role will also involve supporting payment functions within the team, handling creditor payments, and overseeing mortgage account activities.

Additionally, you will prepare performance reports and engage in budget monitoring to ensure effective financial management. Liaising with auditors and regulatory bodies to maintain best practices in service charge accounting will be an important aspect of your responsibilities.

We are looking for candidates with extensive experience in leasehold management and financial administration, as well as a strong understanding of S20 consultation processes and their implications on service charges. You should be proficient in financial principles and able to perform accurate calculations, with excellent analytical skills and a high level of attention to detail. Strong IT skills, particularly in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, are also essential.

There is no better place to work in London than Hackney; we have great pride in our borough, our communities, and our services. Hackney is one of London’s most vibrant and diverse boroughs. It’s one of the most sought after areas to live in London with good schools, parks and local amenities, as well as great transport links and vibrant and diverse communities.

About the Job:

The Controls Automation & Analytics Specialist enables efficient, high-quality, and scalable internal control testing through data analytics, automation and agentic AI. The role prepares and validates large transactional datasets, develops repeatable automated tests to identify exceptions, and supports the testing team with data-driven insights and monitoring outputs.

The position sits within the Internal Control Testing and Automation organization and reports to the Director, Internal Control Testing and Automation.

Main Responsibilities

Data, Analytics & Automated Testing Delivery

  • Define data requirements with testers and process stakeholders. Obtain and prepare extracts from source systems (ERP, sub-ledgers, workflow tools).
  • Perform data quality and reconciliation checks (completeness, accuracy, duplicates, cut-off, mapping) and document results.
  • Build and maintain automated tests (SQL/Python/R) to detect exceptions (e.g., duplicate payments, abnormal journals, master data anomalies).
  • Develop dashboards and exception reporting (Power BI/Tableau) to support periodic and continuous monitoring.
  • Operationalize automated tests: scheduling, run-books, exception triage workflow, and handoff to testers/control owners.

Agentic AI Enablement for Testing

  • Design and maintain agentic AI workflows to support testing activities such as evidence intake/classification, completeness checks, automated follow-ups, exception clustering, and drafting testing narratives for reviewer completion.
  • Define human-in-the-loop checkpoints and ensure reviewer approval before conclusions are finalized.
  • Maintain prompt libraries, agent configurations, and reusable components aligned with testing standards.

Governance, Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure audit-ready governance for automation and agentic solutions: documented logic/assumptions, data lineage, versioning/change logs, reproducibility, logging, access controls, and periodic re-validation.
  • Collaborate with IC Testing Analysts/Senior Analysts and process teams to translate testing objectives into analytics/agentic use-cases and support root cause analysis and remediation follow-up.
  • Identify opportunities to expand automation/agentic coverage and reduce manual effort. Contribute to the testing automation roadmap and standardization initiatives.

About You

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Professional certifications (CFA, CPA, ACCA, CIA, CISA, or AI/analytics certifications) are a plus.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or related field.
  • Relevant certifications are a plus (data/analytics, CISA, etc.).

Experience

  • 2–4 years in data analytics, IT audit, forensic analytics, finance analytics, automation, or similar.
  • Proven experience working with large transactional datasets in ERP/finance contexts.
  • Hands-on proficiency in SQL and at least one analytics language (Python or R).
  • Experience with BI/visualization tools (Power BI/Tableau) and strong Excel skills.
  • Experience building automated analytics, exception monitoring, or controls monitoring solutions.
  • Exposure to LLM/agentic workflows in a controlled business context (prompt design, evaluation, logging) is a plus.

Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to translate findings into actionable testing insights.
  • Strong documentation discipline and audit trail mindset.
  • Ability to implement human-in-the-loop safeguards and quality checks for agentic outputs.
  • Effective communication skills
  • Ability to work across time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with GRC tools (AuditBoard or similar).
  • Exposure to internal controls and end-to-end processes (RTR, P2P, O2C).
  • Familiarity with RPA and basic model risk concepts (validation, monitoring, access controls, data privacy).

Why us?

At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.

We Are Challengers.

We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:

All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.

Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.

Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.

Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.

Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Analyze and track the state-backed and financially motivated attackers that target cloud ecosystems.

We're establishing a new leadership position to oversee our Dynamics 365 function, and we're searching for the right person to join us as our Head of Dynamics.

Dynamics is the platform that underpins how Clarion manages its finances, serves its customers, and looks after 140,000 homes. Finance and Operations, the full Customer Engagement suite, and Field Service all sit within it. Each is run by a capable team, but each naturally focuses on its own roadmap. Your job is to bring a single direction across the whole estate, so the platform evolves as one considered whole rather than three good parts.

This is a strategic leadership role, offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract with a clear mandate. The three teams work well individually. What's missing is a single point of leadership that sets a shared direction across the platform, so that decisions are made for the estate as a whole rather than one roadmap at a time. Your job is to provide that, and to lift the function to high-performing. You'll coach three team leaders, set a clear bar for what good looks like, and build the ways of working that keep the platform aligned. The decisions you make will shape how Clarion serves residents for years to come.

You'll own the strategy for the Dynamics estate, take a portfolio view of where it should invest, decide how it's governed and run, and hold the senior commercial relationships with Microsoft and our delivery partners. You'll be the senior point of accountability for the function's performance, reporting to the Director of Technology Solutions and Experience.

  • Led a sizeable function at Head of Service level or above, accountable for performance, delivery, and people across multiple teams.
  • A real record of developing senior managers and building high-performing teams, with the coaching instinct to grow people alongside the discipline to set a clear bar.

  • The judgement to take a portfolio view of a complex estate, direct investment to where it delivers most, and hold specialist leaders to account for the decisions they make.

title: Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist
description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

title: FPGA Internship (2027 Start)
description:
Optiver FPGA Engineers build hardware systems where nanoseconds matter. Their work spans highly parallel algorithms, low-level networking and latency-critical applications that operate in live markets. They work closely with traders, software engineers and researchers to understand how trading strategies behave in production, then turn that context into systems that are fast, reliable and efficient.

Optiver is building with cutting edge AI technology in the most competitive, data rich landscapes in the world: financial markets. That means no two days are the same, and every day brings new, exciting technical challenges to solve.

What you’ll do

Get ready for a ten-week internship where you’ll be immersed in the systems behind Optiver’s trading. As Optiver’s FPGA Engineer Intern, you’ll own a project connected to our live trading systems, experiencing tight feedback loops and shipping your code to production alongside our Engineers and Traders. You’ll work side-by-side with your mentor to build latency-critical applications, parallel systems and networking interfaces, giving you a clear view of how low-level engineering decisions connect to trading outcomes. You’ll tackle real issues that will test your critical thinking and problem-solving acumen, and each day will bring new challenges that require fresh perspectives. It’s an opportunity to accelerate your knowledge while contributing to systems that operate in live markets.

You will also have the chance to join industry lectures to learn about trading and our other departments to gain a complete understanding of Optiver and our business. Don’t worry, you won’t be expected to have previous knowledge of the financial industry – you’ll be educated and upskilled by our world-class trainers in order to hit the ground running.

Examples of potential projects that you could be working on:

  • Supporting new networking protocols – think 25G and 100G interfaces

  • Developing FPGA applications in close collaboration with our Traders to improve how strategies behave in live markets – where did that nanosecond go?

  • Improving the resource usage of our current systems – why use 8 bits when 3 will do?

  • Make your mark on our future trading systems by trailblazing new domain areas – from high-precision timestamping to new proprietary inter-system communication protocols

Based on your performance during the internship, you could receive an offer to join our firm full-time after your studies.

What you’ll get

  • A highly competitive internship compensation package

  • Optiver-covered flights and accommodation in the city centre for the duration of the internship

  • Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, bi-weekly massages, Friday afternoon drinks, a bicycle to explore Amsterdam and much more

  • The opportunity to participate in sports and leisure activities, along with social events exclusively organised for your intern cohort

Who you are

  • Student working toward a Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or similar, with the ability to work full-time upon graduation in 2028

  • Someone with strong engineering instincts and academic experience in digital design with FPGAs or ASICs

  • Experienced in writing hardware in VHDL, Verilog or SystemVerilog

  • Passionate for clean code, simple well-architected systems and continuous improvement, with a desire to understand how the systems you build fit into our trading activities

  • Able to collaborate with developers, traders and business operations

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
About Coursera

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, creating one of the world's most comprehensive skills development platforms for the AI era. This strengthens our ability to accelerate AI-powered innovation and shape how the world discovers and builds skills at a pivotal moment of change. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Coursera was launched in 2012 by Andrew Ng and Daphne Koller with a mission to provide universal access to worldclass learning. Coursera partners with leading university and industry partners to offer a broad catalog of content and credentials, including courses, Specializations, Professional Certificates, and degrees. Coursera’s platform innovations — including AI-powered personalized guide and features, like Role Play and Course Builder, and role-based solutions like Skills Tracks — enable instructors, partners, and companies to deliver scalable, personalized, and verified learning. Institutions worldwide rely on Coursera to upskill and reskill their employees, students, and citizens in high-demand fields such as GenAI, data science, technology, and business, while learners globally turn to Coursera to master the skills they need to advance their careers. Coursera is a Delaware public benefit corporation and a B Corp. Coursera recently combined with Udemy to create one of the world’s most comprehensive skills development platforms.

Why Join Us

At Coursera, we’re looking for inventors, innovators, and lifelong learners ready to shape the future of education. You’ll help build global programs and tools that power online learning for millions turning bold ideas into real impact. People who thrive here are customer-first builders who move fast, simplify ruthlessly, and iterate relentlessly on the metrics that matter.

We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to do their best work together. Our virtual hiring and onboarding experience makes it easy to join us and start making an impact from anywhere. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

As a mission-driven company, we’re passionate about making a positive impact in learners’ lives by unlocking opportunity through learning. We’re looking for self-motivated, curious, and bold problem solvers — people who are driven by purpose, energized by complex challenges, and deeply committed to putting learners at the center of everything they do. If you’re excited to reimagine how education can better serve everyone, everywhere and want to build products that drive real-world impact, you’ll thrive here.

Staff Product Manager, Creator Community

The way learners want to learn is shifting from long-form, asynchronous courses toward ongoing relationships with experts and peers — access, live guidance, accountability, and staying current in fast-moving domains. Instructors are already building these relationships off-platform on Patreon, Circle, Discord, and Substack. This role owns Udemy's answer: the product surface that lets creators connect with, teach, and retain their learners over time, and keeps that value inside the combined Coursera + Udemy ecosystem.

What you'll own

Community & learner connection.

The messaging and comms layer that keeps creators and learners in contact between sessions — Q&A, announcements, and direct learner communications — so engagement becomes recurring rather than one-time.

Human-to-human learning.

Higher-touch formats where a creator's expertise shows up live: 1:1 connect, and VILT and webinars.

Instructor profiles & channels.

The creator's home on the platform — a profile and channel that promote their content and build their brand. As personalized, AI-driven discovery (like Helix) disrupts traditional course merchandising the way SEO decline reshaped search, browseable listings become less central to how content is found. Profiles and channels give creators a durable, owned surface to promote, contextualize, and extend their content inside an ongoing learner relationship — a new front door that doesn't depend on marketplace merchandising or the black box of AI orchestration.

Creator channels & tooling.

The tools creators use to build and run an audience — channel management, social/community tools, and subscriptions — including the recurring economic model (50/50 when Udemy sources the learner, 70/30 when the instructor does) that gives top creators a reason to keep building with us.

Flagship — Instructor Communities: from pilot to business (2027)

With the pilot launching soon, this role owns taking Instructor Communities from a 60-instructor test on Circle.so to a proven, scalable business line in 2027. Near-term, that means getting the pilot live on a Finance-supported manual billing bridge (Circle-hosted checkout on Udemy-owned Stripe accounts) while securing the committed Product/Engineering path to automated, in-house billing and payouts — Engineering has proposed a ~3-month build with no major top-line impact. Longer-term, it means turning early signals into a repeatable model: which interactions create value for learners, instructors, and Udemy, what drives conversion and retention, and how the recurring economic model scales beyond the initial cohort — across Product, Finance, Consumer, and Content/Instructor stakeholders.

Collaboration

Cohort learning. Partner with the lead PM who owns cohort-based learning to ensure community, profiles, and creator tooling reinforce cohort experiences rather than duplicate them.

  • Experience building products in EdTech, learning technologies or content authoring tools
  • Experience with B2B2C business model
  • Experience building, using, or experimenting with AI-driven products, particularly in the areas of content generation and editing, adaptive learning and personalization, automated quality assurance, and multimodal authoring support such as AI for video, audio, and translation.

  • Learning How To Learn
  • Gen AI for Product Managers
  • Data Analysis with Python

Salary is just one component of Coursera’s total rewards package. All regular employees are also eligible for a bonus program and equity in the form of RSU’s.

title: Quantitative Research Internship (2027 Start)
description:
As a Quantitative Research Intern, you’ll use data, mathematics and technology to turn financial market data into quantitative insights and trading strategies. You will tackle a practical research challenge using rich market data to explore real-world trading questions. In our business, where the markets are always evolving, you will test hypotheses, identify patterns and explore how research ideas are developed, challenged and evaluated in practice.

By the end of the ten-week internship, you’ll be equipped with the skills and knowledge required to succeed as a Quantitative Researcher at a leading global trading firm.

What you’ll do

Led by our in-house education team, the internship combines structured training with hands-on experience across trading, research and AI.

The comprehensive training program offers you the opportunity to:

  • Deep dive into trading and research fundamentals, from theoretical concepts to financial markets, strategies and cutting-edge technology
  • Take part in a collaborative research project, using quantitative analysis to develop and test a systematic trading strategy
  • Develop your research skills by working with large market datasets to test hypotheses, identify patterns and explore trading ideas
  • Gain hands-on market experience through simulated trading using real Optiver technology and responding to live market events
  • Gain exposure to traders and researchers and experience the trading floor environment first-hand
  • Learn how we use AI and apply it to solve real-world trading problems

Based on your performance during the internship, you could receive an offer to join our firm full-time after your studies.

What you’ll get

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

  • A highly competitive internship compensation package
  • Optiver-covered flights and accommodation in the city centre for the duration of the internship
  • Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, bi-weekly chair massages, Friday afternoon drinks, a bicycle to explore Amsterdam and much more
  • The opportunity to participate in sports and leisure activities, along with social events exclusively organised for your intern cohort

Who you are

  • Penultimate-year student in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics or a related STEM field, with the ability to work full time upon graduation in 2028
  • Solid foundation in mathematics, probability and statistics
  • Excellent research, analytical and modelling skills
  • Independent research experience
  • Proficiency in any programming language
  • Knowledge of machine learning, time-series analysis and pattern recognition is a plus
  • Strong interest in working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
  • Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills

We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via the contact form, selecting "Reasonable Adjustments" as the subject of your inquiry.

title: Production Engineer in the VAN Assembly Production Team
description:
As a Production Engineer, you will be responsible for the preparation, implementation, stabilization, and continuous improvement of production processes within the VAN assembly area.

Your role will focus on ensuring safe, high-quality, and efficient production processes, resolving technical and process-related issues, and comprehensively preparing the assembly line ramp-up. You will collaborate with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Logistics, Engineering, and IT, combining technical expertise with data analysis and modern digital tools.

Key Responsibilities

· Participate in projects related to the preparation, launch, and ramp-up of new production processes and production lines.

· Create, implement, and further develop assembly process concepts, taking into account safety, quality, costs, deadlines, and planned production volumes.

· Participate in the construction, commissioning, acceptance, and optimization of production machinery, equipment, and installations.

· Ensure the stability of production processes and provide ongoing support to Production in resolving technical, quality-related, and organizational issues.

· Analyze end-to-end production processes and identify dependencies between processes, equipment, materials, systems, and data.

· Identify the root causes of problems and implement and monitor corrective and preventive actions.

· Manage technical and process changes and coordinate the related activities.

· Analyze and optimize cycle times, ergonomics, material flow, equipment utilization, and workplace organization.

· Coordinate activities related to process quality, complaints, and risks concerning production processes and components.

· Implement and continuously improve production methods, standards, and procedures.

· Define requirements for machinery, equipment, systems, and solutions supporting production.

· Analyze production data and use the results to assess process stability and implement improvements.

· Collaborate with other departments.

· Manage project tasks and coordinate their implementation in accordance with the agreed scope, schedule, and standards.

· Prepare process documentation, instructions, analyses, and reports.

· Conduct training for production employees and other target groups covering new processes, standards, and working methods.

· Use digital tools and AI solutions for data analysis, documentation preparation, identification of potential improvements, and enhancement of daily work efficiency.

· Participate in continuous improvement activities in accordance with Lean Manufacturing principles.

Working closely with business leaders, clients, product managers, developers, and other key stakeholders, the successful candidate will facilitate collaboration, drive process improvements, and support solution design, testing, and implementation activities. The Functional Business Analyst will act as a bridge between business and technology teams, helping to ensure solutions deliver measurable value, enhance user experiences, and support the strategic objectives of the Ingage IR platform.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Elicit, analyse, document, and validate business requirements through stakeholder engagement, workshops, and discovery sessions.
  • Translate business needs into clear user stories, process maps, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria for delivery teams.
  • Analyse current and future-state processes, identifying opportunities for optimisation, efficiency, and improved user experiences.
  • Collaborate with Product, Technology, UX/UI, and Project teams to support solution design, backlog prioritisation, and successful delivery.

  • Build and manage stakeholder relationships, facilitating alignment, decision-making, and expectation management.

  • Produce and maintain high-quality project documentation in line with governance and organisational standards.
  • Remove delivery blockers and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Drive process improvement initiatives.

What you will bring to the role:

  • Proven Business Analysis experience within digital products, platforms, or CRM environments.
  • Experience within Financial Services.
  • Strong requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation skills.
  • Expertise in user story creation and process mapping (As-Is / To-Be).
  • Experience driving product enhancements, feature development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Experience supporting platform integrations and working across multiple systems.

  • Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • A proactive, self-driven approach with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving, and ambiguous environments.
