title: Marine Cargo Room Operator
description:
Wood is recruiting an MCRO for the DANA Triton, this will be a core crew role on a 2/3 rotation.

The Marine Control Room Operator reports to the OM Supervisor and will assist in all marine aspects relating to the operation of the FSU. Responsible to monitor, control and operate the marine and cargo operations efficiently, ensuring all procedures are adhered to. Ensure to display a pro-active and continuous approach to safety.

The role will be involved in all day-to-day marine operations to ensure safe and effective operation while ensuring compliance with industry standards and safety regulations.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:
 Control, Monitor, receive, store and discharge crude oil cargo and slops, COW, operation of inert gas systems, maintaining stability of FSU and monitoring of FSU safety and control systems complying with all the working and reporting procedures and relevant standards
 Ensure the management and quality of the Cargo
 Operate the ballast system including the operation of ballast valves and pumps, including routine and emergency ballasting/de-ballasting.
 Be fully conversant with the unit’s stability manual with emphasis on stability and methods of recovery from damage conditions.
 The focal point for marine activities when on night-shift, assisting vendors where applicable.
 Operation of a variety of marine systems throughout the FSU such as variable frequency drive cargo systems, bilge and ballast systems, Pot water and sewage systems.
 Complete / record marine planned maintenance activities and update Maintenance Management System (SAP)
 Responsible for the safe and cost effective operation and maintenance of the Facility's marine systems with minimal environmental impact in accordance with legislation, class, flag, and the integrated facility management system.
 Partake in all aspects of the cargo oil offtake operations - cargo transfer, metering, mooring / unmooring co-ordination and documentation
 Ensure the correct and accurate completion of Marine Department Data and reports, including: marine logs, vessel movements, weather reports and hull tank contents, Oil content record books and Garbage record books. Stability record keeping
 Monitoring of pigging operations between the platform and FSU,
 Operation of the vessels oily water separator
 Key involvement in all logistical tasks onboard the asset; Cargo Tanker operations, Supply Vessel operations and organisation of dangerous goods
 Responsible for Vessel Stability (Ballasting and Cargo Loading Management)
 Responsible for the execution of assurance activities in relation to the Written Scheme of Examination
 Responsible for the execution of assurance activities in relation to Class certification
 Maintain complete and accurate records within the Maintenance Management System (SAP)
 Ensure that the required level of reporting and record keeping is maintained.
 Adopt, and promote safety culture, behaviours and values.
 Promote a high level of HSE awareness and proactiveness.
 Compliance with all Company management standards and procedure requirements and support all safety/environmental initiatives.
 Ensure appropriate Risk Assessments are carried out for all activities, with particular attention to recognising the impact of change.
 Ensure that all operational procedures are being correctly applied and adequately monitored.
 Carry out emergency response duties where necessary.
 Carrying out first line maintenance on the various marine systems.
 Monitoring of bilge & void spaces, de-watering as and when required.
 Monitoring mooring system, taking appropriate action as and when directed
 Monitor Aero nautical communications
 Ensure weather monitoring station is fully operational, including Helicopter weather reports
 Any other duties as defined by the OIM and OM Supervisor
 Participate in audit, technical and incident investigations as required.
 Ensure learning opportunities are captured and realised.

Qualifications:

  • Relevant mariner qualifications/HNC/NVQ or equivalent experience
  • CoC
  • STCWs
  • Tanker Experience

Minimum Experience:

  • Control room experience (preferably marine)
  • Practical knowledge of systems plant and equipment relevant to the industry sector in own discipline area
  • Experienced technician practice within an offshore environment.
  • Good working knowledge of marine engine systems
  • Experience of CMMS systems (SAP preferred)

Role-Specific Skills:

  • Demonstrate the ability to apply theory in a practical context.
  • Able to demonstrate team working skills.
  • Good interpersonal skills.

description:
About CooperSurgical

CooperSurgical is a leading fertility and women’s healthcare company dedicated to putting time on the side of women, babies, and families at the healthcare moments that matter most in life. As a business unit of CooperCompanies (Nasdaq: COO), we're driven by a unified purpose of helping people experience life’s beautiful moments. Guided by our shared values – dedicated, innovative, friendly, partners, and do the right thing – our offerings support patients throughout their lifetimes, from contraception to fertility and birth solutions, to women’s and family care, and beyond. We currently offer over 600 clinically relevant medical devices to healthcare providers, including testing and treatment options, as well as an innovative suite of assisted reproductive technology and genomic testing solutions. Learn more at

Work location: Trumbull, CT or Livingston, NJ (on-site)

Scope:

The Sr. Global CAPA Engineer serves as a subject matter expert for the Global Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Program, providing technical leadership, facilitation, and guidance to ensure effective investigation, root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and effectiveness verification across CooperSurgical.

This role partners with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, and other functional teams to support the timely execution of CAPAs, strengthen problem-solving capabilities, and drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Job Summary:

The Sr. Global CAPA Engineer is responsible for supporting the execution and effectiveness of CooperSurgical's Global CAPA Program. This role provides expert guidance to CAPA owners on investigation techniques, root cause analysis, risk evaluation, corrective action development, effectiveness verification, and documentation requirements.

The Sr. Global CAPA Engineer facilitates complex and high-risk CAPAs, performs quality reviews of CAPA records, analyzes CAPA trends, and identifies opportunities to improve quality system performance. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, this role helps ensure CAPAs are executed consistently, effectively, and in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and company procedures.

• Provide technical guidance and support to CAPA owners throughout all phases of the CAPA process.
• Facilitate complex, high-risk, and cross-functional CAPAs to ensure timely progression and successful completion.
• Review CAPA records for completeness, scientific rigor, and compliance with established procedures.
• Support investigation activities, root cause analysis, corrective action planning, and effectiveness verification.
• Conduct quality reviews of CAPA documentation to ensure records are complete, accurate, and inspection ready.
• Identify and escalate risks that may impact CAPA quality, timelines, or regulatory compliance.
• Support remediation activities related to audit observations, inspection findings, quality events, and systemic issues.
• Ensure CAPA activities comply with internal procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Monitor CAPA performance metrics, aging, and effectiveness trends.
• Analyze data to identify recurring issues, systemic trends, and opportunities for improvement.
• Support development of management reporting, dashboards, and CAPA performance reviews.
• Recommend process improvements that enhance CAPA effectiveness and quality system maturity.
• Coach CAPA owners and cross-functional teams on root cause analysis, investigation methodologies, corrective action planning, and effectiveness verification.
• Deliver CAPA-related training and onboarding sessions.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Travel: This position may require 10-20% domestic and/or international travel.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, EU MDR regulatory requirements.
  • Experience managing projects at a Global Level in a regulated environment.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or above
  • Strong decision-making skills, ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Strong technical writing skills
  • Ability to provide critical review and feedback on quality records
  • Ability to read and interpret technical and regulatory documentation.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills (English).
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global cross-functional teams in a regulated environment.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced setting with shifting priorities while maintaining attention to detail and compliance standards.

Work Environment:

  • Primarily office-based with regular use of computer systems and virtual collaboration tools

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in medical device, pharmaceutical, biologics, or other regulated industries.
  • 3+ years of direct CAPA, quality engineering, quality systems, or compliance experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex investigations and root cause analyses.
  • Working knowledge of FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, MDSAP, and EU MDR requirements.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in biomedical engineering or related technical discipline.

  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) preferred.

  • Project Management Certifications preferred.

description:

The New Games team is looking for a highly skilled Senior VFX & Animation Generalist to join us. This is a hands-on and creative role for someone who can take visual effects and motion design from ideation to final in-game implementation. You will help design, build, and polish the VFX and motion language of the game, working closely with art, design, tech art, engineering, and production.

Crucially, we need someone who can take full ownership of the pipeline that drives the dynamic, deeply satisfying VFX and interactions seen in top-tier, highly polished casual puzzle games. We are looking for a generalist who combines strong artistic judgment with deep hands-on Unity experience.

Responsibilities

  • Own, build, and optimize the VFX and animation pipeline, establishing efficient workflows tailored to producing the highly dynamic and rewarding interactions expected in top-tier casual puzzle games.
  • Create high-quality VFX and animations from ideation, concept, and visual exploration through to final implementation in Unity.
  • Design and implement "juicy" interactions and celebratory effects that make every player interaction feel incredibly tactile and satisfying.
  • Bring your own creative ideas to the table to make the puzzle pieces, UI, environments, and effects feel alive and responsive.
  • Work hands-on with modern Unity workflows, including the Animation timeline, Particle System, Shader Graph, URP, custom materials, and animation-driven effects.
  • Translate concepts, prototypes, gameplay needs, and rough ideas into clear, polished in-engine effects and motion.
  • Optimize VFX and animations for mobile, balancing visual ambition with performance, memory, readability, and production constraints.
  • Identify visual, technical, and workflow bottlenecks in the pipeline, and propose practical solutions.
  • Collaborate with tech art and engineering on shaders, tools, profiling, and runtime performance.

Requirements

  • Significant experience (at a Senior, Lead, or Principal level) creating real-time VFX and animations for games, specifically casual puzzle games or highly polished free-to-play titles.
  • Proven experience owning, building, or significantly contributing to a VFX and animation pipeline for mobile.
  • A strong grasp of fundamental animation principles applied to gameplay elements, UI, and effects.
  • Strong hands-on experience making VFX and animations directly in Unity.
  • A strong portfolio showing high-quality in-game VFX and motion design from idea to final implementation, highlighting "juicy" and satisfying visual feedback.
  • The ability to create assets from early ideation, concept, mood boards, mockups, prototypes, or rough direction and turn them into polished in-engine results.
  • A strong understanding of mobile performance constraints and optimization techniques.
  • The ability to troubleshoot visual bugs, sorting issues, and performance problems.
  • Strong collaboration skills across art, design, technical art, engineering, and production.
  • A proactive, organized, and self-driven approach to your work.

What Makes You Successful In This Role

  • You are not waiting for tasks to be assigned. You look at the game, understand what it needs, and help raise the bar.
  • You are comfortable owning a feature’s VFX and motion from start to finish: shaping the idea, exploring the visual direction, implementing it in Unity, polishing it, and keeping stakeholders informed and aligned.
  • You can explain your creative and technical choices clearly, take feedback well, and help the team make better visual decisions.
  • Most importantly, you make the game feel better and the player feel profoundly rewarded.

  • Private medical care

  • Life insurance and a favorable pension scheme
  • Healthcare cash plan including dental and optical coverage

title: Senior Back-End Developer (Node.JS)
description:
About the Role Are you a seasoned Backend Engineer who excels at scaling high-load architectures, optimizing complex databases, and crafting clean, testable code? We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js/Nest.js) to join our partner's engineering team on-site in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. If you thrive on solving sophisticated database bottlenecks, building resilient microservices from scratch, and handling Big Data in a high-concurrency environment, this is your next big career move.

About the Client Our partner is a dynamic tech powerhouse building cutting-edge product engineering solutions across Fintech, iGaming, and Marketing. They excel at turning innovative concepts into high-performing engines and launching them at global scale. As their exclusive recruitment partner, Lionhires manages their full-cycle talent acquisition, connecting top-tier tech talent with this fast-growing, ambitious team.

What You Will Do

  • Architect & Develop: Build and maintain robust in-house backend platforms using Node.js and Nest.js within a high-performing microservices architecture.

  • Database & High-Load Optimization: Solve complex DB performance bottlenecks by debugging queries, managing index strategies, leveraging data partitioning, and optimizing high-load SQL/NoSQL databases (MySQL, MongoDB).

  • API & Service Integration: Design and implement high-throughput third-party API integrations, working with REST, GraphQL, and WebSockets.

  • Guard Reliability & Quality: Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following TDD principles, utilizing Redis and RabbitMQ to ensure maximum system reliability.

  • Collaborate & Scale: Work closely with cross-functional teams to design, normalize, and continuously improve scalable data systems.

What You Bring

  • Proven Experience: At least 5 years of commercial web development experience, with 5+ years focused specifically on Node.js and Nest.js.

  • Database Mastery: Hands-on experience managing relational/NoSQL DBs and Big Data, with a deep understanding of table indexing, the DB Query Planner, normalization principles, and query optimization.

  • Architecture & Messaging: Strong knowledge of microservice architecture, REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, RabbitMQ, and Redis.

  • Engineering Standards: Solid proficiency in ES6+, Git version control, and Test-Driven Development (TDD).

  • Communication: Intermediate (or higher) English proficiency with strong problem-solving capabilities and collaborative skills.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript.

  • 2+ years of experience working with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and Kubernetes.

  • Practical experience using NATS.

What's in It for You

  • Financial Growth: Highly competitive remuneration level with structured annual performance reviews.

  • Global Mobility: Full relocation support to Ras Al Khaimah, UAE (including flight tickets, up to 2 weeks of hotel accommodation, and visa support for you and your family members).

  • Work-Life Balance: 21 non-business days of paid annual vacation plus 6 fully paid sick days.

  • Professional Growth: Opportunities to tackle high-load technical challenges and company-supported language development initiatives.

  • Culture & Perks: Regular team-building activities in a collaborative, supportive tech environment.

Our Recruitment Process We respect your time and aim to keep our process transparent and efficient:

  1. Initial Screen: A casual conversation with a Lionhires Recruiter to discuss your background and expectations.

  2. Technical Assessment: A practical evaluation via HackerRank.

  3. Technical Interview: A deep-dive discussion with our partner’s Technical Team.

  4. Final Interview: A strategic conversation with the Hiring Leads.

  5. Offer: Welcome aboard!

(Please note: This is a full-time, on-site role in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. Remote or hybrid options are not available for this position.)

Sureserve is a trusted partner for housing associations, local authorities, and residents, delivering high-quality compliance and energy services. About the role

Lead a team of field-based Gas Engineers across a range of domestic heating and gas maintenance contracts. Deliver safe, high-quality services while supporting and developing engineers in the field. You’ll be part of a supportive team that values expertise, reliability and great customer service. We offer a positive working environment, opportunities for development and the chance to make a meaningful impact, in the communities we serve.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
• Seeking an experienced Senior AI/ML Engineer specialized in Generative AI and Agentic Systems.

  • Role focuses on the end-to-end design, development, optimization, and deployment of autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents.

  • Architect multi-agent orchestration systems, design enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and implement production-ready MLOps infrastructure utilizing Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and containerized environments.

  • Design, develop, and deploy autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents utilizing leading frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or Google's Agent Development Kit/Vertex AI Agent Builder to automate and optimize enterprise business processes.

  • Architect complex multi-agent systems, establishing robust orchestration patterns, task decomposition methods, cognitive planning loops, and inter-agent communication protocols like Model Context Protocol, function-calling, and structured tool execution.

  • Build, secure, and maintain integrations between AI agents and external enterprise systems, APIs (REST/GraphQL), databases, and Google Cloud services such as BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, and Vertex AI APIs.

  • Implement advanced memory management paradigms including short-term, long-term, episodic, and semantic memory to maintain context, state, and historical execution metadata across user sessions.

  • Author, test, and optimize advanced prompt templates and system instructions while establishing and maintaining reusable prompt libraries to ensure deterministic, safe, and repeatable agent behaviors.

  • Evaluate, select, and fine-tune foundation models such as Gemini or other open-source/proprietary models via Vertex AI Model Garden to balance model capability, execution latency, and API inference costs.

  • Design and optimize high-throughput, low-latency RAG pipelines, ensuring clean document ingestion, smart text chunking (semantic/character-based), and high-quality embedding generation.

  • Integrate and manage scalable vector databases such as Vertex AI Vector Search, AlloyDB, or similar vector stores to ground AI agent responses in verified enterprise knowledge.

  • Analyze, clean, and pre-process complex structured and unstructured data sources to optimize model ingestion and ensure efficient data access.

  • Write, test, and maintain declarative Infrastructure as Code scripts using Terraform to provision secure GCP environments, including GKE clusters, Cloud Run services, Vertex AI endpoints, storage buckets, and networking components.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, GitLab CI, or Jenkins for automated testing, container building, and seamless multi-environment deployment of agent configurations, prompt files, and backend tools.

  • Package application code, agents, and dependencies into secure Docker containers, orchestrating deployments on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) or deploying serverless workflows via Cloud Run.

  • Configure, schedule, and maintain workflow orchestrators such as Vertex AI Pipelines or Cloud Composer/Airflow to automate scheduled agent evaluation cycles, model fine-tuning, and data ingestion processes.

  • Establish comprehensive evaluation metrics and testing pipelines to measure task completion rates, reasoning depth, tool-calling precision, latency, token consumption, and hallucination rates utilizing LLM-as-a-judge and Vertex AI evaluation tools.

  • Implement robust input/output content filtering, moderation tools, grounding validators, prompt-injection defenses, data privacy checks, and human-in-the-loop approval gates.

  • Implement production monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, and real-time alerting using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, Prometheus, Grafana, or dedicated LLM observability tools like LangSmith.

  • Continually audit and optimize agent workflows, model parameters, caching strategies, and underlying infrastructure to maximize cost-efficiency and performance under high loads.

  • Adhere to strict version control standards using Git, managing branching, pull requests, and code review workflows for code, prompts, Dockerfiles, and Terraform scripts.

  • Partner closely with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and business units to translate complex operational requirements into scalable production-grade AI solutions.

  • Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including system architecture diagrams, agent flowcharts, tool definitions, prompt engineering strategies, containerization guidelines, and standard operating procedures.

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Machine Learning or AI Engineering with a strong foundation in MLOps practices.

  • At least 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience specifically designing and implementing LLM-based, generative AI, or agentic systems in production.

  • Expert-level Python programming skills and experience with standard machine learning libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.

  • Strong theoretical and practical understanding of deep learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Transformer architectures.

  • Hands-on experience using agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or Vertex AI Agent Builder.

  • Proven experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and container services including Docker, Kubernetes/GKE, Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions.

  • Proven experience working with vector indexing, semantic search, and databases like Vertex AI Vector Search, AlloyDB, or equivalents.

  • Solid understanding of database systems (SQL/NoSQL) and building or consuming REST and GraphQL APIs.

  • Experience with Terraform, Git, and automated CI/CD tools like Cloud Build, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.

  • Experience setting up monitoring solutions such as Prometheus, Cloud Logging, or LangSmith, and evaluating LLM outputs for quality and safety.

  • Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, and analytical skills for diagnosing complex agent behavior, tool failures, and infrastructure bottlenecks.

  • Exceptional collaborative and communication skills to effectively translate complex technical constraints to cross-functional stakeholders.

  • GCP Professional Machine Learning Engineer or Google Professional Cloud Architect certifications are highly desired.

title: Engineer II Mechanical Engineering X
description:
SR Mechanical Design Engineer:

Job Summary

Vertiv is seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled SR Mechanical Design Engineer to supporting high-impact projects in the data center industry with a strong focus on low-voltage (LV) power distribution systems. The Mechanical Engineer will focus and be responsible for designing the Mechanical part for Switchboard / Switchgear product lines. The mechanical Engineer supports the design from start to finish and provides technical guidance to Supply chain and Material Management in global and local locations to support New Product Development and sustaining products. The role will review requirements and specifications, provide feedback, and use 3D CAD software to develop product designs. The product designs are documented in PLM software to release drawings and bills of material.

We are looking for candidate who are self-directed, solution-focused, and thrive in cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

  • Lead and contribute to the global environment in providing design engineering support for new product development, Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE), and improvement projects.
  • Serve as the Mechanical Engineer (ME) to lead concept and detailed design of power systems including the use of sheet metal, busbar, power cable, and wire harnesses.
  • Develop complex drawings and bills of material designs, including 2D drawings and/or MBD (Model Based Design) for the mechanical design.
  • Collaborate with other Mechanical Engineers to efficiently break down tasks, discuss design ideas, and work towards the best possible solution.
  • Write, submit, and release change orders for new and released products into our PLM system using our revision control system.
  • Execute diverse projects and assignments, ranging from concept design to NPD, Bills of Materials (BOM), CAD modelling, detailing (using Solidworks Tool), and Change Orders, maintaining organizational quality standards.
  • Request and review analysis for Seismic, CFD, and Thermal designs while working with our internal simulation team.
  • Work with manufacturing engineers and production associates to build prototypes and provide direction when needed.
  • Familiarity with and ability to interpret industry design standards (UL, NEC, and IEC) for application to product designs.
  • Order parts/components and support for prototype builds and production.
  • Create customer facing product submittal drawings for finished designs.
  • Support prototype/product testing as needed – typically assisting in thermal, mechanical layout, and mechanical strength issues.
  • Support manufacturing with building issues of new designs.
  • Occasional contact with outside vendors and suppliers as needed.
  • Identify areas requiring process improvement or documentation. Work with management to execute improvements.

Qualifications:

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or directly related degree or equivalent work experience.

Additional / Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering with 6 to 9 years of experience in product development.; OR Associate’s Degree with minimum 9+ years experience.
  • Expert in 3D CAD design and programs, prefer experience with Solidworks and/or Creo.
  • Working experience on any PLM tools. Agile or PD cloud will be added advantage.
  • Knowledge and hands on experience of sheet metal fabrication process is must. Experience in a fabrication environment would be an added advantage.
  • Experience on telecom/electrical enclosure design is added advantage
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Ability to interpret electrical schematics and familiarity with electrical components such as fuses, circuit breakers, and transformers.
  • Experience with model-based design (MBD) plus but not required.
  • General knowledge of 3-phase power is preferred but not required.
  • The ability to work effectively in a cross functional group setting, including providing technical guidance to support management.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to summarize technical data/results quickly for non-technical audiences.

Physical & Environmental Requirements: - (To be used majorly for manufacturing jobs.)

  • None

title: AI Tech Lead
description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a AI Lead Developer, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 4+ years of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role & Responsibilities

  • 1. Strong experience in frontend development using ReactJS and Next.js
    Solid backend engineering skills in Python (FastAPI) with working knowledge of NodeJS or NestJS
    2. Hands-on experience with AI and LLM-based systems, including embeddings, intelligent analysis, and private or offline AI setups
    3. Experience with vector databases such as OpenSearch or Chroma for similarity search and RAG-based solutions
    4. Practical exposure to model evaluation, response accuracy tuning, and hallucination reduction techniques
    5. Strong understanding of data handling using PostgreSQL and object storage platforms such as Azure Blob Storage, Azure Data Lake, or MinIO for structured and unstructured data
    6. Ability to analyze data, build KPIs, and derive actionable insights using SQL and Python
    7. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, security best practices, and enterprise-grade system design
    8. Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to translate complex technical solutions into measurable business value

Must Have

  • 1. Experience with AI workflows such as RAG, agent-based systems, LLM-driven integrations, and scalable AI pipelines

    2. Exposure to private or offline AI setups, including local LLM deployments

    3. Strong backend experience using Python with FastAPI for building AI services and APIs

    4. Frontend exposure using ReactJS / Next.js for AI-driven user interfaces

    5. Good understanding of PostgreSQL and object storage platforms such as Azure Blob Storage, Azure Data Lake, or MinIO

    6. Experience building KPIs, dashboards, and insights using SQL and Python

    7. Background in Retail, Digital, or large-scale enterprise platforms

    8. Ability to explain complex AI and technical concepts in a simple, business-friendly manner

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a Fulltime position based in Bangalore.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud! Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

At Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA), we have one clear goal: to create low-cost, flexible, and reliable access to space. We specialize in building small launch vehicles designed to deploy satellites into Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and beyond. Together with you, we aim to revolutionize space services and help improve life on Earth. Sounds interesting? Then join our journey and become part of the team driving the New Space movement in Europe.

Our international and agile team is looking for support from a motivated person as a Intern (m/f/d) Systems Engineering. Do you want to revolutionize space travel in New Space? Then you've come to the right place.

Job Description:

ROLE OVERVIEW
The Data Visualisation & Governance Director will be responsible for the technical delivery of data visualisation and taxonomy projects.
This is a client-facing, technical role requiring hands-on experience of media data and infrastructure, with the expertise to understand client requirements, identify and design appropriate solutions and ensure successful delivery.
The role will support in ensuring accurate data, reporting and governance solutions are in place with a high degree of accuracy, as well as supporting other analytics teams with data outputs for further analysis and modelling.
An independent worker, this person will also enjoy collaborating with team members from the EMEA DMV hub, as well as with colleagues from other markets and other Omnicom agency partners.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Be the key point of contact for the client on data governance and BI projects, working with them to understand their data needs and create robust solutions to address them.
Communicate with stakeholders and clients to understand analytics, reporting and data requirements.
Design and define new data solution requirements, ensuring they are practical, scalable and aligned to client needs.
Lead the design, build and ongoing maintenance of data visualisation solutions, ensuring dashboards and reporting outputs are clear, accurate, scalable and aligned to client and stakeholder needs.
Support client-side data solutions, ensuring the accurate flow of data from source through to output.
Drive discovery and adoption of relevant analytics, measurement and reporting tools.
Support the development and implementation of AI-enabled initiatives where relevant to client and agency priorities.
Challenge existing ways of working and identify opportunities to improve the delivery of analytics and data services.
Drive efficiencies in how analytics services are delivered through standardisation, automation and improved ways of working.

Work with media specialists, media operations and ad operations teams to ensure governance and compliance with agreed taxonomies, templates and processes.

title: Experienced Assistant Driller
description:

Role Description:

Arcadis are looking for a new Assistant driller / Site Labourer to be based from our Gloucester facility. The position will involve working throughout the UK across a variety of sites and sectors including manufacturing, petrochemical, and construction environments.

Whilst beneficial, no previous experience in land drilling is necessary as this is an entry-level role with great scope for promotion through to lead driller in the future, this role requires someone who enjoys working outside in a wide variety of site environments.

The role will require you to travel to sites across the UK during the working week and stay local to the drilling site Monday-Friday. PPE and Single Accommodation/Travel expenses will be provided.

Please note that, although the majority of work will be away, daily commuting to the depot will be required; therefore, the successful candidate will reside within a reasonable commute from Gloucester.

  • As an Assistant Driller, you will operate in a two-person team supporting the Lead Driller to complete drilling projects across the UK and occasionally in Europe.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Ability to stay away from home Monday-Friday. Single occupancy accommodation, Travel and Food allowance will be provided.
  • Basic IT Skills
  • The following competencies/accreditations would be beneficial: CSCS, SPA/PIA, Personal Track Safety (PTS) but if not held the required training will be provided in any event by Arcadis.

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We believe that by working together diverse people with different experiences develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of how we improve quality of life and we work closely with our people across six ED&I Workstreams: Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+ and Race. A diverse and skilled workforce is essential to our success.

title: Tax Analyst (Direct Tax)

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

  • Global exposure: hands-on corporate tax compliance work across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas
  • Mentorship from the International Tax Manager, with room to grow into cross-border tax expertise
  • A front-row seat to major international tax shifts

  • Prior experience and proficiency with corporate tax compliance (including corporate income taxes, withholding taxes on payroll, withholding taxes on local and cross-border services), with at least 4 years of aggregate experience, with a consultancy background being considered a plus
  • You have proven advisory and compliance experience across direct taxes, both local and cross-border (as well as with tax treaties), including working knowledge of transfer pricing rules
  • You have strong analytical skills and a high attention to detail
  • You keep track of recent updates in tax topics that are relevant for corporate tax compliance (e.g., Pillars 1, 2 of the OECD Programme of Work, DSTs)
  • You possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with different stakeholders
  • Writes and speaks fluent English. Other languages are considered a plus
  • It is not required for you to have experience working remotely, but it is considered a plus

Key Responsibilities

  • Report to the International Tax Manager and assist in the control of corporate tax compliance tasks (e.g., filings, supporting documentation, payments) for all the companies of the Remote group worldwide
  • Work with tax advisors to prepare and submit reports/returns related to the corporate tax obligations of Remote group entities
  • Handle analysis of sensitive topics on corporate tax (internal and/or with the assistance of external partners), ranging from compliance issues to tax planning worldwide
  • Ensure a status of sustainable compliance before the tax authorities of the countries in which Remote operates
  • Analyze and discuss risk positions if those arise in Remote's corporate tax compliance
  • Support the team in tax audits and inspections worldwide
  • Monitor changes in tax law in several jurisdictions (EMEA, APAC, North America, Central and South America)

Practicals

  • Location: For this position we welcome everyone to apply

Application process

We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

$1—$3 USD

Benefits

  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • budget towards co-working spaces, learning and wellness (including gym memberships)
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • home office budget & IT equipment

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at .

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.

description:
Principal Machine Learning Engineer

Europe Remote | Up to 135,000 Base + Bonus (c.150,000 OTE)

This is an opportunity to join a growing, profitable AI-driven technology business where machine learning is central to the product and commercial strategy. The role offers a rare blend of technical leadership and hands-on engineering, allowing you to shape the future direction of ML systems while solving complex challenges at scale.

The Company

They are an established technology scale-up that develops advanced machine learning solutions to power highly personalised digital experiences for millions of users worldwide. Operating internationally, the business has grown significantly in recent years and continues to invest heavily in its data and AI capabilities.

Their machine learning teams work on large-scale real-time systems where model performance directly impacts commercial outcomes. With a collaborative engineering culture and strong leadership support, they offer an environment where innovation and experimentation are encouraged.

The Role

As a Principal Machine Learning Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across the machine learning function while remaining closely involved in model development and production systems.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Defining technical direction for machine learning systems and frameworks.

  • Enhancing machine learning infrastructure, experimentation platforms and deployment processes.
  • Partnering with engineering leaders and business stakeholders to align machine learning initiatives with commercial objectives.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience building and owning machine learning systems in production.
  • Experience developing and deploying machine learning models at scale.
  • Advanced Python skills alongside experience with modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Excellent understanding of MLOps, model lifecycle management and production machine learning environments.
  • Experience working with recommendation systems, predictive modelling, LTV modelling, churn prediction or related machine learning applications.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with a focus on scalability, performance and reliability.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • PhD in a STEM discipline.
  • Experience within DSP environments.

What They Offer

  • 4.5-day working week with Friday afternoons off.

  • Longevity bonus awarded every two years.
  • Strong work-life balance and employee wellbeing initiatives.
  • The opportunity to shape machine learning strategy within a growing and profitable technology business.
  • Clear opportunities for progression and increased technical influence.

Interview Process

  1. Introductory conversation with the Talent Acquisition team.
  2. Take-home technical assessment.
  3. Technical interview and assessment review with senior machine learning engineers.
  4. Interview with the CTO.
  5. Final executive leadership interview.

How to Apply

If you are an experienced Principal Machine Learning Engineer looking to combine technical leadership with hands-on machine learning development, please apply to learn more about this opportunity.

  • Technical proficiency with Google BigQuery, cloud-native data pipelines (GCP preferred), Docker, Kubernetes, and messaging queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

  • Hands-on experience across full-stack technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Storybook, Node.js, Go, Python) and distributed source control tools (Git).

title: Senior AI Privacy Risk Consultant
description:
Senior Privacy & AI Risk Consultant (Contract)

Location: Remote

Contract Duration: 12 months

Department: Privacy Team, Office of Ethics & Compliance (Enterprise AI Programme)

The Opportunity

Are you a Subject Matter Expert in data privacy and AI governance? Have you guided global enterprise organizations through the complex, evolving landscape of AI compliance?

We are partnering with a global leader in medical technology, to find a highly experienced Privacy & AI Risk Contractor to support their cutting-edge Enterprise AI programme. In this highly visible role, you will sit within the Office of Ethics & Compliance, acting as the bridge between complex AI use cases and practical, global privacy risk management.

If you are a seasoned consultant who thrives in a fast-paced environment and has a proven track record of delivering privacy assessments for major enterprise logos-especially within the Healthcare, Life Sciences, Pharma, or Medical Device sectors-this is the perfect contract for you.

What You Will Do

As our AI Privacy SME, you will ensure that appropriate privacy controls are built into relevant AI solutions from design through implementation. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Lead AI Risk Assessments: Drive privacy risk assessments for prioritized enterprise AI projects, including Generative AI, LLMs, and machine learning use cases.
  • Apply Governance Frameworks: Assess use cases against current privacy and AI risk frameworks (focusing on accountability, human oversight, third-party risk, transparency, and data use).
  • Conduct Global Privacy Reviews: Execute Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs), and review complex cross-border data flows, model locations, and retention requirements.
  • Embed Privacy by Design: Identify and document practical controls, mitigations, and actions across technology, process, and governance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Security, Legal, Compliance, Regulatory, Data, IT, and business owners to integrate privacy into AI risk registers and decision gates.
  • Executive Advisory: Prepare clear, concise written risk assessments, escalation notes, and strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders.
What You Bring to the Table

We are looking for an independent, fast-paced contractor who can seamlessly translate complex technical and regulatory issues into clear business recommendations.

Essential Experience:

  • SME-Level Expertise: Significant, global-scale professional experience in data privacy, AI governance, technology risk, or legal/compliance advisory.
  • Enterprise Pedigree: Proven experience working with large, global enterprise logos.
  • AI & Emerging Tech: Direct experience advising on the privacy risks associated with GenAI, ML, LLMs, and automated decision-making.
  • Regulatory Mastery: Deep understanding of GDPR, UK GDPR, the EU AI Act, and international privacy requirements.
  • Practical Assessment Skills: Extensive hands-on experience conducting DPIAs, TIAs, and vendor assessments across multiple jurisdictions.

Highly Desired:

  • Industry Background: Previous experience working with big names in highly regulated sectors (Medical Devices, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or Pharmaceuticals) is a massive plus.
  • Certifications: Privacy, compliance, or AI governance qualifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, AIGP, or equivalent.
Why This Contract?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the responsible use of AI at a global medical technology enterprise. You will be operating at the forefront of AI governance, tackling complex, real-world technology challenges in a developing programme environment that values pragmatic, independent expertise.

Ready to help build the future of responsible AI in healthcare?Submit your resume at Prasanna . merugu @ randstaddigital . comwith a brief overview of your enterprise AI/Privacy project experience to apply.

Interpret these regulatory updates and collaborate with operational teams to implement policy changes.

Drive risk remediation programs for escalated compliance issues, providing cross-functional leaders with actionable, best-practice solutions.

Serve as an objective, independent gatekeeper to prevent operational shortcuts, ensuring logistics growth aligns with legal standards and brand reputation.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Logistics/Supply Chain Management, Law, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or related fields.

  • Deep technical knowledge of localized transportation regulations, dangerous goods (Hazmat) handling, warehouse regulatory standards, and 3PL contractor compliance management.

title: Gas Engineer
description:
Sureserve is a trusted partner for housing associations, local authorities, and residents, delivering high-quality compliance and energy services. Our focus on energy efficiency, safe and compliant homes, and enhanced quality of life makes us a leader in the industry. With nationwide reach, regional expertise, and a commitment to excellent service, we are well-positioned to support our clients now and, in the future.

Location: Covers all PL and occasionally EX23 and TR areas

title: Building Services Engineer Support - UK Wide / Mobile
description:
We are currently recruiting for a Building Services Engineer Support position within a large UK-wide residential estate. This is a national mobile role, providing technical support across a diverse portfolio of properties.

The successful candidate will support the Building Services Manager with planned and reactive maintenance, technical investigations, building projects, compliance, asset management and lifecycle works.


Key Responsibilities
  • Provide technical support across planned, reactive and emergency building works.
  • Support project works, including design reviews, specifications, testing and snagging.
  • Investigate technical issues and identify appropriate solutions.
  • Produce professional reports covering building services, compliance and technical issues.
  • Carry out desktop and physical site asset surveys.
  • Provide technical advice across mechanical, electrical, building fabric and control systems.
  • Assist with project scopes, specifications, tenders and requests for quotation.
  • Support cost estimates, lifecycle replacement programmes and CAPEX projects.
  • Manage specialist subcontractors where required, ensuring compliance with health and safety requirements.


About You
  • Relevant technical or Building Services qualification, ideally degree level or equivalent.
  • Previous experience working as a Building Services Engineer, preferably across a large or multi-site estate.
  • Good knowledge of Health & Safety, environmental legislation, CDM and contractor management.
  • Knowledge of UK Building Regulations, British/Harmonised Standards and relevant UK legislation.
  • Strong analytical, organisational and planning skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel nationally as this is a mobile position.


Benefits
  • Annual discretionary bonus of up to 10%
  • Annual salary review
  • 5 weeks' annual leave
  • 1 paid Volunteer Day
  • Enhanced family leave
  • 2 weeks' sick leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Health and wellbeing benefits
  • Medicash health insurance
  • Cycle to Work Scheme

This is a mobile role and a company vehicle is not provided. Business mileage can be claimed at 45p per mile. Public transport and overnight stays can be arranged and booked through the company.

description:
Are you a recent school leaver or in your final year of school and looking for a direct pathway to becoming a qualified tax adviser?

We are offering a 5-year training opportunity (and a permanent role) to a motivated and ambitious individual with a desire to learn. This is a great opportunity to join our growing personal tax team as a Trainee Personal Tax Associate and to learn “on the job” from experienced tax professionals. You don’t need a degree to build a successful career and this role offers a practical alternative, where you can earn a salary, gain real business experience, and work in a professional environment from day one. We will support a successful candidate in achieving the “gold standard” in professional tax qualifications with a route to ATT and CTA qualification.

At our firm, we believe in putting our people first and investing in their future. You will receive support and encouragement from mentors and peers along the way. You won't just be an employee; you'll be a valued member of a supportive team dedicated to helping each other succeed and deliver great service to our clients.

If you are ready to kickstart your career in a firm that values you and your future, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your cover letter and CV covering your qualifications, work experience, your ambitions and why you think you would be a great fit for our team.


What is Personal Tax?


Personal tax or private client tax is a system of taxation applied to individuals on their income, capital gains, savings, investments and on death. It encompasses both tax compliance matters, ensuring individuals meet statutory filing and payment requirements, and advisory services, which focus on planning for the future and optimising our clients tax position.


The Role


As a Trainee Personal Tax Associate, you will be a key part of our personal tax team, learning the skills required to provide expert advice and support to a range of clients. As a large team we offer both tax compliance and advisory services to our clients and you will have the chance to get involved in interesting work.

Responsibilities will include preparation of tax returns, conducting research on tax rules and guidance, communication directly with HMRC on client matters and supporting the team with administrative tasks.

You will learn not only the technical skills required for role but the interpersonal and soft skills required from a tax adviser which will be key to your future growth in the industry.


What We Offer


We are committed to helping you achieve your professional goals. For successful candidates, we offer:

· Full support and funding for professional tax examinations, including study leave

· Mentorship from experienced professionals who will guide your development.

· A collaborative work environment with the opportunity to make an impact

· A clear training and progression path for the first 5 years and opportunities to progress within the firm beyond your training contract. A competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.


What We're Looking For


We are offering an opportunity to forge a rewarding career in a professional firm, learning hands on experience without a university degree. The

· A strong academic record including a Mathematics and English qualifications, at least at Higher level.

· A willingness to learn and ability to take initiative when approaching tasks.

· Excellent problem-solving skills and a keen eye for detail.

· Good communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively interact with clients and colleagues.


How to Apply:

If you are ready to kickstart your career in a firm that values you and your future, we would love to hear from you. Please send us your CV and cover letter with details of your qualifications, work experience, your ambitions and why you think you would be a great fit for our team!

title: Technical Solutions Engineer
description:
About Teads


Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform focused on driving outcomes for brand and performance advertisers across screens. With a focus on meaningful business outcomes for branding and performance objectives, Teads drives value by leveraging predictive AI technology to connect quality media, beautiful brand creative, and context-driven addressability and measurement. About the opportunity

Teads is looking for a Technical Solutions Engineer to join our team in Canada. This is a second-tier role: you'll take on the platform-level technical issues escalated from first-tier support, investigate them end to end, and work alongside the people building recommendation technology for the open web.

You will be the go-to technical support person, owning a broad set of issues from campaign troubleshooting to integrations and escalations. You will partner cross-functionally with key stakeholders across R&D, AdOps, Account Management, and Product to drive client success. Based in Canada and operating during North American business hours, this role complements our global support center in Slovenia to extend our support coverage across time zones.

What will you do:

  • Own second-tier technical cases end to end, keeping them prioritized and within SLA.
  • Investigate issues escalated by first-tier support and AdOps, and drive them to resolution.

  • Handle reports coming in through Slack, Salesforce, email, and other channels promptly.

  • Pull data from our databases, analyze it, and turn it into clear insights and solutions for marketers.
  • Document known issues, workarounds, and escalation paths for the wider team.
  • Collaborate across teams to surface ideas that improve our products.

What will you bring to the team?

  • Experience in a technical support or technical solutions role, ideally in ad tech, with a track record of resolving customer-facing technical issues.
  • Systematic, hypothesis-driven troubleshooter who knows when to dig in and when to escalate.
  • Clear communicator who works well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and can de-escalate frustrated clients.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment juggling multiple priorities.
  • Solid grasp of how the web works, for example JavaScript, HTML, HTTP, iframes, cookies, the DOM, etc
  • Working knowledge of SQL for analytical queries (joins, aggregations, CTEs).

  • Proficient with a text editor (VS Code, Sublime, Vim, or similar).
  • Basic Git and command line.
  • Fluent in English; other languages could be a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior ad tech experience.
  • Chrome DevTools for debugging.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and Jira.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools.
  • Comfortable working with APIs and REST clients like Postman or Insomnia.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude (Claude Code or Cowork), Gemini, and similar to speed up troubleshooting, analysis, and automation.
  • Experience with automation tools like n8n or Workato.

If you're a self-driven learner who enjoys digging into complex technical problems, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't tick every box. If you're curious, eager to learn, and interested in the work, we encourage you to apply.

Please submit your CV in English.

Life at Teads

At Teads, we don’t just offer new roles - we blend creativity, technology, and data to shape the future of media. You’ll work with smart humans, meaningful brands, and cool tools, all while helping redefine how advertising works in a world that demands more transparency, better insights, and smarter strategies.

As a Teadster, you’ll play a critical role in shaping our future success in the region. Here’s why Teads stands out:

  • We've merged two open internet category leaders—Outbrain and Teads—to create the ‘new’ Teads, a unified omnichannel platform that drives results from branding to performance across all screens, including CTV, mobile, and web.

title: Continuous Improvement Lead
location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
description:
Job Purpose

The Group Business Services (GBS) strategy is to create a customer centric Continuous Improvement (CI) culture across the GBS to embed end-to-end process transformation, which includes embedding CI principles in the GBS operations, as well as across value streams. The Continuous Improvement (CI) Lead: GBS drives the development of a continuous improvement centric CI culture across the GBS; an integral part in leading the people, customer and transformation agenda. The CI lead: GBS is the single point of accountability for the development and deployment of continuous improvement initiatives across the GBS.

To deliver this, the CI lead is expected to operate at GBS, Central and OU Senior Management level, whilst also engaging and working across the organisation hierarchy. The person will partner with GBS functional heads to define and continuously evolve the continuous improvement (CI) strategy and priorities. This includes championing the organization-wide adoption of world-class CI principles, ensuring alignment across customer experience, operational excellence, and cost transformation goals.

Key responsibilities include deploying and sustaining CI practices across teams, while actively engaging and coaching leadership to reinforce a culture of continuous improvement and build a strong CI deployment pipeline. The person will also be expected to build CI capabilities within GBS and identify end-to-end process improvement opportunities that can be addressed through the application of CI methodologies.

Principal Accountabilities

CI Delivery & Operational Management

  • Work with senior leadership and senior management to determine the strategic priorities for CI deployment and other interventions in line with the GBS’s foremost customer and business challenges.
  • Partner with respective GBS leadership to identify and deliver CI deployments, ensuring alignment with Customer Experience and Transformation goals, and to sustainably underpin and budget challenges.
  • Build and drive CI deployment roadmaps across GBS to achieve full coverage and engagement over the next 2-3 years.
  • Defining a Sustain strategy which outlines requirements both during CI deployment, and also wider organisational mechanisms, roles and behaviours which need to be in place to truly embed and maintain a CI culture.
  • Define and deliver the pathway to Silver and ultimately Gold CI maturity for GBS.
  • Define and build direct CI team resourcing requirements in line with deploy and sustain strategies.
  • Contribute to the assessment, on-boarding and training of new Coaches.
  • Support coaches as a technical subject matter expert in Lean, SixSigma and Change Management techniques.
  • Responsible for all GBS CI tracking and reporting of benefits through the hierarchy.
  • Sustaining CI post wave and supporting the GBS to consistently deliver year-on-year benefits of up to 5% after the initial wave.
  • Keeping up to date with market trends and bringing in external best practice.
  • Identify method innovations and evolve the CI model as appropriate.

Coaching

  • Provide coaching to GBS CI coach teams on a day-to-day basis.
  • Coordinate and align CI cultural change and development by supporting the GBS CI teams in setting up and maintaining the required governance mechanisms.
  • Recruit, train, and retain a high-performance workforce, ensuring continuous professional development.
  • Driving engagement, collaboration, accountability and service excellence.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements in operational processes.
  • Ensure audit outcomes of the business processes meet full compliance, and address non-compliance with corrective measures.

Requirements

Job Knowledge, Skills & Experiences

  • Bachelor’s degree/NQF 7 qualification.
  • On learning pathway to becoming an Advanced Lean Practitioner and Six Sigma Blackbelt.
  • 5 Years’ proven experience in Continuous Improvement
  • Proven strong leadership and/or management capability; ability to inspire and develop a high-performance culture and to grow talent for GBS.
  • Ability to lead, influence and deliver results at a team leadership level and in a fast paced, matrixed environment.
  • Experienced coach, with an ability to empower individuals and teams to think for themselves, and proven leadership capability.
  • Recognised Subject Matter Expert in CI with extensive practical experience with Lean/ Six-Sigma programmes/ deployments, Lean ways of working and coaching leadership in role modelling the respective behaviours.
  • Excellent communicator and well developed interpersonal, negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
  • High degree of change orientation, willingness to challenge current thinking in constructive ways which build support and develop new approaches to complex issues.
  • Previous experience of senior level stakeholder management.
  • Strong commercial, financial and analytical skills, working with the business to identify practical, performance improvement opportunities.
  • Relevant experience with complex programmes and driving impact from these programmes.

Desirable (if required)

  • Shared Services expertise is a preference.

description:
About us Aave Labs began with a simple question: how do we make financial services like borrowing, saving, and earning more accessible globally? We built the Aave Protocol, now the world’s largest and most trusted onchain lending market, connecting decentralized finance with individuals, traditional finance, and fintech. Today, we build trusted, high-quality products that expand access to lending, credit, and savings globally Our culture We build trusted products that help people access and discover economic opportunities. We hold a high bar for quality and craftsmanship. No detail is too small. Trust depends on it. We’re a global team building products people can actually use, turning complex technology into something simple and reliable. We stay aligned, move quickly, and think long term, while keeping teams lean and focused on impact. About the role

We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer to join the Business Development team at Aave Labs, sitting at the intersection of engineering and business development. This role is critical to helping partners successfully integrate with and build on top of Aave’s infrastructure – translating commercial opportunities into clear, scalable technical solutions.

You'll work across Product, Engineering, and Business Development to develop, package, and document solutions built around Aave's earn and borrow products. This is a hands-on role focused on building reference architectures, prototypes, and integration materials that enable partners to adopt Aave's infrastructure quickly and confidently, ensuring Business Development has the technical assets they need to present clear, scalable solutions to partners.

How you can make an impact:

  • Work closely with Engineering and Product to relay partner needs, surface technical insights, and influence roadmap priorities
  • Keep internal stakeholders aligned on timelines, dependencies, and progress across multiple concurrent partner integrations
Let's connect if you have:
  • 4+ years of experience in solutions architecture, partner engineering, or blockchain development, ideally within Fintech, Crypto, or Web3
  • Strong technical fluency and the ability to understand and read Solidity, Typescript, and Rust (hands-on coding experience is a plus)
  • Proven ability to translate business goals and partner requirements into clear, scalable technical designs
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to confidently engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfort managing multiple partner integrations simultaneously, operating autonomously, and maintaining momentum across projects
  • A strong curiosity for DeFi and a genuine enthusiasm for how open financial infrastructure is evolving
