title: Lead - Commercial Operations Compliance
description:
ROLE PURPOSE AND DESCRIPTION

Goal:

Key Responsibilities: The Lead - Commercial Operations Compliance oversees operational integrity, platform compliance, and data accuracy for Thailand accounts. The role ensures that key commercial operational processes are executed accurately and consistently while maintaining required platform standards and internal process compliance.


The role serves as a key operational touchpoint between KAMs and cross-functional teams, translating commercial requirements into practical execution, monitoring critical operational workflows, and ensuring clear communication and alignment across stakeholders.


Beyond BAU operations, the Lead is expected to proactively drive process and performance improvement initiatives by identifying operational pain points, analyzing root causes, and implementing practical solutions. A key focus is to analyze shop performance and platform scoring, identify factors impacting shop health and performance, and recommend corrective actions or optimization approaches to improve and balance performance scores across managed shops.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Operational Compliance & Data Governance

Price Change Tracking & Analysis

  • Track, monitor, and report price updates (LTP / RSP changes) across client Business Units (BUs).
  • Monitor compliance with established price-change processes and identify recurring gaps or operational issues.
  • Analyze historical pricing trends and recurring issues to identify root causes and recommend process improvements.
  • Streamline price-update workflows to reduce turnaround time and minimize manual errors.

Item Master & SKU Data Validation

  • Audit, trace, and monitor SKU master data across internal systems (eIQ) and marketplace Seller Centers.
  • Identify and validate data discrepancies for new and existing SKUs.
  • Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve data issues and ensure compliance with marketplace requirements and internal system standards.

2. Marketplace Compliance & Shop Performance Management

Marketplace Enabler Program

  • Track and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) required to maintain official Enabler Certification status across major marketplaces (e.g., Lazada, Shopee and Tiktok).
  • Coordinate with KAMs and cross-functional operational teams to address performance gaps before they impact platform ratings or certification status.

Shop Performance & Platform Scoring

  • Monitor and analyze shop health, operational performance, and platform scoring across managed shops.
  • Identify key drivers contributing to underperformance or score imbalance.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and recommend corrective or preventive actions.
  • Develop practical approaches to improve and balance shop performance scores across the portfolio.
  • Track improvement actions and evaluate their effectiveness over time.

3. Commercial Reporting & Stakeholder Facilitation

Recurring Business Reporting

  • Manage the timely extraction and generation of recurring MBR, QBR, campaign Post-Mortem, and other predefined reports for Thailand BUs and selected regional markets (e.g., Singapore).
  • Ensure reports are generated according to agreed templates and client-specific data requirements.
  • Validate data completeness and accuracy before distribution.
  • Provide completed reports to KAMs for use in monthly, quarterly, and client business reviews.
  • Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve data or reporting issues when required.

Stakeholder Communication & Facilitation

  • Act as a key operational touchpoint for KAMs and cross-functional stakeholders on assigned operational and compliance matters.
  • Translate operational issues, findings, and required actions into clear and structured communication.
  • Facilitate alignment between Commercial and relevant functions to ensure issues are understood, assigned, and followed through to resolution.

4. Process Improvement & Commercial Initiatives

  • Proactively identify operational pain points, recurring issues, and process inefficiencies across Commercial Operations.
  • Analyze root causes and recommend practical, scalable solutions.
  • Lead or coordinate improvement initiatives from problem identification through implementation and follow-up.
  • Establish tracking mechanisms to measure improvement and ensure sustainable outcomes.
  • Support ad-hoc Commercial Operations and compliance initiatives as assigned.

Client Satisfaction Survey

  • Coordinate end-to-end execution of the bi-annual Client Satisfaction Survey.
  • Support refinement of survey criteria and consolidate survey responses.
  • Analyze key findings, recurring themes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Prepare structured findings and recommendations for Commercial leadership and relevant stakeholders.

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Technical Qualifications

 Bachelor's or Master’s degree in a relevant area, other fields are also considered.
  • At least 1-3 years of experience in E-commerce operations, understanding of E-commerce environment from a process-driven and operations point of view, experience working with E-commerce Management Systems and marketplace Seller Centers such as Lazada, Shopee, and TikTok Shop. Previous experience within marketplace, e-commerce enabler is a plus.

Soft Skills and Other details
  • Structured Thinking & Problem Solving: Structured, hands-on, and detail-oriented thinker with a can-do mindset. Able to analyze operational and performance data, identify patterns, root causes, and process gaps, and translate findings into practical solutions and improvement actions.
  • Process Improvement: Proactively identifies operational pain points and opportunities for improvement, with the ability to develop practical, scalable solutions and standardized processes.
  • Technical & AI Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google office products, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, and visualization, with the ability to quickly adapt to new systems and digital tools. Hands-on knowledge of AI tools and AI agents, with the ability to apply them effectively to data analysis, process automation, problem-solving, reporting, and productivity improvement.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Strong communication and presentation skills in both English and Thai, with the ability to translate complex operational or compliance topics into clear, structured, and easy-to-understand messages. Able to effectively narrate key issues, recommendations, and required actions to KAMs, cross-functional teams, and senior management to drive understanding and alignment.
  • Project & Initiative Management: Able to independently drive improvement initiatives, manage priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment, coordinate across multiple stakeholders, and follow through on action plans until measurable outcomes are achieved.
  • Ownership & Accountability: Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with high attention to data accuracy, process compliance, quality, deadlines, and follow-through.

description:

Location - Highstreet Kensington, London. 4 days a week in office

Our network reaches hundreds of millions monthly across social platforms, and our YouTube footprint includes highly successful, high-concept editorial channels including Palace Confidential and Daily Mail World. Now, we are expanding further with the launch of exciting new YouTube channels for our New Media brands.

We are seeking a YouTube Growth Lead with a passion for building new brands and franchises on the platform. This leadership position will be responsible for developing and executing YouTube strategy for our new channel launches, as well as supporting the growth and optimisation of our existing YouTube channels across the dmg media portfolio.

The Role

You will define and activate the YouTube strategy for dmg’s next wave of brands, working closely with editorial, commercial, and creative teams to turn bold ideas into repeatable, scalable video propositions. You will work cross-functionally with our established, high-performing editorial production team on Daily Mail YouTube, focusing your efforts on the launch and growth of new channels – but also lending your expertise and strategic insight to existing channels.

This is a rare opportunity to build dmg’s next generation of flagship YouTube channels from the ground up, shaping brands for global impact while also creating playbooks for success across our portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Channel Launches & Growth: Lead the end-to-end strategy for new YouTube channel launches from ideation and positioning to format development, scheduling, and audience growth.
  • Strategic Leadership: Support strategy, optimisation, and long-term planning for existing YouTube channels, working in partnership with our in-house editorial and production teams.
  • Data-driven Performance: Use analytics, insights and platform intelligence to inform programming, commissioning, and optimisation strategies, with a strong emphasis on building and maintaining channel health across the portfolio.
  • Format & Franchise Development: Support creative and production teams to create repeatable content formats and scalable franchises designed for engagement and retention.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with creative, social, editorial and commercial teams to ensure all output is brand-aligned and revenue-optimised.
  • Creator-led Development: Identify and develop opportunities for creator/talent-led YouTube projects and partnerships.
  • Monetisation & Growth: Develop sponsorship-ready formats, branded content opportunities, and strategies for audience and revenue growth.
  • Cross-Platform Integration: Ensure YouTube activity dovetails with our social-first strategy, leveraging the power of our broader network.

Experience Required

  • Significant track record running or launching YouTube channels at scale.
  • Deep understanding of YouTube formats, audience development, algorithms, and monetisation.
  • Proven ability to launch and grow repeatable video franchises.
  • Publisher, digital media, or creator-led business experience essential.
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience with brand partnerships.

Who We’re Looking For

  • A strategic thinker and creative builder with genuine insight into YouTube’s present and future.
  • Proven expertise in YouTube audience development and channel launches.
  • Understands the YouTube Studio inside out.
  • Both creative and operational, with strong collaborative skills.
  • Able to drive new brand launches but also support and evolve established channels.

Our Mapping team tackles the spatial intelligence of the platform: road matching, low-latency ETA predictions, and processing thousands of coordinates every second to ensure every journey is accurately tracked.

We’re looking for a Mid/Senior Backend Engineer to join a team that keeps frameworks lean and focuses on what matters: clean, maintainable code, shipped fast with TDD, DDD, and continuous integration and delivery.

title: Freelance Software Engineer - AI Coding Agent Evaluation
description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

title: SVP Solutions
description:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

We are seeking a commercially astute, strategically minded Senior Vice President, Global Solutions to lead our global Solutions function. This executive role will be responsible for building a world class pre-sales and solutions capability that accelerates revenue growth, strengthens technical differentiation, and brings the value of Energy Exemplar's solutions to life for customers globally.

As SVP, Global Solutions, you will partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to shape and win strategic opportunities, improve sales velocity, and ensure customers clearly understand the value Energy Exemplar can deliver. You will own our global approach to solution engineering, discovery, demonstrations, technical validation and value-based selling.

A key priority will be demo excellence transforming complex modelling and technology into compelling, outcome led stories that resonate with technical users through to C-suite decision-makers.

You will lead and scale a high-performing global Solutions organisation, creating consistent methodologies, capabilities and ways of working across regions while ensuring our technical expertise is focused where it can have the greatest commercial impact.

Key Responsibilities

Global Solutions & Pre-Sales Leadership

  • Own and drive the global Solutions strategy, aligning the function directly with company growth and go-to-market priorities. Build a scalable global pre-sales operating model across discovery, solution engineering, demonstrations, technical validation and proof of value.
  • Develop and lead a high-performing global Solutions team with the technical expertise, commercial mindset and customer focus required to support our growth.

Sales Partnership & Commercial Success

  • Partner closely with global Sales leadership to improve win rates and accelerate deal velocity. Embed Solutions into strategic account planning, opportunity qualification and deal strategy, ensuring technical resources are deployed against the opportunities where they can have the greatest commercial impact.
  • Act as an executive sponsor on strategic opportunities, helping teams uncover customer needs, shape compelling solution narratives, overcome technical barriers and demonstrate differentiated value.
  • Establish clear measures of Solutions effectiveness, including influence on pipeline conversion, win rates, sales velocity and revenue growth.

Demo Excellence

  • Own Energy Exemplar's global demo strategy and standards. Transform demonstrations from product walkthroughs into compelling customer stories that connect our technology to real-world challenges, outcomes and value.
  • Develop repeatable demo environments, narratives, use cases and playbooks that can scale globally while being tailored to individual customers and markets.

Customer Engagement & Growth

  • Act as a senior executive sponsor across strategic prospects and customers, building trusted relationships with C-suite and senior decision-makers.
  • Partner with Sales to shape complex enterprise pursuits and with Customer Success to identify opportunities for expansion and additional use cases across existing customers.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Create a strong operating rhythm across Solutions, Sales and Customer Success, ensuring the teams operate as one commercial organisation around the customer.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to bring structured customer and market feedback into roadmap discussions and ensure Solutions teams remain at the forefront of product capability.
  • Work with Product Management, Marketing and Sales Enablement to develop compelling solution messaging, demonstrations, use cases, collateral and enablement that strengthen our go-to-market execution.

Candidate Requirements & Qualifications

  • Significant leadership experience in pre-sales, Solutions Consulting, Solution Engineering or technical sales, ideally within enterprise software, SaaS and Utilities industry
  • Proven success leading and scaling global, customer-facing technical teams.
  • Strong understanding of complex enterprise B2B sales cycles, solution engineering and value-based selling.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technical capability to commercial outcomes, revenue growth and customer value.
  • Strong familiarity with energy markets, modelling and simulation, ideally including PLEXOS or comparable platforms.
  • Broad understanding of the global energy landscape and the challenges facing utilities, market operators, investors, developers and other energy market participants.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS and modern enterprise technology environments.
  • Proven ability to build and scale high-performing pre-sales organisations.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to engage confidently with C-suite customers and stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel globally.

Core Role Competencies

  • Commercial Solutioning
    Positions Solutions at the right point in the sales cycle to shape opportunities, differentiate Energy Exemplar and improve the probability of winning.
  • Demo & Storytelling Excellence
    Turns sophisticated technology and modelling into compelling demonstrations that clearly communicate customer outcomes and value.
  • Revenue Orientation
    Understands pipeline, ARR, conversion and sales velocity, and focuses Solutions resources where they can create the greatest commercial impact.
  • Customer-Centricity
    Starts with customer challenges and desired outcomes, ensuring technical engagements demonstrate meaningful business value.
  • Global Team Leadership
    Builds, develops and scales high-performing teams while creating consistency, shared standards and best practice globally.
  • Turning Complexity into Clarity
    Translates complex modelling, technology and market concepts into clear value propositions that resonate from technical users through to executives.
  • Develop and articulate a clear customer value proposition, demonstrating both quantitative and qualitative impact. This will include supporting the development and adoption of an ROI tool to help
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
    Creates strong alignment across Sales, Solutions and Customer Success while effectively partnering with Product, Engineering and Marketing.
  • Commercial Innovation
    Identifies repeatable use cases, demos and solution plays that create new opportunities, expand our addressable market and accelerate growth.

title: Data Engineer (6278)
description:
itD is seeking a Data Engineer to build and maintain scalable data infrastructure that powers company AI product analytics and topline metrics across product surfaces. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in large-scale data engineering, SQL, Python, data quality, product logging, dashboards, and analytics, with a track record of delivering reliable data pipelines and solutions that support AI-driven products.

Location: Remote
Schedule: 40 hours per week, 5 days per week; no overtime
Duration: 9 Months, with possibility of extension only if the associated leave is extended

Pay Rate: Market Rate, depending on experience.
We provide comprehensive medical benefits, a 401k plan, paid holidays, and more.
Please note that we are only considering direct W2 candidates at this time, as we are unable to offer sponsorship.

Responsibilities

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • 7+ years of overall professional experience preferred; candidates with less experience may be considered based on strong technical and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven experience in data engineering, including building and maintaining ETL/data pipelines.

  • Experience building and validating product logging and data quality frameworks.
  • Experience developing dashboards and analytics reporting solutions.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Prior Meta experience.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience required.

Os ydych chi'n angerddol am helpu eraill ac yn caru creu profiadau gwych, byddwch chi'n teimlo'n gartrefol gyda ni. Nid oes angen i chi fod yn arbenigwr i ddechrau - byddwn yn rhoi'r holl hyfforddiant a chefnogaeth sydd eu hangen arnoch chi. Gyda dros 130 o ganolfannau ledled Cymru a Lloegr, mae yna lawer o le i dyfu. Mae llawer o'n tîm wedi adeiladu gyrfaoedd anhygoel gan wneud yr hyn maen nhw'n ei garu, gan helpu cwsmeriaid o ddydd i ddydd a gwneud i bobl deimlo'n dda.

Rydyn ni’n falch o fod yn weithle lle mae croeso i bawb, eu bod yn cael eu gwerthfawrogi, a'u cefnogi i ffynnu—oherwydd pan fydd ein tîm yn adlewyrchu'r cymunedau rydyn ni’n eu gwasanaethu, rydyn ni i gyd yn tyfu'n gryfach gyda'n gilydd.

Prif sylw’r swydd fydd cyflwyno, annog a chynorthwyo gyda dosbarthiadau ymarfer grŵp. Os yw hyn yn mynd â’ch bryd chi hoffen ni glywed gennych.

Os byddwn yn derbyn nifer fawr o geisiadau addas, mae’n bosibl y bydd y swydd yn cau cyn y dyddiad cau penodol. Ymgeisiwch cyn gynted ag sy’n bosibl os oes diddordeb gennych.

title: Chief Digital & Information Officer
description:
Great Ormond Street Hospital for Children NHS Foundation Trust
Chief Digital & Information Officer
Salary: Competitive
Location: London

Great Ormond Street Hospital (GOSH) is one of the world’s leading children’s hospitals, renowned for delivering specialist care to children and young people with rare, complex and life-limiting conditions. Caring for more than 300,000 patients each year and partnering with the UCL Great Ormond Street Institute of Child Health, GOSH combines exceptional clinical care, pioneering research and world-leading innovation to transform outcomes for children across the UK and internationally. From genomics and advanced therapies to digital innovation through our globally recognised DRIVE Unit, GOSH is helping shape the future of paediatric healthcare and setting new standards for what is possible.

We are now seeking an outstanding Chief Digital & Information Officer (CDIO) to join our leadership team at a pivotal moment in the Trust’s evolution. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the CDIO will lead our Digital, Data, ICT and AI functions, ensuring technology, data and innovation are embedded as core enablers of clinical excellence, research, operational performance and service transformation. This is a unique opportunity to help realise our ambition to be at the forefront of digital healthcare and become a leading adopter of emerging technologies, including Agentic AI, whilst translating innovation into meaningful and measurable improvements for patients, families and staff.

We are looking for a proven senior leader with significant experience of leading large-scale digital, data and technology transformation within complex organisations. You will bring a strong track record in developing high-performing teams, delivering change through influence and partnership, and creating cultures where people are empowered, supported and inspired to achieve their full potential. Deep expertise in digital strategy, information governance, cyber security and data-driven improvement will be essential, alongside a sophisticated understanding of AI governance, ethical deployment, assurance and risk management. Above all, you will be a values-led leader whose approach reflects GOSH’s recently refreshed Values - recognising that collaboration, respect and curiosity are fundamental to sustained success.

World class care requires world class leadership: this is an exceptional opportunity to join GOSH and lead our Digital, data and AI teams at one of the most exciting, stretching, periods in our evolution. If you have the vision, credibility and leadership capability to build on an already outstanding digital and innovation platform, challenge established thinking and help shape the future of child health on a national and global stage, we would be delighted to hear from you.

title: Recovery - Coordinator 1
description:
Job Duties and Other Information

Please click HERE to apply.

  • May serve as the subject matter expert in Third-Party Liability (TPL) Recovery issues related to Estate, Trauma, Special Needs Trusts, and/or restitution recoveries. Provides support in responses to escalated matters.
  • Develops an advanced working knowledge of Medicaid and Eligibility policy to interpret Medicaid claims.
  • Participates in the development and implementation of TPL policies and procedural changes related to Estate, Trauma, Special Needs Trusts, and/or restitution recoveries.

Requires regular coordination with LDH’s Bureau of Legal Service, families of deceased Medicaid recipients, attorneys, insurance companies, and other third parties, in the regular management of assigned Recovery caseload.
  • May serve as the LDH representative for recovery matters under appeal, including preparation of Summaries of Evidence and other documentation and processes required of the LDH’s and Department of Administrative Law’s fair hearing processes.
  • Assists in making recommendations for system changes required due to changing federal and/or state regulations, Medicaid policies, and other factors including system modernization efforts.
  • Participates in planning, development, design, testing, and implementation of changes and/or new specifications to the recovery system.
  • May serve as backup to team lead (i.e. Recovery Coordinator 2).
  • Other tasks, as directed.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or 6 years’ professional work experience in lieu of degree.
  • Excellent analytical skills, effective organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage projects, assignments, and competing priorities.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office, including but not limited to Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Great attention to detail and follow up, and verbal/written communications skills.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree.
  • Minimum one year of experience in Medicaid Long Term Care and HCBS programs.
  • Minimum one year of experience with the Louisiana Medicaid systems and policy.
  • Minimum one year of experience with liability insurance claims processing.
  • CPT, ICD-9 or ICD-10 coding, and HCPCS knowledge.

title: Canvassing Appointment Setter
description:
Location: Charlotte,North Carolina,United States

Walk. Talk. Earn. Grow.

Full-Time & Part-Time Positions

Driver’s Licenses are Required

Launch Your Sales Career with Renewal by Andersen

Let’s be real this is not a sit-at-a-desk job, and it’s not just hourly work.

This is an entry-level sales + field marketing role where you’ll be out in neighborhoods, talking to homeowners, building confidence, and getting paid while you learn how sales actually works.

If you like being active, talking to people, and earning more than just a paycheck keep reading

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As an Entry-Level Sales & Field Marketing Representative, you are the first impression of Renewal by Andersen.

You’ll be:

  • Going door-to-door in assigned neighborhoods
  • Talking with homeowners (no hard selling)
  • Creating interest and setting appointments for our Sales Team
  • Tracking your activity using company-provided canvassing tech
  • Learning sales fundamentals that can lead to higher-earning roles

This role is independent, high-energy, and performance-driven the more consistent you are, the more you earn.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

✔ $17/hour base pay + uncapped bonuses
✔ Paid training no experience required
✔ Clear growth path into in-home sales or leadership
✔ Supportive team culture you’re never on your own
✔ Flexible schedules for work-life balance
✔ Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision (Cigna), 401(k) w/ match, PTO & holidays

WHO THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR

You’ll thrive here if you:

  • Are motivated by earning more, not just clocking in
  • Can handle rejection and keep moving forward
  • Like working independently but still want team support
  • Are coachable and open to feedback
  • Are physically active and comfortable walking 7–10 miles/day
  • See this as a stepping stone, not a dead end

No sales experience? Totally fine.
Our top performers come from hospitality, retail, customer service, athletics, and other people-facing roles.

QUICK HONESTY CHECK (PLEASE READ)

This job is not for someone looking for an easy hourly paycheck.
It is for someone who wants:

  • Real earning potential
  • Sales experience that actually translates
  • Career growth with a company that invests in training

If that sounds like you we want to meet you.

OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS (NO SURPRISES)

We move fast, but we do take hiring seriously. Here’s what to expect:

1️⃣ Quick recruiter phone screen
2️⃣ Interview with a Team Lead
3️⃣ Final conversation with the Department Manager
4️⃣ Offer + background check

We’ll keep you informed every step of the way.

APPLY TODAY

Join a company that develops people not just fills roles!

You'll lead cross-functional teams and partner across EPEO, cybersecurity, and platform engineering to deliver high-impact initiatives across networking, security, and infrastructure domains.

Strategy, Portfolio Ownership & Delivery

  • Drive improvements in delivery flow, automation, and operational efficiency.

Portfolio & Program Management

  • Manage a portfolio of network objectives, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities.
  • Oversee multiple concurrent initiatives, ensuring timelines, and outcomes are achieved.
  • Track performance using delivery, quality, and risk metrics.
  • Identify and remove cross-team blockers, ensuring seamless execution.

Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

  • Partner with EPEO leadership, platform teams, cybersecurity, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated solutions.

  • Collaborate with vendors and external partners to deliver scalable network solutions.

You'll have...

  • 7+ years of experience in network engineering, cybersecurity, or platform engineering.
  • 3+ years leading technical teams or managing large-scale product portfolios.
  • Strong experience with enterprise networking (on-prem, cloud, hybrid models).
  • Experience integrating network services with security and identity platforms.
  • Deep understanding of modern architectures (Zero Trust, cloud networking, micro-segmentation).
  • Strong Agile delivery experience (Jira, Rally) across complex, multi-team environments.
  • Proven experience delivering large-scale infrastructure or platform transformation initiatives.
  • Strong portfolio/program management experience across multiple initiatives.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Use regular expressions (regex) for data parsing.
  • Understand the importance of vulnerability management and scanning
  • Knowledge of forensic tools preferred.

  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcome

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skillset
  • Ability to analyze complex situations and make informed decisions under pressure.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for documenting incidents and collaborating with teams.
  • Ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to collaborate with other analysts, IT teams, and external stakeholders.
  • Calm and flexible in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
  • Understanding of threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • Familiarity and knowledge of emerging threats and vulnerabilities and have the means to obtain relevant information for threat investigations.
  • Previous experience in a SOC or similar role preferred.
  • Experience with managing real-world incidents.

title: Raymond E Purves Chair of Dermatology
description:
• Outstanding opportunity for a Chair position to develop and expand a globally recognised research program in dermatology

  • 5-year fixed term (0.6 to 1.0FTE) position with attractive renumeration package

  • Located on Camperdown campus

About the opportunity

The Faculty of Medicine and Health (FMH) at the University of Sydney is the largest faculty, encompassing the Sydney Medical School (SMS), Sydney Dental School, Sydney School of Health Sciences, Sydney School of Nursing and Midwifery, Sydney School of Medical Sciences and Sydney School of Public Health. Our faculty takes pride in fostering a collaborative and multidisciplinary approach to address contemporary healthcare challenges.

We are seeking to appoint an outstanding senior academic as the Raymond E Purves Chair of Dermatology (Professor/Level E) in teaching and research. Depending on the candidate the role may be appointed in the School of Medical Sciences, the Sydney Medical School or the School of Public Health. This position is suited to an ambitious person with a passion for building a program of work in dermatology. The Chair will grow an internationally outstanding research program which will complement and leverage the research activities in the school and faculty.

We are looking for a leader who can foster collaborations across academic, clinical, industry, and professional networks. The Chair must have a disciplined approach to research, balancing the delivery of high-quality outcomes with mentoring and supporting the career development of students and academic staff. The Chair will report to the relevant Head of School.

We welcome applications from both clinicians and non-clinicians who are committed to advancing dermatology research, fostering collaboration, and contributing to the education and development of the next generation of health professionals.

About you (skills, capabilities and experience)

We are seeking a candidate with the vision, expertise, and leadership to make a lasting impact in dermatology. Applicants who hold, or are eligible for, registration as a Dermatologist with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) are especially encouraged to apply.

The successful candidate will:

  • hold a PhD in a relevant discipline and an international reputation for outstanding scholarship and research

  • demonstrate experience in people leadership and management of a research team within the higher education sector

  • have experience supervising and mentoring of higher degree by research students to completion

  • have an outstanding track record in obtaining grant funding and an exceptional publication record with original contributions in the field of dermatology

  • have experience in educational design and delivery, including recognition for achieving improved or consistently excellent student outcomes, educational innovation or educational leadership

  • have excellent interpersonal and communication skills and proven ability and experience in working cooperatively and collegially in inclusive decision-making environments.

  • hold, or be eligible for, registration as a Dermatologist with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) (desirable).

Sponsorship / work rights for Australia

Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance will be provided if required.

Term and remuneration

The successful candidate will be offered a 5-year fixed term (0.6FTE to 1.0FTE) position with the possibility for renewal subject to performance and funding. The appointment is subject to completion of a satisfactory probation period for new appointees.

The successful candidate will be offered a competitive remuneration package commensurate with the responsibilities of the position and the candidate’s relevant experience and qualifications.

Pre-employment checks

Your employment is conditional upon the successful completion of all pre-employment or background checks required for the role in terms satisfactory to the University. Also, to meet the University’s obligations under the National Higher Education Code to Prevent and Eliminate Gender-Based Violence you will be asked to declare if you have been investigated for, or found to engaged in, sexual harm or gender-based violence in the course of previous employment or in a legal process. Similarly, your ongoing employment is conditional upon the satisfactory maintenance of all relevant clearances and background check requirements. If you do not meet these conditions, the University may take any necessary step, including the termination of your employment.

To keep our community safe, please be aware of our COVID safety precautions which form our conditions of entry for all staff, students and visitors coming to campus.

EEO statement

At the University of Sydney, our shared values are trust, accountability and excellence and we strive to be a place where everyone can thrive. We are committed to creating a University community that thrives through diversity and reflects the wider community that we serve. We deliver on this through our commitment to diversity and inclusion, evidenced by our people and culture programs, as well as key strategies to increase participation and support the careers of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People, women, people living with a disability, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, and those who identify as LGBTQIA+. We welcome applications from candidates from all backgrounds.

We are proud to be recognised as an Australian Workplace Equality Index (AWEI) Platinum Employer. Find out more about our work on diversity and inclusion.

Understanding of the important role Employee Relations plays in colleague experience and employer brand.

Committed to join in, have some fun and celebrate everyones hard work.

Regularly asks for feedback and uses it to improve and grow.
Breaks down problems into smaller, manageable steps for easier resolution.
Team up with others to find solutions through Ai and thrives on the strength of working together.
Always seek out fresh ways to work through technology and/or Ai that can boost the business and move things forward.
Actively developing your ability to use AI effectively and think critically about outputs
Strengthen Human Touch - Keeping the human element strong: Balancing AI efficiency with human coaching, empathy, and team cohesion

Desired but not Essential:

title: Campaign Organizer- Alliance, NE
description:
Campaign Organizer- Nebraska

Location and Timeline: We are hiring a full-time Campaign Organizer to begin by the end of August and continue through Election Day. The locations are Scottsbluff, North Platte, Grand Island, Hastings, Alliance, Chadron, and Norfolk. This will expand over the program, so if you are a Nebraskan who lives further away, please still apply!

Who We Are: The Outreach Team is the national engine of campaigners and organizers building a fairer, cleaner, safer, and more peaceful world. We invest in people at every level with industry-leading pay/benefits, rigorous training and support and real paths to leadership.


General Overview:
Neighbor, it’s your time to step up for Nebraska. We need your love for our state and its people, your skills earned from years of hard work, and your ability to connect with other Nebraskans. Frankly, it’s the only way we are going to pry back our government and economy from the billionaires who have taken over. The good news is that there are more of us than there are of them. We just need to harness our power… conversation by conversation, on every porch, corner, driveway, sidewalk, field, and farm in Nebraska. And we need you to lead the charge. Join us on behalf of the Working Class Majority Pac.

We are looking for Organizers to talk to voters about Dan Osborn’s run for Senate in Nebraska’s upcoming election. If you believe that real political power is built from the ground up through deep organizing and face-to-face conversations, we want you on our team in Omaha and Lincoln, Nebraska
Organizers will be charged with recruiting, training, and working with a team of volunteers in key counties in Nebraska. The Organizer will start by building and recruiting a team of supporters and volunteers around canvassing. From there, Organizers will continue to engage volunteers through a series of campaign events and actions.

What You’ll Do:

  • Recruit and Train a Community of Volunteer Activists
  • Call and text supporters and recruit them into grassroots actions.
  • Identify new supporters and volunteers by knocking doors, gathering petitions, flyering, and conducting in-field recruitment efforts in the community and on local campuses
  • Run grassroots skills trainings to develop effective campaigners among volunteers.
  • Keep meticulous track of a volunteer list so that no potential volunteer falls through the cracks.
  • Represent the campaign through participation in community spaces and events, while engaging and uplifting coalition and partner organizations.

Generate Campaign Actions

  • Gather over a thousand petitions from the community in support of key campaign issues
  • Generate hundreds of additional actions targeting key Members of Congress with a particular focus on social media posts, phone calls, postcards, and photo petitions.
  • Recruit and train volunteers to generate more petitions and volunteer engagement at events.
  • Recruit and engage with community leaders, organizational partners, and VIPs to build meaningful relationships while generating new supporters, volunteers, and event attendees.
  • Register voters in key Iowa districts
  • Generate hundreds of new voter registrations in key Iowa counties
  • Maintain strong QC systems for ensuring compliance with VR laws and rules

Organize High-Volume Visibility Events

  • Organize and execute exciting, high-visibility in-person events demonstrating support for climate, jobs, and justice.
  • Educate community members about historical climate investments and the urgency of continued actions.
  • Nail 100% of all messaging and legal requirements and ensure that volunteers do the same.
  • Manage Digital Campaign, Data Management, and Reporting Tools
  • Demonstrate public support by recruiting volunteers to post on their own social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter.
  • Use peer-to-peer texting services and relational organizing tools to communicate with community members.
  • Send timely and compelling email campaigns to recruit activists to campaign activities.
  • Track every interaction with detailed notes in order to report numbers daily and write weekly reports on the results of the campaign.

Who You Are & Keys to Success (the must-haves):

To be successful in this job, you will excel in these areas:

  • Relationship Building: You develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with a diverse group of local and statewide community members. You are attentive and empathetic to the communities we serve, regardless of race, ethnicity, class, gender, or ability, and can identify shared values across communities for collective growth. You can build authentic relationships through authenticity and reliability, continuously uplifting others and their goals. You are comfortable and experienced in public speaking to a group about environmental, jobs, health care issues and climate change.

  • Inclusive and Collaborative Leadership: You approach leadership with a “power with” mindset that recognizes the impact power hierarchies have in different settings. You can learn from others, see and hear other perspectives, and step in or step back as necessary. You are reliable and accountable, always transparent about your abilities, capacities, and expectations. You honor the time and commitments of others while inspiring them to meet goals.

  • Commitment to Equity and Inclusion: You have a proven ability to develop meaningful connections with diverse communities, including a wide range of community organizations, community leaders, and community members. You work with the community and within the workplace to identify areas of improvement for a more equitable environment. You take continued action and efforts to improve your REI knowledge, skills, and tools.
  • Drive to Achieve Results: You have experience accomplishing ambitious goals and getting results, even when there are obstacles. You have the experience or ability to plan backwards to meet multiple goals timely and effectively. When there are unexpected changes, you bounce back and adjust quickly, learning and improving from any mistakes.


Must be able to drive, have a valid drivers license, and also you will need to meet our driver authorization standards

  • Skills and Experiences we Expect of all Outreach Team employees:
  • Commitment to equity and justice.
  • Experience bringing a lens of inclusivity to all of your interactions with colleagues and community members.
  • Passion for the role that your work plays in creating change in the world.
  • Kindness and consideration for others.
  • Drive to work collaboratively: learning from others; stepping-in or stepping-back when needed.
  • Transparency: comfort admitting what you do and don’t know, your capacity, and abilities.
  • Task management: Able to adapt to the evolving needs of a project. Able to tackle big-picture projects and break them down into smaller pieces.
  • Organized and efficient: Experience or demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects or goals at once in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Acute attention to detail: Track interactions and tasks with detailed notes. Plans ahead for roadblocks and bounces back quickly when problems arise.
  • Effective communication skills (written or spoken) that are clear, concise and honest.
  • Comfortable and excited to speak about the campaign publicly.
  • Coach and learning mentality: successful experience or willingness to learn new things and pick up new skills on the job. Able to learn from mistakes and try again.
  • Understanding of how your words and actions affect others, including an awareness of power language and communication accessibility.
  • Ability to work weekends and weekday evenings, occasional holidays.

Nice-to-Haves, but Not Required:

  • Organizing experience within or around Iowa.
  • Experience working for nonprofits and issue campaigns.
  • Data Management and Evaluation Experience: Experience working with various data management systems and tools, mainly Google Suite.
  • Experience with Relevant Campaign Tools and Technologies: VAN, Action Network, ThruText, MailChimp, eCRMs like EveryAction, or social media tools (Twitter, Facebook, Instagram).
  • Event or Project Planning & Management, Implementation or Evaluation.

title: FE College Governor - London
description:
Use your expertise to shape education, influence communities, and grow as a leader

Roles available at colleges across London

Are you a business leader or corporate professional looking to make a meaningful impact outside the boardroom?

By becoming a volunteer governor at a further education (FE) or sixth form college, you’ll help shape the strategic direction of an organisation that transforms lives through education and skills—while strengthening your own governance experience and leadership credentials.

Why it’s relevant to professionals like you

Further education colleges train over 1.6 million learners annually, preparing the skilled workforce that keeps our economy moving—from engineers and IT specialists to healthcare professionals and construction experts.

As a college governor, you’ll sit on the board of an FE institution (and registered charity), where your insight into strategy, risk, people, or finance will have a direct impact on how public funds are spent, how performance is measured, and how learners are supported to succeed.

This is an opportunity to:

  • Apply your corporate skills in a leadership role
  • Gain board-level experience and enhance your CV
  • Contribute to local economic growth and social mobility
  • Support a vital sector during a time of transformation

What will you be doing?

As part of a governing board, you’ll:

  • Set strategic direction: help define the college’s mission and goals
  • Hold leadership to account: monitor finances, performance, and outcomes
  • Ensure governance excellence: make decisions in the best interests of learners and stakeholders
  • Act as a charity trustee: ensure financial sustainability and legal compliance

You’ll also engage with senior leaders and external stakeholders, including local employers, regulators, and community partners.

Who are we looking for?

We welcome professionals from a broad range of sectors, including but not limited to:

  • Finance, Audit & Risk
  • HR, People & Culture
  • Strategy, Transformation & Operations
  • Technology, AI & Digital
  • Legal, Governance & Compliance
  • Marketing, PR & Communications
  • Education, apprenticeships, or vocational courses

What matters most is your strategic thinking, commercial awareness, and commitment to helping others succeed.

Prior education experience is not required. Full induction and training are provided, with access to DfE-funded development and peer mentoring where needed.

Time commitment

Expect to give approximately 1–2 days per month, including:

  • Attending board and committee meetings (in person or remote)
  • Reading papers and preparing questions
  • Participating in training and occasional college visits

The time commitment is manageable alongside a full-time role—and many employers actively support staff to take on governance roles as part of their professional development.

Where you’ll be needed

Some colleges offer remote governance and meetings take place online. This may suit you best, or we may suggest a role where you volunteer on a hybrid basis at a college within a reasonable distance from you. We are recruiting governors for colleges across England, with new opportunities added regularly.

What’s in it for you?

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Enhance your board-level and governance experience
  • Develop strategic oversight and leadership outside your day-to-day role
  • Expand your professional network
  • Give back in a way that creates long-term, measurable impact

About Boards for Education

Boards for Education is a charity that sources and supports volunteers for governing boards. We aim to improve educational outcomes for children, young people, and adult learners by strengthening governance across the education sector.

With more than 25 years’ experience and a national network of partners, we connect schools, academy trusts, colleges, and education charities across England and Wales with skilled, independent volunteers.

Ready to step into a strategic, purpose-driven leadership role?

If you’re ready to bring your corporate insight to the education sector and help shape the future of skills, opportunity, and social mobility—we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to become a volunteer college governor.

title: Software Engineer II/III
description:
About Rent the Runway

Rent the Runway (RTR) is transforming the way we get dressed by pioneering the world’s first Closet in the Cloud. Founded in 2009, RTR has disrupted the $2.4 trillion fashion industry by inspiring women with a more joyful, sustainable and financially-savvy way to feel their best every day. As the ultimate destination for circular fashion, the brand now offers infinite points of access to its shared closet via a fully customizable subscription to fashion, one-time rental or ownership. RTR offers designer apparel and accessories from hundreds of brand partners and has built in-house proprietary technology and a one-of-a-kind reverse logistics operation. RTR has been named to CNBC’s “Disruptor 50” five times in ten years, and has been placed on Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies list multiple times.

Galway Office

Rent The Runway established its European Technology Hub in Galway in April 2019. Based in the historic Claddagh area of the city, the growing team in Galway tackles core technology challenges and influences the next generation of services critical to Rent The Runway’s success and continued growth.

The Galway office is Rent the Runway's first international office outside the US and enables the company to significantly expand its Software Engineering, Product Development, Machine Learning Engineering and Data Science footprint. Rent The Runway’s Galway-based employees have the opportunity to grow their careers across several roles and career paths in Technology.

Our engineering team is smart, pragmatic, and entrepreneurial. We build with Agentic AI in the loop every day, own what we ship from design through automated testing to deployment to the cloud, and protect a sustainable pace with dedicated time for learning and paying down tech debt. We give engineers genuine autonomy over the tools and services they build.

About the Job:

In your role with our eCommerce Platform team, you'll build and operate the critical, cloud-scale microservices behind our customers' checkout and orders — the systems the customer-facing funnel depends on. You'll also own the internal application our Customer Experience (CX) team uses to support customers, and the compliant financial reporting behind every order. Across the full stack, you'll keep these high-traffic, revenue-critical flows fast, resilient, safe, and friction-free.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and improve the internal application our CX team relies on to support customers, delivering responsive, accessible, well-tested interfaces in ReactJS
  • Own features end-to-end, from those interfaces through to the Java/Kotlin services and intuitive, well-tested APIs behind them
  • Build and evolve integrations with third-party providers across our eCommerce ecosystem (payments, fraud, tax)
  • Deprecate outdated functionality and improve the quality, reliability, scalability, and observability of our revenue-critical flows as the platform grows
  • Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to build software solutions that deliver real business value at scale
  • Work in a cross-functional team, helping everyone achieve their best work through code review, mentorship, and sharing technical direction

About You:

  • BA/BS in Computer Science or related degree, and 4+ years of practical experience
  • Hands-on: ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, SpringBoot, Maven, npm
  • Experience working in an environment with: cloud / web-scale microservices, GCP (Terraform, Kubernetes), GitHub (git, GitHub Actions), AMQP / RabbitMQ, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Splunk
  • Proven experience building responsive, well-tested web applications, with a strong grasp of component architecture and state management, ideally interfaces where usability and data density matter
  • Solid experience with OOP and design patterns, building backend services and APIs
  • An eye for UX detail and a knack for building tools people genuinely like using
  • A track record of shipping multiple large, complex projects, and the ability to pick up new tools and technologies quickly
  • Strong communication and a collaborative, inclusive approach; you mentor and learn from teammates and help foster an empowering team dynamic
  • An owner's mindset; you take initiative, follow through, balance competing priorities, and leave things better than you found them
  • Comfort with AI-assisted development tools (Gemini CLI, Claude, Copilot)

Studies show that some people, especially women and members of under-represented groups, hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits:

At Rent the Runway, we’re committed to the happiness and well-being of our employees, and aim to create a workplace that fosters both personal and professional growth. Our inclusive benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous Paid Time Off, including annual leave, paid bereavement, and family sick leave - every employee needs time to take care of themselves and their family.
  • Universal Paid Parental Leave for both parents + flexible return to work program - because we know your newest family member(s) deserve your undivided attention.
  • Paid Sabbatical after 5 years of continuous service - unplug, recharge, and have some fun.
  • Competitive Stakeholder Pension - taking care of your future.
  • Comprehensive health, dental care and dependents care from day 1 of employment - Your health comes first, and we’ve got you covered.
  • Company-wide events and outings - our team spirit is no joke - we know how to have fun!
  • Hybrid Work -This hybrid role requires 2-3 days per week in our Galway, Ireland office, with the option to work 2 days remotely.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Azure & Microsoft Cloud)
description:
We're looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with a broad technical background and particularly strong experience across Microsoft Azure and cloud infrastructure.

This isn't a pure Cloud, DevOps or Platform Engineering position. We're looking for someone who is comfortable working across a wider infrastructure environment but has the depth of Azure knowledge to become the go-to person within the team.

You'll take ownership of the Azure estate while getting involved in everything from Microsoft 365 and Entra ID through to migrations, integrations, automation, virtualisation and wider infrastructure projects.

A major part of the role will be supporting the integration of newly acquired businesses, including cloud and tenant-to-tenant migrations, so it's an interesting opportunity for someone who enjoys project work and solving the challenges that come with bringing different technology environments together.


What you'll be doing
  • Take technical ownership of the Azure environment and become the team's go-to person for Azure infrastructure and best practice
  • Lead and support cloud and tenant-to-tenant migrations, particularly as newly acquired businesses are integrated
  • Manage and support Azure infrastructure including virtual machines, networking, storage, backup and monitoring
  • Work across Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID, including identity, RBAC, MFA and Conditional Access
  • Build and support integrations between Azure, Microsoft 365 and third-party SaaS platforms
  • Automate user provisioning, joiner/mover/leaver processes and other repetitive infrastructure tasks
  • Use PowerShell and other automation tools to improve efficiency and reduce manual administration
  • Deploy and manage virtual machines and services within a private/hybrid cloud environment
  • Work across the wider infrastructure estate alongside other members of the team
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and act as a technical escalation point
  • Work closely with security and networking teams to ensure the environment remains secure, resilient and well governed
  • Identify opportunities to use automation and emerging AI tooling to improve infrastructure operations


What we're looking for

We're not necessarily looking for someone who has spent their entire career specialising in Azure.

You may have started out in traditional infrastructure, systems or Microsoft engineering and developed increasingly strong Azure and Microsoft cloud expertise as environments have moved towards cloud and hybrid infrastructure.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Strong, hands-on Microsoft Azure experience
  • A broad background in infrastructure or systems engineering
  • Good experience across Microsoft 365 and Entra ID
  • Experience delivering cloud migrations, tenant migrations or infrastructure transformation projects
  • Strong knowledge of identity and access management
  • Good PowerShell scripting and automation skills
  • Experience integrating SaaS applications through SSO, provisioning, APIs or connectors
  • Experience working with virtualised and/or hybrid infrastructure
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across a wider infrastructure environment
  • The confidence to take ownership of technical problems and make recommendations
  • The communication skills to work effectively with both technical teams and the wider business

Experience with Microsoft Graph API, HPE GreenLake, acquisition/integration projects or AI tooling would be particularly useful, but isn't essential.


Why consider it?

This is a role with genuine technical ownership rather than simply maintaining an existing environment.

You'll have the opportunity to become the team's Azure subject matter expert, while retaining the variety that comes from working across a broad infrastructure estate.

With continued integration and transformation work ahead, there will be plenty to get involved in across Azure, Microsoft 365, identity, migrations, automation and infrastructure improvement.

Location: Solihull – office-based

Please note: Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Microsoft Fabric and dbt to design, build, and maintain scalable, analytics-ready data platforms. The ideal candidate is a collaborative team player who can also work independently to solve complex business use cases end to end. Experience in the telecommunications industry, particularly exposure to RAN sharing environments, is a strong advantage.

Your Mission
• Design, build, document and maintain end-to-end data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Data Engineering, Data Factory, OneLake, Lakehouse, and Warehouses).
• Ingest data from a variety of sources including APIs, relational databases, files, SaaS platforms, and telecommunications network systems.
• Develop and manage ELT transformations using dbt, including reusable models, tests, documentation, and data lineage.
• Implement medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) using Fabric and dbt best practices.
• Build robust, analytics-ready data models (facts, dimensions, marts) to support BI, operational reporting, and advanced analytics.
• Support telecommunications use cases, including network performance analysis, capacity tracking, cost allocation, and compliance reporting.
• Work with datasets related to RAN sharing, such as multi-operator performance metrics, shared asset utilization, and operator-level data segregation.
• Collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams while also owning and independently driving data solutions from problem definition through delivery.
• Implement CI/CD pipelines and Git-based version control for data solutions.
• Ensure strong data governance, security, and access control, particularly in shared or multi-tenant data environments.
• Document architecture, pipelines, and business logic clearly for long-term maintainability.

Your Specific Expertise
• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including:
o Fabric Data Engineering
o Lakehouse & Warehouse
o OneLake
o Data Pipelines / Data Factory
• Proven experience using dbt for analytics engineering and transformation-layer development.
• Advanced SQL skills for data transformation, modeling, and optimization.
• Experience with Spark (PySpark preferred).
• Solid understanding of ELT patterns, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse best practices.
• Experience with Git and CI/CD in data projects.

Your Profile
• You have a bachelor or master degree in IT/data/computer science (or equivalent experience).
• Minimum experience: 3 years in Data engineering in a modern IT environment.
• Good proficiency of English is a must, knowledge of Dutch or French is a plus.
• You are analytical, proactive, and delivery-focused.
• You are a team player.
• You have excellent communication skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts to end user language.
• Comfortable working in an agile, fast-paced environment.
• Experience in a Telecom environment is certainly a big plus.
• Experience with advanced analytics and/or AI is a plus as well.

title: Senior QA Engineer (Magento)
description:
• Own and define the quality engineering strategy across a growing digital delivery business.
  • Drive automation, AI-enabled testing and modern QA practices at scale.
  • Full Remote (UK) with flexibility, autonomy and genuine influence.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a highly experienced Senior/Lead QA to join a specialist digital delivery business that builds and supports complex ecommerce solutions for well-known brands. This is a newly created position where you'll have the opportunity to shape how quality is delivered across the organisation, combining strategic leadership with hands-on technical expertise. You'll work closely with delivery, development and QA teams to create smarter ways of working, improve release confidence and embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.


What experience you'll need to apply

  • Experience delivering both manual and automated testing within ecommerce environments.
  • Experience with Adobe Commerce or Magento platforms.
  • Strong experience designing and implementing automated testing frameworks using Playwright.
  • Experience developing testing strategies, standards and best practices.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD processes and integrating automated testing into delivery pipelines.
  • Experience mentoring, coaching or supporting QA team members.
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing, exploratory testing or visual regression tools would be beneficial.
  • A passion for continuous improvement and modern engineering practices.

What you'll be doing


You'll take ownership of the organisation's approach to quality engineering and automation, helping to create scalable testing practices that improve consistency, reduce risk and support high-quality delivery. A key focus will be leading the automation strategy, ensuring automated testing becomes a core part of delivery across multiple projects. You'll design, build and maintain test frameworks using Playwright, increase automated regression coverage and work closely with developers to integrate testing into CI pipelines.


You'll also explore and implement AI-supported testing approaches, visual regression testing and other modern QA techniques that improve efficiency and confidence. Alongside the strategic responsibilities, you'll remain hands-on in project delivery, supporting testing activities across ecommerce platforms, integrations and critical customer journeys. As a senior member of the team, you'll mentor colleagues, share best practice and help foster a quality-first culture where testing is considered from discovery through to release.


What you'll get in return for your experience


You'll be joining a remote-first business that values quality, collaboration and continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to shape a growing quality engineering function, influence technical direction and introduce new approaches that have a genuine impact across the business. The package includes a competitive salary (£60-70K) quarterly bonus scheme, flexible working arrangements, a monthly wellbeing benefits allowance, enhanced family-friendly policies, pension contributions and generous holiday entitlement. You'll be trusted to manage your workload, contribute ideas and develop your career in an environment that values expertise, autonomy and long-term growth.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • At least 3-4 years of relevant experience in a similar role.
  • Good Leadership, communication & interpersonal skills.

title: Client Delivery Manager
description:
Own the delivery and lead the performance.


At Foxway, we don’t just deliver IT services — we enable a more sustainable and circular tech future. Through Foxway CWS, we help organizations manage their IT lifecycle smarter, more efficiently, and with lower environmental impact.

Now, we’re looking for a Client Delivery Manager who wants to step into a high-impact role at the center of our customer operations.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. Someone who is confident in leading performance dialogues with customers, driving operational excellence internally, and ensuring that every SLA, KPI, and commitment is delivered with precision. You will be the operational voice of Foxway towards the customer and the customer’s voice internally.

About the role

As Client Delivery Manager, you have the operational ownership of assigned customer contracts. You are the main point of contact and responsible for ensuring that Foxway delivers according to agreed SLAs, KPIs, and contractual obligations. You work closely with the Account Executive (who owns the commercial dialogue), while you own the delivery.

You will:

  • Act as the primary operational contact for customers.

  • Monitor SLA & KPI performance and proactively manage deviations.

  • Handle escalations and drive resolution internally.

  • Lead operational governance meetings.

  • Drive collaboration across Service Desk, Procurement, Operations and other internal teams.

  • Identify delivery improvements and optimization opportunities.

  • Support upselling opportunities together with Sales.

You sit in the center of the delivery with a clear mandate and high visibility.

Success in this role is measured by:

  • SLA performance

  • Customer satisfaction (NPS)

  • Gross Profit performance

We believe you have:

  • Minimum two (2) years of experience within Service Delivery Management / IT Delivery / Operational Account Management.

  • Experience managing larger customers with complex delivery setups.

  • Strong understanding of SLAs, KPIs, and service performance monitoring.

  • Proven experience handling escalations and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills – clear, confident, and directive when needed.

  • Business acumen and ability to see the full value chain (helicopter view).

  • A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.

  • Experience from IT lifecycle services, DaaS or similar models is a plus.

You are also:

  • Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

  • Based in Växjö or Stockholm, Sweden.

  • Willing to work four (4) days per week in the office and travel occasionally to customers’ sites.

If you are motivated by owning delivery quality, driving improvements, and building long-term customer relationships — we would love to hear from you.

Come and join Foxway 💜

  • Be part of a purpose-driven company enabling sustainable, circular tech.

  • Own the operational delivery of key customer contracts and drive real service excellence.

  • Work cross-functionally at the heart of performance, governance, and customer satisfaction.

  • Make a visible impact through proactive leadership and continuous improvement.

Help us make a difference

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like the next step in your career, apply quickly!

For the selected final candidate

Foxway will conduct a background check as part of our recruitment process, in accordance with applicable local legislation and our internal screening policy. The scope of the check depends on the position and the country in which it is based. You will be informed of the details, and your approval will be requested before any check is initiated.

How does Foxway operate?

Foxway is a fast-growing and dynamic organization with an international team of nearly 1,300 people. We operate across multiple countries, with key hubs across Europe.

Within Foxway, Circular Workspace Solutions (CWS) focuses on delivering sustainable workplace solutions through Device-as-a-Service, lifecycle services, and IT Asset Disposition offerings for enterprise and public sector customers.

Our mission is to make sustainable technology accessible to everyone by extending the life of IT equipment and enabling circular business models.

By joining us, you become part of a purpose-driven, international team that is shaping the future of sustainable workplaces and circular technology.
